[![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH 插件：Codex 风格彩色思考强度滑条 | DSH plugin: Codex-style colourful reasoning-effort slider
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-slider

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

A **Codex-style reasoning-effort slider** for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: it replaces the composer's discrete effort picker with one continuous, **colour-shifting** track — blue at the cool end, violet in the middle, bright lavender at the top.

![preview](preview.png)

---

## English

### The colours

Dragging does not merely lengthen a bar; the fill **heats up** as the effort rises:

| Position | Fill's right end | Feel |
|---|---|---|
| low (≤ 1/3) | `#4D93F8` blue | cool |
| middle (1/3 – 2/3) | blue → `#9333EA` violet | warming |
| high (≥ 2/3) | violet → `#C084FC` lavender | hot |

- The fill always starts blue on the left and blends toward the current accent, producing one continuous gradient.
- A glossy **sheen** layer rides on top of the gradient.
- The track is a **10 px pill**; the knob is a **white circle** with a same-colour ring.
- Tick marks and the current-level label **tint with the same ramp** (blue → indigo → lavender).
- The top stop is deliberately a *bright* lavender rather than a deep purple: deep purple is nearly invisible against the dark composer panel.

The palette follows the colour scheme of OpenAI Codex's reasoning-effort slider (`#4d93f8` / `#9333ea` / `#c084fc`, mixing across thirds of the track). Colour values only — no Codex code is included.

### Interaction

- 1:1 pointer dragging; on release the knob snaps to the nearest level and saves.
- Keyboard: ← / → step one level, Home / End jump to the ends.
- The menu stays open so you can fine-tune; a failed save springs the knob back.
- Registered as a `priority: -1` shadow of `conversation.input.model`, so the stock model seat stays as a fallback.

### Install

```sh
# web surface
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider

# desktop app
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
```

Or clone and install by path:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-effort-slider
```

**Restart DSH afterwards** (restart the app on desktop).

### Compatibility

Works on DSH `0.1.x` (web) and `0.2.1+` (desktop).

On 0.2.x, a traced service method rebinds `this.ctx` to the **caller**, and the `modelDirectories` resolver resolves `remote.session` through that context. Without declaring `remote` / `remote.session` in `inject`, the composer seat crashes with:

```
cannot get property "remote.session" without inject
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.input.model'
```

Both are declared here, and the registration uses the 0.2.x form (`ctx.slots.inject(...)` directly).

### Tests

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

Asserts the registration surface, the `remote.session` declaration, that the inject face resolves, that the component renders, and that **the three fill colours really progress with position** (`#4D93F8` → `#7063F1` → `#BF82FB`).

### License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Third-party notes in [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

---

## 中文

### 配色

拖动时颜色会随档位**"升温"**，不是单纯的进度条变长：

| 位置 | 填充右端颜色 | 观感 |
|---|---|---|
| 低段（≤ 1/3） | `#4D93F8` 蓝 | 冷 |
| 中段（1/3 ~ 2/3） | 蓝 → `#9333EA` 紫罗兰 | 过渡 |
| 高段（≥ 2/3） | 紫罗兰 → `#C084FC` 亮紫 | 热 |

- 填充始终以蓝为左端、向当前档位颜色过渡，形成一条连续渐变；
- 渐变之上叠一层**高光 sheen**；
- 轨道是 **10px 药丸形**，滑块是**白色圆钮**并带同色描边；
- 刻度点与当前档位文字**同样跟色**（蓝 → 靛紫 → 亮紫）；
- 最高档刻意用**亮紫而非深紫**：深紫在深色面板上几乎看不见。

配色参考了 OpenAI Codex 推理强度滑条（`#4d93f8` / `#9333ea` / `#c084fc`，按轨道前中后三段混合），仅取色值，不含 Codex 代码。

### 交互

- 指针 1:1 跟手拖动；松手吸附到最近档位并保存；
- 键盘 ← / → 逐档，Home / End 跳到两端；
- 菜单保持打开便于连续微调；保存失败会回弹；
- 以 `priority: -1` 影子注册 `conversation.input.model`，原模型座位作为兜底。

### 安装

```sh
# Web 版
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider

# 桌面应用版
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
```

或克隆后按路径安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-effort-slider
```

**装完重启 DSH**（桌面版重启应用）。

### 兼容性

同时适配 DSH `0.1.x`（Web）与 `0.2.1+`（桌面版）。

在 0.2.x 上，traced 服务方法会把 `this.ctx` 重绑到**调用方**，而 `modelDirectories` 会经由该上下文解析 `remote.session`。若 `inject` 未声明 `remote` / `remote.session`，模型座位会直接崩溃：

```
cannot get property "remote.session" without inject
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.input.model'
```

本插件已声明这两项，并使用 0.2.x 写法（`ctx.slots.inject(...)` 直接注册）。

### 测试

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

覆盖注册面、`remote.session` 声明、注入面可解析、组件渲染，以及**三档填充颜色确实随位置递进**（`#4D93F8` → `#7063F1` → `#BF82FB`）。

### 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；第三方说明见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

plugins.description: Global memory and user-level system prompts for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session facts with a per-turn index that costs no context.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-memory-system-prompt **中文** | [English](#english) 全局记忆插件：AI 可以主动把事实写进记忆文件，并在后续对话里按需读取。记忆索引每轮自动注入系统提示，**不占用对话上下文**。 同时包含**用户级系统提示词**功能（原先独立的 `dsh-system-prompt` 已并入本包），两部分共用同一个设置页。 ## 它解决什么 模型本身没有跨会话记忆。这个插件给出一份可持久、可检索的记忆区： - **AI 主动写**：对话中发现的稳定事实（偏好、约定、环境细节）由模型调用工具写入； - **索引常驻**：每轮把「标题 + 一句话摘要」注入系统提示，模型知道有什么； - **正文按需**：需要细节时再调工具读全文，不把整个记忆库塞进上下文； - **可按对话关**：某个对话不想带记忆时，单独关掉。 ## 工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |---|---| | `memory_save` | 保存或更新一条记忆（同名覆盖） | | `memory_read` | 按标识读取一条记忆的正文 | | `memory_list` | 列出全部记忆（默认只返回索引） | | `memory_delete` | 删除一条记忆 | ## 用户级系统提示词 写一次，对所有对话生效；也可以按对话单独禁用。 - **自定义正文**：任何想长期强加给模型的要求（语气、格式、禁止事项）； - **九维风格档位**：不想写长文时，用档位拼出一段行为指令（基础语气、亲切程度、热情程度、表情符号、可视化回答、标题和列表、快速回答、提示词建议、回答长度）； - **两种注入位置**：作为系统提示的一部分，或作为上下文片段。 档位默认都是「默认」，全部保持默认时不产生任何额外内容。 ## 界面 - **输入框左侧开关**：三态（关 / 部分 / 开），按对话生效； - **设置 → 记忆与提示词**：管理全局开关、单条记忆、系统提示词与风格档位、首次使用引导。 ## 存储 | 路径 | 内容 | |---|---| | `~/.dsh/memory/` | 每条记忆一个文件 | | `~/.dsh/memory-settings.json` | 记忆的全局开关与偏好 | | `~/.dsh/system-prompt/settings.json` | 系统提示词与风格档位 | ## 安装 **推荐：内置插件安装程序。** 打开「设置 → 内置插件」，粘贴包名，点安装，再重启应用： ``` dsh-memory-system-prompt ``` 安装程序会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手改任何文件。 命令行方式（先完全退出应用）： ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-memory-system-prompt ``` 然后把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启应用。 ## 注意 - 记忆索引通过 `systemPrompt.context` 注入，不是 `agent.inject`——后者会排队成一条用户消息，导致模型在回答完再自问自答一轮。 - 索引刷新挂在 `agent/created` 和 `turn/start` 上，因为在 assemble 之后才拿得到最新内容。 - 系统提示词部分**不把 `systemPrompt` 写进 `inject`**，而是运行时用 `agent.ctx.get('systemPrompt')` 取。硬注入会让 fiber 在服务未就绪时被挂起，表现是插件静默不加载、设置里一片空白。 --- **English** | [中文](#chinese) Global memory for DeepSeek Harness: the model can write facts into a persistent store and read them back later. The index is injected into the system prompt every turn, **without consuming conversation context**. The package also carries the **user-level system prompt** feature (the former standalone `dsh-system-prompt` is merged in). Both halves share one settings page. ## What it solves Models have no cross-session memory. This plugin provides a persistent, searchable memory area: - **The model writes**: stable facts discovered in conversation (preferences, conventions, environment details) are saved through tools; - **The index is always present**: each turn injects "title + one-line summary" into the system prompt, so the model knows what exists; - **Bodies are on demand**: the full text is read only when needed, so the whole store never floods the context; - **Per-conversation opt-out**: a conversation that should not carry memory can turn it off. ## Tools | Tool | Purpose | |---|---| | `memory_save` | Save or update one memory (same slug overwrites) | | `memory_read` | Read one memory body by slug | | `memory_list` | List memories (index only by default) | | `memory_delete` | Delete one memory | ## User-level system prompt Written once, applied to every conversation; can also be disabled per conversation. - **Custom body**: anything you want to impose on the model long-term (tone, format, prohibitions); - **Nine style dials**: build a behavior instruction from dials instead of prose — base tone, warmth, enthusiasm, emoji, visual answers, headings and lists, quick answers, suggestions, verbosity; - **Two injection positions**: part of the system prompt, or a context fragment. Every dial defaults to "default"; keeping all of them default produces no extra content. ## UI - **Composer toggle (left side)**: three states (off / partial / on), per conversation; - **Settings → Memory & Prompt**: global switch, individual memories, system prompt and style dials, first-run guide. ## Storage | Path | Contents | |---|---| | `~/.dsh/memory/` | One file per memory | | `~/.dsh/memory-settings.json` | Global switch and preferences for memory | | `~/.dsh/system-prompt/settings.json` | System prompt and style dials | ## Install **The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app: ``` dsh-memory-system-prompt ``` The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits. From the command line (quit the app completely first): ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-memory-system-prompt ``` Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app. ## Notes - The memory index is injected through `systemPrompt.context`, not `agent.inject`. The latter queues a user message, which makes the model answer its own question for another turn. - The index refreshes on `agent/created` and `turn/start`, because the content is only current after assembly. - The system-prompt half deliberately does **not** list `systemPrompt` in `inject`; it resolves the service at runtime via `agent.ctx.get('systemPrompt')`. A hard injection parks the fiber while the service is not ready, which shows up as a silently unloaded plugin and an empty settings page.

plugins.description: See which semantic primitives your answer lights up, live — brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style traces, composition card. 语义脉冲 / HowNet 义原可视化
plugins.readme_text:
# 语义脉冲 · dsh-primitive-pulse

在 DSH 里实时看**当前这段回答**点亮了哪些语义基元。右下角一个圆钮，点开是三个面板，也可以切到全屏背景模式。

![面板](assets/screenshots/sfx_panel.png)

**基元星图**——340 个簇铺成立体脑形，被命中的节点变亮，两端都亮的连线更亮：

![基元星图](assets/screenshots/sfx_brain.png)

**基元流 + 指纹卡**——上面是义原沿 token 的激活曲线（脑电样式多导联），下面是按分区聚合的构成表：

![基元流与指纹卡](assets/screenshots/sfx_stream.png)

| 面板 | 看什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 基元星图 | 340 个簇铺成立体脑形：被命中的节点变亮，两端都亮的连线更亮；静息时是一张暗着的网格 |
| 基元流 | 多条多导联，每条是一个义原沿 token 的激活曲线（带衰减拖尾），合成在一张脑电图纸上 |
| 指纹卡 | 义原按分区聚合后的构成表，按占比降序，和样例基线对比 |

**形状是隐喻，不是脑活动。** 面板里没有 fNIRS、没有皮层柱、没有任何神经测量；点亮的依据全部是文本经 HowNet 义原体系分解后的统计。所以页脚写的是「形状是隐喻，不是脑活动」。

## 它到底做了什么

1. 宿主把每轮 assistant 正文交给插件（`session/event` 的 `assistant/message`，不抓屏、不读你的输入）。
2. 正文用内置的中英词表切成词，每个词查 HowNet 义原（2,168 个义原 / 133,759 个中文词 / 48,042 个英文词）。
3. 逐 token 累出「义原激活流」，按指数衰减滚成曲线；同时聚成 340 个簇，投到预生成的三维坐标上。
4. 浏览器端只负责画：一个轮询 `/dsh-pulse/state`，拿到帧自己渲染。

## 装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:DreamLoomStudio/dsh-primitive-pulse
```

装完**重启 DSH Desktop**（宿主在启动时收集一次注入行，运行期加不进来）。重启后：

- 右下角出现圆钮；点它，或按 `Ctrl+Shift+P` 展开面板；
- 想看服务端是否起来，访问 `http://127.0.0.1:43129/dsh-pulse/ping`，返回 JSON 即正常：

```json
{"ok":true,"plugin":"dsh-primitive-pulse","assets":{"widget":25630,"core":11022,"data":4348808},"seq":0,"hasText":false}
```

## 用

- **圆钮可拖动**，位置会记住。
- 面板头部「背景模式」：把星图铺到整个窗口背景，慢慢自转；再点一次关闭（也会记住）。
- 没有新回答时，面板不会空着——回放结束后会按每个节点的峰值做错相位的呼吸，让你仍能看到这段回答激活了哪些区域。
- 手动粘贴：面板底部「手动粘贴」可以贴任意文本（不用等模型回答）试一段。

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-primitive-pulse
```

然后重启 DSH Desktop。

## 数据从哪来

- **2,168 个义原 / 133,759 个中文词 / 48,042 个英文词**：清华 [OpenHowNet](https://github.com/thunlp/OpenHowNet)（HowNet 语义词典）的义原组合，不取例句、不取词频排名。
- **补录 38 条**：HowNet 里没有的现代术语（微分、梯度、插件、面板、残差…）。
- **340 个簇**：义原共现矩阵 → 谱嵌入 → 递归二分聚类，簇名取质心最近的成员义原。
- **三维位置**：侧视剖面取样 + 半球深度 + 空间近邻网格（1,342 条边）。

词表与坐标全部离线打包在 `assets/sememe-data.js`（4.3 MB），**运行时不联网、不调模型、不上传任何内容**。

## 隐私边界

- 插件只在**服务端内存**里保留**最近一段** assistant 正文（`state.text`），进程退出即消失，不落盘、不写日志。
- 浏览器只向**本机**的 `/dsh-pulse/state` 取数据，路由先过宿主的 `connection.requestRejection` 信任栅栏（拿不到栅栏就 fail-closed）。
- 没有账号，没有统计，没有远程上报。

## 已知限制

- 宿主只推「一整条 assistant 消息」，没有逐字 delta：所以是**回答落地后回放**，不是逐字实时。
- 拿不到 `logprobs`（内核目前不暴露），所以没有「模型犹豫度」这一维。
- 多义词按 HowNet 第一个义项算，偶尔会出笑话（`把` → 把手、`世界` → 天体）。
- 未登录词会显示在底部（`未登录义原 N%`），不影响其余部分。

## 开发

先 clone 仓库（`test/` 与 `script/` 不在发布包的 `files` 里，装进 `node_modules` 的那份没有它们）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/DreamLoomStudio/dsh-primitive-pulse.git
cd dsh-primitive-pulse
node test/smoke.mjs            # 核心链路（分词 → 义原流 → 簇帧 → 指纹）
node test/widget_headless.mjs  # 挂件 DOM/Canvas 用最小桩跑一遍
node test/english.mjs          # 英文词表
```

资产同步（如果你在本仓库之外改了 `core.js` / 词表）：`node script/sync-assets.mjs`。

plugins.description: 按 workspace 注入一段用户可编辑的 system 提示词，sidebar 面板内编辑、保存后下一轮生效 | Workspace-scoped user-editable system-prompt section with a sidebar editor
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-workspace-system 按 workspace 注入一段用户编辑的 system 提示词段落：同一 workspace（canonical cwd 相同）下的所有会话（含 subagent）共享这段文本，sidebar 面板内编辑，保存后下一轮模型请求即生效，无需重启。 > Injects a user-edited system-prompt section per workspace: every session (subagents included) whose working directory belongs to the workspace shares one paragraph, edited from a sidebar panel and effective on the next model request after save. ## 功能 - **workspace 级注入**：监听 `agent/created`，把 workspace 文本构造成带标题的 `` 消息（source.kind `workspace-level-system`）经 `agent.inject()` 排入 next-step 边界——inbox 领取顺序使其位于 turn 1 首条用户消息之前（agent-instructions / preface-context 同款模式）。无 cwd/空文本不注入；目录缺失/读失败静默跳过（fail-soft）。编辑保存后对**下一个新会话**生效。 - **sidebar 面板**：注册官方 sidebar 全局面板（`main` keyed 槽 + `sidebar.panellist` 列表槽，id `workspace-system`、order 40）。面板左侧列出全部 workspace（有已存提示词的带徽标）与孤儿条目（workspace 已删但数据残留），右侧为选中 workspace 的 textarea + 保存/清空。 - **数据落盘**：`$DSH_HOME/workspace-level-system/`（即 `~/.dsh/workspace-level-system/`），每 workspace 两个文件：`.md`（原文）+ `.meta.json`（`{ "path": ... }` 供人工辨识）。host 侧自管，不进 settings.yaml。 - **写通道**：自托管 `/wls/api` HTTP 路由（POST only，JSON envelope），`set` 经 `realpathNormalize` 规范化路径后落盘（空文本即清除），拒绝 > 1 MiB 文本；同源校验。 - **大小护栏**：注入上限 256 KiB（超出截断并告警）；写入上限 1 MiB。 ## 开发 ### 仓库结构 ``` src/ ├── index.ts # host 入口: name/inject/apply + section 注册 + gateway 接线 ├── store.ts # 存储层: dir/keyOf/读写清列 + mtime 缓存 + 写串行化 + 大小上限 ├── gateway.ts # POST /wls/api/{list,set,clear}: origin 校验 + JSON envelope └── client/ ├── index.ts # client 入口: main 面板体 + sidebar.panellist 图标注册 ├── panel.tsx # 面板: workspace 列表 + textarea + Save/Clear ├── panel.css.ts #

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: design-first PowerPoint generation - guided intake, AI imagery, editable slides, layout checks, vision review. DSH 设计型 PPT 生成插件。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pptx-studio **Design-first PowerPoint generation for DeepSeek Harness** 给一个主题，得到一套可编辑、版式完整、配图统一的 PPT。 [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-%E2%89%A50.2.1--rc.2-0b5fff)](https://github.com/ColdMagicchess/PTT-Studio) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-143%20passed-brightgreen)](tests) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A522.19-339933)](package.json) [功能](#功能) · [示例](#示例) · [安装](#安装) · [使用](#使用) · [工具](#工具) · [开发](#开发) · [Roadmap](#roadmap)
--- ## 为什么是它 大多数 AI PPT 工具做的是「把文字塞进模板」：页页一样、图是贴纸、导出后全是图片。 `dsh-pptx-studio` 走的是另一条路：**先把每一页当设计稿画出来，再用确定性代码组装**。 - **先设计，再生成**：先产出可审阅的 `deck.json`（版式、网格、层级、配色、图片位置），再渲染成 PPT。 - **满版构图**：内置覆盖率检查，极简也要撑满版面，拒绝「上半页内容 + 下半页空白」。 - **真实素材优先**：名画、文物、地标、产品先用公有领域/授权原图，AI 只补没有现成素材的插画、背景和装饰。 - **确定性组装**：pptxgenjs 按百分比坐标绘制，文字、形状、图表、表格、图标全部是原生可编辑元素。 - **自带质检**：溢出、重叠、安全区、文字密度、对比度、装饰压字、版面覆盖率、背景采样，逐项检查后再交付。 - **图片不重复嵌入**：同一张背景/装饰只存一份，配合 800px 级图片压缩，成片通常在 1–4 MB。 ## 示例 以下都是插件真实生成的成片（点击预览图查看大图）： | 编程夏令营 · 扁平插画 / rich | 清明上河图导览 · 水墨 / ornate | 旧办公楼更新 · 瑞士极简 / minimal | |---|---|---| | [](docs/preview/camp.jpg) | [](docs/preview/qingming.jpg) | [](docs/preview/swiss.jpg) | | 7 页 · 3 背景 + 6 张 cutout 插画 + 10 件装饰 · 2.9 MB | 7 页 · 公有领域原作裁段 + 12 件水墨装饰 · 3.7 MB | 7 页 · 黑白建筑摄影 + 严格网格 + 信号红 · 650 KB | > 三份成片均为 `pptx_build` 0 error 产物；预览由 LibreOffice 渲染。 ## 功能 ### 设计系统 - **11 套风格**：扁平插画、科技深色、国风水墨、瑞士国际主义、复古印刷、手绘、3D 等； - **5 档复杂程度**：极简 / 简约 / 均衡 / 复杂 / 华丽； - **3 档文字量**：字少多图、均衡、字多图少； - **17 种版式**：封面、章节、要点、对比、时间线、数据、图表、表格、引用、图片全屏、结尾等； - 统一网格、字号阶梯、留白与安全区规则，生成前先看 `assets/pptx-studio/references/styles.md`。 ### 素材生成 - 风格板：一次生成 2–3 张候选封面构图，用户选定后作为插画风格参考； - 背景 / 插画 / 装饰件分开生成：背景只画底子，装饰件按组生成后切成透明 PNG； - 插画默认 **cutout 去底**，直接融入背景，不套白框； - 插画可带风格参考图；纯背景与装饰件不参考人物图，避免把角色抄进背景； - 支持 Agnes AI（默认）与 ModelScope（Qwen-Image）两种图片后端，带缓存、重试、限流； - 真实素材优先：支持 `path` 直接引用本地图片，并记录来源与许可。 ### 生成与质检 - `pptx_build` 组装可编辑 `.pptx`：文字、形状、原生图表、轻量表格、矢量图标、装饰件、页码； - `pptx_check` 检查溢出、重叠、安全区、密度、对比度、`fill` 覆盖率、装饰压字、背景纹理采样； - `pptx_review` 用配置的独立视觉模型逐页评审渲染图，返回结构化的版式 / 字号 / 对比度 / 配图问题； - `pptx_render` 用 LibreOffice Kit 渲染逐页 PNG，交给对话模型做视觉复查； - `pptx_build` 默认生成逐页缩略图和总览图 `<文件名>.preview.jpg`，交付时一起给出； - `pptx_generate_assets` 支持 `run_in_background`：图片多时立即返回 job id，模型继续写后面的页，最后用 `job_output` 收结果。 ### 插件集成 - 注册 `pptx-studio` skill：模型按「问需求 → 写 deck → 生成素材 → 组装 → 检查」流程执行； - **聊天卡片**：6 个 `pptx_*` 工具在 Web 对话里显示专用卡片——组装卡带总览图、页数、体积与问题，评审卡逐页结论，配图/样张/渲染卡显示缩略图网格，点击可放大； - 插件设置页：文字 / 图片 / 视觉三类模型，自定义 OpenAI 兼容模型，API Key 写入 DSH 凭据库； - 文字与视觉模型默认跟随当前对话；图片模型默认 Agnes； - 兼容 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 及以上（`engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`）。 ## 工作流 ```text 主题 │ ├─ ask_user_question → brief.json 风格 / 复杂度 / 文字量 ├─ 逐页设计稿 → deck.json 版式、元素、坐标、文案 ├─ pptx_style_board → style/board-N.png 候选风格构图（用户选定） ├─ pptx_generate_assets → assets/ decor/ 背景、插画、装饰件 ├─ pptx_build → builds/deck.vN.pptx 确定性组装 + 几何检查 ├─ pptx_check / pptx_render 文字、对比度、覆盖率、逐页目检 └─ present 交付 .pptx ``` 每一步的产出都落在工作区文件里，模型只通过工具结果和文件看到内容；中途可以随时改 `deck.json` 重新组装。 ## 安装 ### 环境要求 - DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2** 或更新的 0.2.x（0.3 尚未适配）； - Node.js **≥ 22.19**（仅从源码构建时需要）； - 图片生成需要 Agnes 或 ModelScope 的 API Key。 ### 从插件市场安装（推荐） 本仓库自带一份 DSH 插件市场索引（[market/index.json](market/index.json)，格式 1，已用 DSH 官方校验器验证）： 1. 打开 **插件** → **实验性插件** 旁的 **更多** → 打开 **自定义插件市场**； 2. 切到 **发现** → **添加索引源**，填入 `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ColdMagicchess/PTT-Studio/main/market/index.json`； 3. 搜索 “PPT”，点 **安装**。每个版本锁定到一个提交，无需构建授权。 ### 直接从 GitHub 安装 本仓库按 DSH **组合包（bundle）分发格式**组织，并且已经把构建产物提交在 `lib/` 下，因此不需要在安装时构建： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ColdMagicchess/PTT-Studio ``` 安装后重启 Desktop，在「插件」页看到 **PPT 工作室** 即成功。生产环境建议锁定 commit： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ColdMagicchess/PTT-Studio# ``` ### 从源码构建 tgz ```bash git clone https://github.com/ColdMagicchess/PTT-Studio.git cd PTT-Studio pnpm install pnpm run build pnpm run pack ``` 然后在 Desktop 中二选一： 1. 打开「插件」页 → 安装第三方插件 → 选择 `dist/dsh-pptx-studio-0.4.1.tgz`； 2. 或退出 Desktop 后，用自带 CLI 安装： ```powershell "E:\Deepseek harness Desktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "E:\path\to\dist\dsh-pptx-studio-0.4.1.tgz" ``` 重启 Desktop，插件页出现 **PPT 工作室** 即安装成功。 > 如果修改了源码，重新执行 `pnpm run build` 后把 `lib/index.js`、`lib/client.js` 一起提交；DSH 从 GitHub 安装的是仓库内容，不会替你运行构建脚本。 ### 配置 API Key 打开「插件 → PPT 工作室」设置页，在 **API Key** 分区填入： - `AGNES_API_KEY`：Agnes AI 国内站（默认图片后端）； - `MODELSCOPE_API_KEY`：ModelScope（可选备用后端）； - 自定义模型 Key：按自定义模型的 `apiKeyRef` 填写。 Key 只写入 DSH 凭据库，不进入配置文件。也可以直接设置同名环境变量后重启 Desktop。 ## 使用 安装后在对话里直接说： > 做一份关于「青少年编程夏令营」的招生 PPT，风格活泼一点，文字少一些。 > 做一份「旧办公楼更新提案」，现代极简、商务建筑风，7 页左右。 模型会自动加载 `pptx-studio` skill，按顺序完成需求确认、设计稿、风格板、配图、组装和检查。如果插件设置里配置了独立视觉模型（`visionModelMode` 为 `route` 或 `custom`），检查阶段会调用 `pptx_review` 逐页评审并返回结构化问题；默认 `session` 时仍用渲染图 + `read_image` 复查。你也可以在过程中直接指定： - 「用瑞士国际主义风格，黑白摄影 + 信号红」 - 「这块内容太空了，补满一点」 - 「插画不要白边，直接融进背景」 - 「第 5 页文字太小，投影看不清」 ## 工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |---|---| | `pptx_style_board` | 生成 2–3 张候选风格样张，供用户选定 | | `pptx_generate_assets` | 生成背景、插画、装饰件；支持 `run_in_background` 后台任务与进度 | | `pptx_build` | 按 `deck.json` 组装 `.pptx`，内置几何检查与媒体去重 | | `pptx_check` | 检查溢出、重叠、安全区、密度、对比度、覆盖率和装饰压字 | | `pptx_review` | 用独立视觉模型逐页评审渲染图，返回结构化问题与修复建议 | | `pptx_render` | 用 LibreOffice Kit 逐页渲染 PNG，做视觉复查 | 配套 skill：[`assets/pptx-studio/SKILL.md`](assets/pptx-studio/SKILL.md)；版式与风格参考在 [`assets/pptx-studio/references/`](assets/pptx-studio/references/)。 ## 配置 所有可调参数都在插件 `Config` 中（`src/config.ts`），可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖；设置页编辑下列字段： | 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `textModelMode` / `textModelName` | `session` / 空 | 文字模型：跟随对话、Host 路线或自定义模型 | | `visionModelMode` / `visionModelName` | `session` / 空 | 视觉模型：`pptx_review` 用它逐页评审 | | `imageBackend` | `agnes` | 当前图片后端；内置 `agnes`、`modelscope` | | `imageBackends` | Agnes + ModelScope | 内置图片后端列表（名称、类型、模型、Base URL、Key 引用） | | `customImageBackendsJson` | `[]` | 设置页里追加的图片后端，同名会替换内置项 | | `customModelsJson` | `[]` | 自定义 OpenAI 兼容模型数组 | | `customModelApiKeyRef` | `CUSTOM_API_KEY` | 自定义模型 Key 的凭据名 | | `imageMaxPx` | `800` | 嵌入图片的最长边（控制包体大小） | | `maxImagesPerCall` | `24` | 单次生成图片上限 | ## 插件仓库格式 本仓库遵循 DSH 第三方组合包的标准分发布局（单插件仓库）： ```text package.json name / version / main / exports / files / engines.dsh dsh.bundle.patch → cordis.patch.yml dsh.client → lib/client.js（Web 设置页） cordis.patch.yml bundle 层：插入一个 id 为 pptx-studio 的 Host 行 lib/index.js Host 入口（已提交，安装即用） lib/client.js Web 设置页（已提交） locale/ 插件页标题与描述 assets/pptx-studio/ skill、风格/版式/生图/质检规范 src/ TypeScript 源码（开发用） ``` `package.json` 的 `files` 精确包含发布需要的文件；`lib/` 是构建产物但**必须入库**，因为 `dsh plugin add github:...` 只拉源码、不运行 `prepare`/构建脚本。 ## 使用其他图片模型 除了默认的 Agnes，任何 **OpenAI 兼容的图片接口**都能用，在插件设置页「图片模型 → 自定义图片后端」里加一项，再把「当前图片后端」改成它的 `name`： ```json [ { "name": "gpt-image", "kind": "openai", "baseUrl": "https://api.openai.com/v1", "model": "gpt-image-1", "apiKeyRef": "OPENAI_IMAGE_KEY" } ] ``` | `kind` | 适用接口 | 请求格式 | |---|---|---| | `openai` | 标准 OpenAI Images API：OpenAI gpt-image / DALL·E、OpenRouter、硅基流动、各类中转网关等 | `POST /images/generations`，`model` + `prompt` + `n` + 像素 `size` | | `openai-compatible` | Agnes 这类扩展接口 | 档位 `size`（1K/2K）+ `ratio` + `return_base64` | | `modelscope` | ModelScope API-Inference | 异步任务 + 轮询 | `openai` 类型的可选项：`sizes`（按比例覆盖尺寸，如 `{"16:9": "1792x1024"}`；默认 1536x1024 / 1024x1536 / 1024x1024）、`responseFormat`（`b64_json` 或 `url`）、`extraBody`（附加字段，如 `{"quality": "high"}`）。Key 用设置页的「自定义模型凭据名」写入 `apiKeyRef` 指向的凭据即可，同样只存进 DSH 凭据库。`baseUrl` 必须是 https（本机网关可用 `http://127.0.0.1`）。 注意：`openai` 类型不发送风格参考图（标准接口的参考图走 multipart 编辑端点），插画风格一致性靠 `styleAnchor` 提示词保持。 ## plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-inline-trigger

> 让 DSH Web 输入框在**已有内容**时也能用 `/` 唤起指令菜单、用 `@` 唤起「文件 / 会话」引用菜单 —— 包括紧跟在中文等非 ASCII 文字之后输入的情况。

[![test](https://github.com/xubin0628/dsh-inline-trigger/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/xubin0628/dsh-inline-trigger/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[License: MIT](LICENSE)

原生 DSH 的触发规则（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-input-trigger`）只认三种位置：

- 输入框最前面；
- 空格（含换行）之后；
- 对 `/` 额外允许：标点之后（URL 里的 `:/`、`//` 除外）。

所以 `你好/`、`你好@`、`总结一下@文件` 这类**紧跟在中文后面**的输入不会弹出菜单 —— 中文本来就不习惯敲空格，于是看起来就变成「只有输入框为空时 `/` 和 `@` 才有用」。本插件就是补上这一格。

## 安装

### 直接下载 zip（免 git）

从 [Releases](https://github.com/xubin0628/dsh-inline-trigger/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-inline-trigger-1.0.0.zip` 并解压，然后在 DSH 会话里让 agent 安装该目录：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle { target: "<解压目录绝对路径>" }
```

### 从 GitHub 克隆后安装（推荐）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xubin0628/dsh-inline-trigger.git
```

然后在 DSH 会话里让 agent 安装这个目录（把路径换成实际克隆位置）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle { target: "<克隆目录绝对路径>" }
```

或者用 CLI：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<克隆目录绝对路径>
```

装好后插件出现在「设置 → 插件」里，页面会自动同步，不需要重启。

### 本地开发目录安装

直接在插件源码目录执行同样的 `plugin_manager install_bundle`（`target` 指向源码目录）即可；profile 会以链接方式引用该目录，改完代码后页面热重载生效。

## 生效范围

| 输入 | 原生 DSH | 装插件后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/model`（空输入框） | ✅ | ✅（不变） |
| `hello /model`（空格后） | ✅ | ✅（不变） |
| `你好/`（中文后） | ❌ | ✅ |
| `总结一下/`（中文后） | ❌ | ✅ |
| `参考@会话`（中文后） | ❌ | ✅ |
| `你好，@文件`（中文标点后） | ❌ | ✅ |
| `a@b.com`（邮箱） | ❌ | ❌（保护） |
| `src/index.ts`（路径） | ❌ | ❌（保护） |
| `https://example.com/@u` | ❌ | ❌（保护） |

规则一句话：**`/` 只在非 ASCII 文字（中文、日文、韩文、西里尔、带音标拉丁等）后面放宽；`@` 在除 ASCII 字母/数字/下划线、`/`、`:`、`@` 以外的任意非空白字符后面放宽。** 这样既解决中文输入的问题，又不会在邮箱、路径、URL 里乱弹菜单。

已触发菜单之后的一切行为（键盘选择、引用 chip 插入、`/` 指令的 popup / 动作 / 直接执行、Esc 关闭、IME、只读/命令 chip 阶段）都沿用 DSH 原生实现，本插件只影响「是否判定为触发」这一步：

- 输入框最前已经有一条命令 chip（`claimed` 阶段）时，`/` 仍不触发（与原生一致）；
- `frozen` 阶段（提交中等）不触发；
- 关闭插件（或 HMR 卸载）时，对 DSH 的包装会完整还原。

## 可选项：更激进的边界

默认模式（`cjk`）保留邮箱与代码路径保护。如果你希望「任何非空白字符后面输入 `/` 或 `@` 都弹菜单」，在页面控制台执行一次：

```js
localStorage.setItem('dsh-inline-trigger:mode', 'always'); // 改回默认：localStorage.removeItem('dsh-inline-trigger:mode')
```

然后刷新页面（或等插件热重载）。代价很直接：`a@b.com`、`src/index.ts` 这类输入也会弹菜单，`https://` 除外（协议里的 `:/`、`//` 始终不触发）。

## 它怎么工作（给维护者）

DSH 的触发判定在 `InputTriggerController.track()` 内部，插件无法通过注册 trigger source 改变它。因此本插件：

1. 注入 `inputTriggers` 服务，包装它的 `sessionOf()`，从而拿到每个会话的 `InputTriggerController` 并包装其 `track()`；
2. 在把 draft 交给原生判定之前，生成一个**长度完全相同**的「影子 draft」：只把触发符前面那一个字符替换成边界字符（`@` 前换成空格、`/` 前换成 `、`）；
3. 原生 `detectTrigger()` 在影子 draft 上判定成功；由于替换发生在 token span 之前且不改变长度，`trigger / query / span {start,end} / position` 与真实 draft 完全一致，之后的选择、插入、命令 claim、token 消费都用真实偏移和真实 draftRev 工作；
4. 真实编辑器内容从不被修改。

这是一个针对已安装 DSH 版本行为的小包装（不修改编辑器 DOM、不 require 任何 Harness 客户端包）。升级 DSH 后如果上游把边界规则改宽了，本插件会自动变成「什么都不做」的纯直通。

## 测试

```bash
node test/detection.test.mjs
```

测试会把 `client.js` 的真实工厂函数加载起来，并用从当前 DSH 安装包里原样复制的 `detectTrigger()` 判定影子 draft，覆盖中文/日文/西里尔、邮箱与 URL 保护、`always` 模式、`frozen`/`claimed` 阶段、补丁安装与卸载还原。

## 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 半边：空 `apply()`，只为了让包成为一条 Loader entry |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半边：影子 draft 判定 + `track()` 包装 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 挂载声明（插入一条 row） |
| `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` | 插件管理页的标题与描述 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标（原创） |
| `test/detection.test.mjs` | 自包含回归测试 |

## English

**dsh-inline-trigger** makes the DSH Web composer open the `/` command menu and the `@` file/session reference menu even when the draft already contains text — most importantly right after CJK text, where a space is not normally typed.

The shipped trigger pipeline (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-input-trigger`) only accepts a trigger at start-of-draft, after whitespace, or (for `/`) after punctuation. This plugin wraps the per-session `InputTriggerController.track()` and feeds the host a same-length *shadow draft* where only the character before the trigger is replaced by a boundary character. Detection succeeds while the real span/query/revision stay identical, so picks, chips, command claims and token consumption keep working; the real editor content is never touched.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xubin0628/dsh-inline-trigger.git
# then, in a DSH session: plugin_manager install_bundle { target: "<abs path to the clone>" }
```

| Input | DSH | with plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `你好/` | ❌ | ✅ |
| `参考@会话` | ❌ | ✅ |
| `a@b.com`, `src/index.ts`, `https://…` | ❌ | ❌ (deliberate protection) |

Set `localStorage['dsh-inline-trigger:mode'] = 'always'` in the page console to relax the boundary after ASCII words too. Tests: `node test/detection.test.mjs`. MIT licensed.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 xubin0628

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: 在 DSH-HARNESS 中通过插件读写 Excel VBA 工程
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vba-bridge

让 DSH 会话里的 AI 直接读写 **Excel VBA 工程**：列模块、读源码、改代码、导出
`.frm`/`.frx`、列过程，并在保存后重新打开校验。核心走 Excel 自己的 COM/VBIDE，
所以改完的宏由 Excel 编译、保存和验收，而不是硬拆 `vbaProject.bin`。

Windows · 桌面 Excel · DSH Host 插件 · MIT

GitHub: <https://github.com/alexltr/dsh-vba-bridge>

![VBA Bridge 讲解图](docs/screenshot.png)

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `vba_doctor` | 安装后先跑：检查 Python、pywin32、Excel COM、`AccessVBOM`、离线解析器、临时目录，可选一个工作簿 |
| `vba_inspect` | 工程名、保护状态、全部组件（模块/工作表/ThisWorkbook/窗体）与引用 |
| `vba_read_module` | 读取单个模块源码，含 UserForm 代码区 |
| `vba_write_module` | 替换/追加/新建模块，原地保存，复开校验，生成 `.bak` |
| `vba_export_modules` | 导出全部组件：源码（`.bas/.cls/.frm`）或原生 `.frm` + `.frx`，写 `_manifest.json` |
| `vba_list_procedures` | 列出 `Sub`/`Function`/`Property` 的参数、起止行号，含窗体事件处理 |

相对路径按 **DSH 会话工作目录** 解析；绝对路径原样使用。

## 安装

发布到 npm 后：

```text
dsh plugin add dsh-vba-bridge
```

当前开发目录（本地链接安装）：

```text
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=F:\MyProjects\dsh\vba_bridge
```

安装后先调用 `vba_doctor`，它会把“缺 Python / 缺 pywin32 / 没开 AccessVBOM / Excel
起不来”逐项列出来并给修复建议。

## 前置条件

1. **Windows + 桌面版 Microsoft Excel**（本机实测 16.0.20430.20182）。
2. **Python 3.10+**，并安装 `pywin32`：
   `pip install pywin32`。默认使用 PATH 里的 `python`，可用配置 `pythonPath` 或
   环境变量 `DSH_VBA_PYTHON` 指定。
3. Excel 信任中心开启 **“信任对 VBA 工程对象模型的访问”**：
   `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Excel\Security\AccessVBOM = 1`。
   这是允许本机程序读写 VBA 的全局开关，属于安全决策，不要在不可信的机器上随意打开。
4. 目标文件是 `.xlsm` / `.xlsb` / `.xls` / `.xlam`；`.xlsx` 没有 VBA 容器，会被拒绝。

## 用法

直接用自然语言即可：

- “看一下 `D:\book.xlsm` 里有哪些 VBA 模块”
- “把 `模块1` 的源码读出来”
- “把这段代码写进 `模块1`，先备份”
- “把 `MyVBALibrary.xlam` 的全部模块导出到 `F:\dump`”
- “列出 `FRM_PictureViewer` 里有哪些事件处理过程”

手动参数示例：

```json
{"file": "D:\\book.xlsm"}
{"file": "D:\\book.xlsm", "module": "模块1"}
{"file": "D:\\book.xlsm", "module": "模块1", "code": "Sub Hello()\r\n    MsgBox \"hi\"\r\nEnd Sub\r\n", "mode": "replace"}
{"file": "D:\\book.xlsm", "outDir": "D:\\dump", "mode": "component", "overwrite": true}
{"file": "D:\\book.xlsm", "module": "FRM_PictureViewer"}
```

### 写入语义

- `mode=replace`：重写模块代码区；隐藏的 `VB_*` 属性由 Excel 保留，文档模块可安全重写。
- `mode=append`：读出旧代码 → 拼接 → 整体重写（不依赖 `AddFromString` 的插入位置）。
- `create=true`：模块不存在时新建标准模块。
- 每次写入先复制 `原名.YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS.bak.xlsm`，保存后在同一 Excel 实例里重新
  打开并比对源码 SHA-256，返回 `verified: true/false`。

### 窗体（UserForm）

- 窗体的代码就是它的 `CodeModule`：`UserForm_Activate`、`btnCancel_Click`、
  `imgBigPicture_MouseUp` 等事件处理都能读写，和普通模块一致。
- 只改代码区，**不改**控件布局、属性页或 `.frx` 设计数据。
- `mode=component` 导出 `.frm` + `.frx`，`.frm` 头部保留 `VERSION 5.00 / Begin ...`，
  `.frx` 的 `OleObjectBlob` 完整，可用于备份/迁移。
- `mode=code` 的 `.frm` 只有代码，不能直接重新导入。

### 导出

- `mode=code`：UTF-8 源码，适合 grep、diff、喂给模型分析。
- `mode=component`：调用 `VBComponent.Export`，窗体会多出 `.frx`。
- 输出目录写 `_manifest.json`（类型、行数、字节数、SHA-256、跳过/失败）。
- `overwrite` 默认 `false`，已存在的文件跳过并报告。

## 配置

安装行 id 是 `vba-bridge`，默认配置在 [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pythonPath` | 空 → `python`（其次 `DSH_VBA_PYTHON`） | 带 `pywin32` 的 Python |
| `bridgePath` | 空 → 包内 `bridge/vba_bridge.py` | 自定义桥接脚本 |
| `timeoutMs` | `240000` | 单次工具调用超时 |
| `allowWrite` | `true` | `false` 时 `vba_write_module` 直接拒绝 |
| `maxOutputChars` | `200000` | 工具输出截断上限 |

修改后重载插件（禁用/启用）或重启 Harness 生效；也可以在该 profile 的 patch 层
按行 id `vba-bridge` 覆盖配置。当前版本尚未导出 `Config` schema，所以这些键通过
patch 配置而不是设置页表单修改。

## 安全边界

- 桥接期间 `AutomationSecurity=3`，读写源码不会顺带执行工作簿里的宏。
- 不提供“运行宏”工具；运行宏等于任意代码执行，需要时另行评估。
- 插件以宿主用户权限运行 Python，**绕过 DSH 文件沙箱**；只安装可信版本，只对可信工作簿使用。
- 写入默认生成 `.bak` 并复开校验；校验失败会返回 `verified: false`，不会静默成功。
- 密码保护的 VBA 工程无法编辑；任何改动都会使数字签名失效。
- 保存由 Excel 重写整个包，字节会变化（本机样本 39,195 → 37,537 字节）；
  生产使用请保留备份并做业务校验。

## 错误码

| 代码 | 含义 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOT_MACRO_ENABLED` | `.xlsx` 等无 VBA 容器 | 换 `.xlsm`/`.xlsb`/`.xls` |
| `FILE_NOT_FOUND` | 路径不存在 | 检查路径/相对路径基准 |
| `FILE_LOCKED` | 被 Excel 占用或残留 `~$` 文件 | 关闭工作簿/清理锁文件 |
| `VBA_TRUST_DISABLED` | 未开 AccessVBOM | 信任中心勾选 |
| `PROJECT_PROTECTED` | VBA 工程有密码 | 在 VBE 中取消密码 |
| `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` | 模块名不匹配 | 按提示候选名重试 |
| `EXCEL_UNAVAILABLE` | COM 无法启动 Excel | 安装桌面 Excel、检查策略 |
| `PYWIN32_MISSING` | 当前 Python 无 pywin32 | `pip install pywin32` |
| `OLETOOLS_MISSING` | 离线解析器缺失 | 重装 bundle |
| `ENGINE_READONLY` | 指定 `engine=ovba` 做写入/导出 | 改用 COM |
| `INVALID_OUTDIR` | `outDir` 指向文件 | 传目录路径 |

## 开发与测试

```powershell
npm test          # Node 单元测试：工具注册、schema、相对路径、元数据
npm run test:py   # Python 单元测试：过程解析、文件名清洗
```

E2E 需要 Excel + `AccessVBOM=1`，见 [docs/feasibility.md](docs/feasibility.md) 与
`test_local.mjs`。桥接脚本可以直接跑：

```powershell
python bridge\vba_bridge.py inspect fixtures\sample.xlsm
python bridge\vba_bridge.py read fixtures\sample.xlsm 模块1
python bridge\vba_bridge.py export fixtures\sample.xlsm work\export --mode component
python bridge\vba_bridge.py procedures fixtures\sample.xlsm 模块1
```

## 项目结构

```text
vba_bridge/
├─ index.js                 # 六个工具与路径解析
├─ package.json             # bundle 清单与市场元数据
├─ cordis.patch.yml         # 插入 vba-bridge 行
├─ locale/{en,zh}.json      # 插件管理器显示名/描述
├─ icon.svg
├─ bridge/vba_bridge.py     # JSON 协议桥接：COM + 离线 OVBA
├─ vendor/                  # 精简 oletools 子集（离线只读）
├─ tests/                   # Node + Python 单元测试
├─ docs/feasibility.md      # 可行性论证
├─ docs/screenshot.png      # 讲解图
└─ CHANGELOG.md
```

## 限制

- 写入/导出依赖桌面 Excel；无 Excel 只能离线读，且离线模式的组件类型是近似值、
  行数包含隐藏的 `Attribute` 行。
- 窗体只支持代码，不支持设计器编辑。
- 当前不运行宏。
- 当前没有 `Config` schema / 设置页表单，也没有 `allowedRoots` 路径白名单；
  配置通过 profile patch 完成。
- `.xlsb` / `.xls` 未单独实测（`.xlsm` / `.xlam` 已实测）。
- 单次调用通常 5–15 秒，取决于 Excel 启动、杀毒软件和是否复开校验。

## License

MIT；第三方组件见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。
