plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost-slip

> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在输入框底部显示当前会话的估算费用（人民币），点击打开，显示费用明细和账号余额。

![截图展示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pktheme/dsh-cost-slip/main/docs/Screenshot.png)

## 功能

- **独立胶囊**：在输入框底部统计行里，和「会话统计」「Token 用量」并排；收据图标 + `费用 ¥0.44`，hover 底色和圆角与原生一致。
- **费用明细**：点开胶囊，按「缓存命中 / 未缓存输入 / 输出」列出 token 数与金额，标题右侧是合计。
- **账号余额**：明细下方显示当前登录账号的「充值余额」「赠金余额」；打开弹窗时刷新读一次，之后每 10 秒刷新。
- **按条计价**：每条回复用当时的模型和峰谷价单独计算，中途换模型、跨高峰都保持准确。
- **窄窗口自适应**：窗口变窄或打开右侧边栏时，胶囊文字像原生统计项一样省略号截断。

## 安装

基于 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 开发，更低版本安装使用尚未测试。

桌面版：插件 → 添加插件 → 安装第三方插件，填 `dsh-cost-slip`，点「立即启用」后重启 DSH。

Web 版：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cost-slip
```

（`dsh` 未全局安装时：`npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cost-slip`）

安装后重启 `dsh web` 生效。

首次安装需要联网：宿主端依赖 `zod`，由 pnpm/npm 自动安装。

## 怎么算的

按**每条** `assistant/message`（以及失败重试的 `assistant/attempt`）单独计价：

1. 取这条回复的 `usage`：未命中输入 `inputTokens`、缓存命中 `cacheReadTokens`、缓存写入 `cacheWriteTokens`、输出 `outputTokens`。
2. 取这条回复的模型（`message.source.model`，缺失时用最近一次 `request/header`）和完成时间 `event.time`。
3. 用 `lib/pricing.js` 的价目表计算，单位换算成微元后累加。

**缓存写入按未命中单价计。** 价格来源：[DeepSeek 官方定价](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)

## 隐私

- 只通过 DSH 宿主接口读取会话的 token 用量与事件，不抓包、不联网。
- 余额通过宿主提供的账号接口读取，仅用于显示。
- 不上报任何数据，不写入额外文件。

## 已知边界

- **估算值**：不是官方账单；赠送额度、优惠、失败请求的计费细节以 DeepSeek 账单为准。
- **子智能体**：subagent 跑在独立会话里，主会话的费用不含它们的消耗。
- **旧事件**：只对带 provider usage 的回复计费；没有 usage 的旧事件会跳过。
- **兼容性**：依赖 DSH 的 `sessionProjections` 和 `composer.dock` 插槽；DSH 大版本升级后若改名，插件需要跟着改。

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pktheme/dsh-cost-slip.git
cd dsh-cost-slip
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

- `lib/index.js`：宿主端会话投影，按条累计费用。
- `lib/client.js`：胶囊与弹窗 UI。
- `lib/pricing.js`：价目表与峰谷判断，调价只改这里。
- `locale/*.json`：插件名与简介。

协议：MIT。

## 图标

插件页图标 `icon.svg` 与界面里的收据图标均为作者本人绘制。

---

非官方插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 DSH 风格的应用内目录选择器接管「新建工作区」，支持盘符逐级浏览与 Everything 全盘文件夹搜索
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-everything-search

把 DSH 的「新建工作区」从 **Windows 原生文件夹对话框**换成 **DSH 风格的应用内对话框**：

- **盘符逐级浏览**：左栏「最近使用 / 快速访问 / 此电脑（盘符 + 可用空间）」，右栏面包屑 + 双击进入 + 上一级 + 新建文件夹。
- **Everything 全盘搜索**：顶部输入即搜，用 voidtools 官方 `es.exe` 走 Everything 的 MFT 索引，只返回文件夹（实测单次查询约 45 ms），命中片段高亮，方向键选择、回车确认。
- **完全跟随 DSH 主题**：控件外观由本插件自带样式 + `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token 保证，浅色/深色自动一致。
- 两者可随时混用：搜到目标直接选，搜不到就手动点下去；Everything 不可用时**只有搜索受影响**，手动浏览照常。

![选择工作区目录](docs/dialog.png)

| 逐级浏览 + 单击选中（右下角选中的就是这一行） | Everything 搜索 |
|---|---|
| ![逐级浏览](docs/selected.png) | ![搜索](docs/search.png) |

> 截图里的 `C:\dsh-demo` 是演示目录，不代表你的机器。

## 功能一览

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 接管「新建工作区」 | 侧栏 `+` 与对话空态 hero 两个入口都换成应用内对话框 |
| 盘符逐级浏览 | 快速访问（主目录/桌面/下载/文档…）+ 此电脑（盘符 + 可用空间），双击进入、面包屑跳转、上一级 |
| Everything 搜索 | 输入即搜（默认 80 条），只返回文件夹，命中高亮，回车/双击进入，方向键选择 |
| 选中即目标 | 单击选中某项后，右下角「选择此文件夹」选中的就是它；点空白处取消选中则回到当前目录 |
| 最近使用 | 可折叠/展开，最多 5 条，记忆在 localStorage |
| 新建 / 重命名 | 新建文件夹；`F2` 重命名（Windows 资源管理器语义，回车提交、Esc 取消） |
| 噪声屏蔽 | 其它 AI 工具/DSH 自己的会话目录按规则默认隐藏，标题栏「已屏蔽 N 项」可临时显示 |
| 可回滚 | 卸载插件即恢复官方原生选择器 |

## 它接管了什么

DSH 的「选目录」是一个 single 槽位（`sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow` 与
`conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow`），官方 `directory-picker-auto` 在
Windows + 127.0.0.1 下解析到系统对话框并占用该槽位。本插件的 `cordis.patch.yml`
在 profile 组合里：

```yaml
- id: directory-picker
  disabled: true          # 让出 single 槽位
- insert:
    - id: dsh-everything-search
      name: dsh-everything-search
```

所以卸载/禁用本插件即自动回到官方原生选择器，无需其它清理。

## 依赖准备：获取 `es.exe`（必需）

搜索这一半要用 voidtools 官方的命令行 `es.exe`。它属于 Everything 本体之外的**单独下载**，
且是第三方免费软件，**本仓库不内置**（请自行下载，遵守 voidtools 的许可）：

1. 打开 <https://www.voidtools.com/downloads/>，下载 **Everything Command-line Interface**（`ES-1.1.0.38.x64.zip` 或更新版本）。
2. 解压出 `es.exe`，放到本插件的 `bin/es.exe`（`bin/` 目录已在 `.gitignore` 里）。
3. 确保 Everything 本体在运行（服务 + 用户实例）。

查找顺序（`src/index.js` 里实现，任一可用即可）：

```
环境变量 DSH_EVERYTHING_ES → <插件目录>\bin\es.exe → %ProgramFiles%\Everything\es.exe → PATH 里的 es.exe
```

所以如果你机器上装了 Everything，也可以直接把 `es.exe` 放进它的安装目录。

## 安装（desktop profile）

App 内「插件」页从路径安装，或手工三步：

1. `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`
   - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-everything-search": "link:<本仓库在本机的绝对路径>"`
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾追加 `"dsh-everything-search"`
2. `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-everything-search` → 指向本仓库目录的符号链接。
3. 重启 DSH 桌面版（profile 只在启动时组合）。

> CLI 无法安装 desktop profile（`dsh plugin --profile desktop` 会被明确拒绝：
> "profile desktop is managed exclusively by the Electron application"）。
>
> 客户端改动（`src/client.js`）会被 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr` 自动热重载；
> 宿主端改动（`src/index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、profile 组合）需要重启 DSH。

## 回滚

```powershell
$p = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
Copy-Item "$p\package.json.bak-dsh-everything-search" "$p\package.json" -Force
Copy-Item "$p\cordis.patch.yml.bak-dsh-everything-search" "$p\cordis.patch.yml" -Force
Remove-Item "$p\node_modules\dsh-everything-search" -Force
# 重启 DSH
```

## 配置

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `bin/es.exe` | Everything 命令行（自己放，本仓库不内置；见上节）。也可用环境变量 `DSH_EVERYTHING_ES` 指向别处，或放进 `%ProgramFiles%\Everything\es.exe` |
| Everything 本体 | 需在运行（服务 + 用户实例）。未运行时搜索报 `everything-not-running`，界面提示但浏览照常 |
| 索引范围 | Everything 只索引 NTFS 固定卷；网络盘/U 盘请手动浏览或粘贴路径 |

## 宿主端 RPC

`POST /api/dsh-everything-search.<endpoint>`（信封协议与 DSH 客户端 RPC 一致，
也接受裸 JSON）：

| 端点 | 入参 | 返回 |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | — | `es.exe` / Everything 版本与可用性 |
| `hello` | 浏览器半自报 | 加载自证（写 `events.jsonl`） |
| `noise` | — | 噪声规则（客户端据此保持与宿主一致） |
| `places` | — | 主目录 + 桌面/下载/文档/图片/音乐/视频（存在才返回） |
| `drives` | — | 盘符列表（含 total/free） |
| `list` | `{ path }` | 子文件夹（隐藏/屏蔽标记、父目录、是否盘符根） |
| `mkdir` | `{ parent, name }` | 新建文件夹并返回路径 |
| `rename` | `{ path, name }` | 同目录改名并返回新路径 |
| `search` | `{ query, limit }` | `[{ name, path, full, blocked? }]`，`/ad` 只要文件夹 |

## 自检

```powershell
node --check src/index.js; node --check src/client.js
node --test test/plugin.test.mjs test/render.test.mjs   # 24 项：宿主纯函数 + es.exe 链路 + bundle 注册协议 + 真实 React 渲染
node tools/probe.mjs 项目                                # 真机链路：status/places/drives/list/search
node tools/verify-composition.mjs                        # 用 DSH 自己的 patch 引擎验证组合语义
```

## 端到端验证（真实 DSH 运行时 + 真实浏览器）

用**隔离 DSH_HOME + 隔离 profile** 起一份 DSH 实例，完全不碰用户正在用的 App 与 `~/.dsh` 状态：

```powershell
$edsHome = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'eds-verify-home'      # 独立 home：workspace.json / sessions 全隔离
# 建 profile：$edsHome\profiles\eds-verify\{package.json,cordis.yml} + node_modules 软链到本插件
# bundle 列表：@deepseek-ai/dsh-base, @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app, dsh-everything-search

$env:DSH_HOME = $edsHome
node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts --profile eds-verify --port 3100 --no-open
```

然后：

```powershell
# A. 组合与接口：引导图含本插件、原生选择器已消失、bundle 可服务、RPC 全通（12 项）
node tools/verify-instance.mjs --url "http://127.0.0.1:3100/?token=<token>"

# B. 真浏览器点击（Chrome CDP），场景可任选：
#    1 侧栏 + → 本插件对话框 → 盘符逐级浏览 → Everything 搜索
#    2 对话空态 hero 槽位（conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow）→ 同一对话框
#    3 确认建工作区 → 侧栏出现新工作区
#    4 噪声过滤 / 搜索双击进入 / 最近使用折叠 / 最多 5 条
#    5 噪声屏蔽计数 + 「已屏蔽 N 项」开关
#    6 F2 重命名（行内编辑、Esc 取消不关窗、回车提交并落到改名后的项）
#    7 选中优先：单击选中 → 右下角按钮选中的就是它；点空白处回到当前目录
node tools/ui-check.mjs --url "http://127.0.0.1:3100/?token=<token>" --scenarios 1,3,4,5,6,7 --create-target "E:\tmp"
```

最近一次结果：`verify-instance` **12/12**、`ui-check` 全场景 **37/37**、单测 **24/24**。

README 顶部那三张演示图由下面的脚本在**干净实例 + 演示目录**上生成（不含个人路径）：

```powershell
node tools/make-screenshots.mjs --url "http://127.0.0.1:3100/?token=<token>"
```

清理：停掉实例进程、删掉 `$env:TEMP\eds-verify-home` 即可（与 `~/.dsh` 无关）。

## 加载自证（不依赖 token 的验收钩子）

宿主半与浏览器半加载时各写一条 JSONL 到插件数据目录：

```
<dsh home>/plugins/dsh-everything-search/events.jsonl
{"time":"…","event":"host-loaded","pid":…,"version":"0.1.0","platform":"win32","home":"…"}
{"time":"…","event":"client-loaded","pid":…,"version":"0.1.0","userAgent":"…","href":"http://127.0.0.1:19387/","slots":"sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow,conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow"}
```

所以「某个 DSH 实例有没有真正加载本插件」可以直接看文件确认，不必拿它的访问 token：

```powershell
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-everything-search\events.jsonl"
# 桌面版重启后应看到一条 host-loaded（App 宿主进程 pid）+ 一条 client-loaded（href 指向 19387）
```

`hello` 端点就是这个自报通道（`POST /api/dsh-everything-search.hello`），也可用于排障。

## 回滚验证（也实测过）

回滚 = 把插件从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里去掉（或整段还原 `package.json`/`cordis.patch.yml` 备份）+ 重启。在隔离实例上实测：

```powershell
node tools/verify-instance.mjs --url "http://127.0.0.1:3100/?token=<token>" --expect rollback
# PASS 回滚后：引导图不再包含本插件
# PASS 回滚后：官方原生选择器回来了   ← directory-picker-native 重新出现在客户端条目图里
# PASS 回滚后：本插件 RPC 路由已消失   ← /api/dsh-everything-search.* → 404
# 7/7 通过
```

即：卸载后 Windows 原生「选择文件夹」自动恢复，无需其它清理。

## 桌面版实测（2026-10-05）

桌面版重启后已确认接管，证据链：

- `~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-everything-search/events.jsonl`：`host-loaded`（App 宿主 pid，home 为真实 `~/.dsh`）+ `client-loaded`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop/0.2.0-rc.2 … Electron/44.0.0`，`href: dsh-app://app/`，两个槽位名）。
- 用户实际点击「+」弹出的即本插件对话框。

### 热重载行为（改代码时有用）

- **客户端半**（`src/client.js`）：桌面版挂了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr`，它每 500 ms stat-poll 已服务的 bundle，文件一改就自动重载——实测改完 client.js 后 App 在同一秒写出新的 `client-loaded`，**不需要重启**。
- **宿主半**（`src/index.js` / `cordis.patch.yml` / profile 组合）：**需要重启 DSH** 才会重新组合。

### 修过的一个视觉瑕疵

症状：输入字符的瞬间，对话框右上出现一条竖直长条。

原因：搜索中的 12px 转圈 `<span class="edsSpin">` 是 `.edsSearchRow` 的直接子元素，被一条过宽的 `.edsSearchRow > span { flex: 1 }` 横向拉成整行宽的椭圆；`border-radius: 50%` + 旋转动画到竖直那一帧就成了一条长条。

修法：删掉该转圈（搜索状态由列表里的「正在搜索…」表达），并把撑满整行的规则收窄到专用类 `.edsSearchField` / `.edsCreateField`。回归检查已进自动化：

```powershell
node tools/ui-check.mjs --url "…" --scenarios 1
# PASS 场景1：输入瞬间没有被拉伸的元素（长条特效回归）
```

### 修过的第二个视觉瑕疵：footer 贴住卡片边缘

症状：底部「取消 / 选择此文件夹」下方没有留白，卡片那条底线与按钮相切。

原因：我在 `.edsDialog` 里写了 `padding: 0`，把 Modal 卡片默认的 `padding: 0 0 24px`（底部 24px 留白）清零了。

修法：改回 `padding: 0 0 20px`，并给 `.edsFooter` 加 `padding-top: 12px` 理开列表与按钮的间距。回归检查同样进了自动化：

```powershell
# PASS 场景1：footer 与卡片边缘留有白边且不越出视口
#   — {"cardW":760,"cardH":596,"minBottomGap":20,"minRightGap":24,"fitsViewport":true}
```

> 教训（两次都踩同一类坑）：`.edsDialog` 里的 CSS 是写在 JS 模板字符串中的，
> 注释里**不能出现反引号**，否则会提前截断模板字符串导致整个 bundle 抛错；
> 另外不要用「父容器 > 标签」这种宽选择器做布局，它会把行内其它同类元素一起拉变形。

## 交互约定（v0.1.0 起）

- **进入下一级**：双击行，或在选中行上按回车（搜索态与浏览态一致）。
- **选定工作区（选中优先）**：单击某行选中它 → 右下角「选择此文件夹」选中的**就是这一行**；
  底部会显示「已选：<完整路径>」。

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

# dsh-smart-proxy

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

> 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供可切换的代理模式、连通性自检和 SSE 超时保护，专治 `Transport Failed` 与 TLS 证书拦截。

## 解决什么问题

国内网络环境下，DSH 桌面版经常出现以下症状：

- 对话请求报 `Transport Failed`，但浏览器/curl 访问同一域名正常；
- 公司网络或杀毒软件做 HTTPS 中间人，导致 TLS 证书校验失败；
- 深度思考模型流式输出中途断连，前功尽弃。

本插件把「代理选择 → 连通性验证 → 长连接保活」串成一条链路，并把当前网络状态暴露成 Agent 工具，出问题时能直接问出来。

## 功能

- **三种代理模式**：`system`（跟随系统） / `manual`（手动指定） / `direct`（强制直连）
- **启动自检**：启动时探测 DeepSeek API 连通性，失败时在日志中给出明确原因
- **超时保护**：单独放大 SSE 流式超时（默认 10 分钟），避免长回答被截断
- **热重载**：修改配置后即时生效，无需重启 DSH
- **诊断工具**：在对话中调用 `smart-proxy.status` / `smart-proxy.switch-mode`

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-smart-proxy       # Web / 插件中心
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-smart-proxy   # 桌面版
```

安装后重启 `dsh web`，在「设置 → 插件」中确认 `smart-proxy` 已启用。

本地开发时也可以直接从目录安装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Jack-jiang421/dsh-smart-proxy.git
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-smart-proxy
```

## 配置

在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖 `smart-proxy` 的配置：

```yaml
- id: smart-proxy
  config:
    mode: manual
    proxyUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:7890"
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `string` | `system` | 代理模式：`system` / `manual` / `direct` |
| `proxyUrl` | `string` | `http://127.0.0.1:7890` | `manual` 模式使用的代理地址 |
| `streamTimeout` | `number` | `600000` | SSE 流式超时（毫秒） |
| `connectTimeout` | `number` | `30000` | TCP 连接超时（毫秒） |
| `keepAlive` | `boolean` | `true` | 启用 TCP Keep-Alive |
| `retryOnTransportError` | `boolean` | `true` | 传输层错误自动重试 |
| `maxRetries` | `number` | `3` | 最大重试次数 |
| `ignoreTlsErrors` | `boolean` | `false` | 忽略 TLS 证书错误（仅在自签/中间人环境开启） |
| `bypassDomains` | `string[]` | `["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"]` | 不走代理的域名 |
| `autoTest` | `boolean` | `true` | 启动时自动测试连通性 |

> `ignoreTlsErrors` 会降低安全性，只在明确知道证书被拦截时临时开启。

## 在对话中使用

插件注册了三个 Agent 工具，直接用自然语言触发即可：

| 说法 | 工具 |
| --- | --- |
| 「看一下当前代理状态，顺便测下连通性」 | `smart-proxy.status` |
| 「切换到直连模式」 | `smart-proxy.switch-mode` |

`status` 返回当前模式、代理地址、TLS 豁免状态、连通性结果与延迟；`switch-mode` 支持 `direct` / `manual` / `system`，可同时传入新的 `proxyUrl`。

## 排查 Transport Failed

1. 先把 `mode` 改为 `direct`，确认问题是否由代理引起；
2. 核对 `proxyUrl` 端口与本机代理软件一致（Clash 常见 7890，V2Ray 常见 10809）；
3. 在代理规则里把 `api.deepseek.com` 设为 `DIRECT`，排除规则误判；
4. 临时关闭杀毒软件的 HTTPS 流量扫描（卡巴斯基、火绒等）；
5. 日志中搜索 `[dsh-smart-proxy]` 获取完整诊断。

## 兼容性

- DSH `>=0.2.0`（`engines.dsh`）
- Cordis `^4.0.1`

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Short model-generated recap under every completed turn in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, plus an on-demand /recap command.
plugins.readme_text: # Turn Recap for DSH A persistent [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that writes a short, model-generated recap under every completed turn in the Web UI — and regenerates one on demand with `/recap`. English | [中文](README.zh.md) ## What it does - **After a turn the session goes quiet** a card appears at the end of that turn: one to three sentences saying what the turn accomplished and, only when it matters, what is still unfinished. The card waits out a quiet window (two minutes by default) and never appears for a turn you kept working past — it is a "where did I leave off" card, not a second summary of a reply you are still reading. The text follows the conversation's language. - **`/recap`** produces the same card for the latest turn on demand, immediately — useful when a turn never got its quiet window, when you scrolled past it, or when you want a fresh read of where things stand. - Turns that carry nothing to summarize (interrupted or failed turns, empty turns) produce no card, and subagent sessions are skipped by default. - When the turn leaves exactly one real next action — an unanswered question, an agreed next step, or a remedy for a blocker — the card adds a single **Next step** line under the summary. Turns that finished cleanly get no such line. The card uses the host's theme tokens, so it follows light/dark and the active locale (English and Simplified Chinese dictionaries ship with the bundle). ## Requirements - **DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`** — the runtime this plugin was built and verified against. `package.json` declares that floor as `engines.dsh`, and the launcher enforces it twice: when the bundle is installed, and again when a profile holding it starts. An older runtime refuses the operation with `incompatible-version` and names the unmet range. - Check which runtime a profile will use with `dsh --version`. - The floor is the API set this plugin binds, not a guess: `agent/turn-stopping`, session projections with a client-visible `wire` view, the `commands` registry (including `command/done` result text), `llm.prepareCall()` streaming, and on the Client side the `conversation.chat.turnTail` and `conversation.chat.commandview` slots plus `remote.session.projections`. A nearby version that provides all of them will almost certainly work, but only the declared floor is the combination tested here. No `peerDependencies` are declared on purpose: this bundle imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` module — it only resolves Cordis services at runtime — so a peer range would describe a dependency that does not exist. If you must run it on an older runtime, the launcher's escape hatch is an exact-version exemption, never a range: ```bash dsh plugin --profile allow-version '@local/dsh-turn-recap@1.0.1' --dsh-version '' --accept-risk ``` The same grant is available in Plugin Manager. It authorizes in-process code against a runtime it was never verified with — crashes and data loss are the documented risk — and it applies to one exact plugin version on one exact runtime version. ## Install This package is a DSH bundle: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and a `dsh.client` half, so it installs into a profile with the launcher's own plugin command. Nothing is published to npm. ```bash # newest commit on the default branch dsh plugin add github:littepointR/dsh-turn-recap # or pin the tagged release dsh plugin add github:littepointR/dsh-turn-recap#v1.0.1 ``` `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and selects the bundle when the install finishes. With HMR enabled in the profile's YAML the composition reloads immediately; otherwise the profile picks it up on the next start. Install into a named profile by passing it through: ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:littepointR/dsh-turn-recap ``` The bundle patch adds one Loader row: ```yaml - insert: - id: turn-recap name: '@local/dsh-turn-recap' ``` ### From a checkout ```bash git clone https://github.com/littepointR/dsh-turn-recap.git dsh plugin --profile add link:D:/path/to/dsh-turn-recap ``` Or ask a DSH session to install the bundle from that directory with the profile's plugin manager. Reinstalling or toggling the plugin needs no Harness restart: disable and re-enable the row and the Host module is imported again. ## Configuration Every key is optional. Add a `config` block to the Loader row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — that layer survives package upgrades. | Key | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | `false` unregisters the projection, the turn listener, and `/recap` | | `maxTokens` | `200` | Output budget of the recap request | | `temperature` | `0.2` | Sampling temperature | | `timeoutMs` | `12000` | Hard bound on one recap request, in milliseconds | | `digestChars` | `6000` | Size bound of the turn digest sent to the model | | `idleMs` | `120000` | Quiet window a finished turn must hold before its card may appear; `0` shows it immediately | | `skipSubagents` | `true` | Subagent sessions get no automatic recap | | `provider`, `model` | unset | Explicit route; by default the turn's own request route is reused | ```yaml - insert: - id: turn-recap name: '@local/dsh-turn-recap' config: maxTokens: 300 skipSubagents: false ``` ## How it works ``` agent/turn-stopping ──▶ digest the turn ──▶ model call ──▶ pending map │ turn/end (committed) ──▶ projection apply ──▶ recap projection ──▶ useProjection("recap") │ conversation.chat.turnTail ``` 1. **`agent/turn-stopping`** is the serial event the agent loop dispatches just before it commits `turn/end`. The plugin digests the turn from the session log — the user request, the newest tool calls (with failures marked), and the turn's *final* assistant reply — and asks the model that served the turn for a short recap. 2. The following **`turn/end`** commit folds the text into the client-visible **`recap` session projection**, so the card and the finished turn arrive in the same frame. 3. The Client half registers into the **`conversation.chat.turnTail`** slot and reads the projection with `useProjection("recap")`. Each entry carries a `revealAt` deadline: the card is held back until that instant passes **and** no newer turn has started, so the quiet window costs nothing and the card never interrupts active work. **What the model is asked for.** One plain-text prompt: one to three sentences in the conversation's language, precise about how far the work actually got (`proposed`, `queued`, `implemented`, `tested`, `published`, and `installed` are different states), keeping unresolved caveats such as "not installed yet", and treating the latest user message as scope rather than proof that the work is done. A real next action — and only a real one — rides in on a final `Next:` line, which the Host parses into its own field so the card can label and style it. **Why a projection instead of a session event?** A plugin may not append new event types: a log carrying a type the build does not know cannot be reopened, and `appendPluginRecord()` is reserved for first-party experimental packages. The session projection is the supported carrier for session-derived client state. **Why is the recap produced before `turn/end`?** Projection state is folded synchronously from committed events and its Value is only re-read when a committed event changes that state. Producing the text while the turn boundary is still open is what lets the commitment bake it into state — the delayed *appearance* is a client-side rule over the stored `revealAt`, not a delayed request. **`/recap`** is a plain DSH command: it runs outside any turn, and its result travels in `command/done`. The Client half claims the command row through the `conversation.chat.commandview` slot under the `recap` key and renders the runn

plugins.description: Rich, interactive UI cards inside DeepSeek Harness chats — Paper Glass style, streaming, persistent turn cards.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Intelligent UI

Answers as interfaces.
Turn DeepSeek Harness chat replies into Paper Glass cards you can read, click, and submit.

快速开始 · 能力 · 截图 · 组件 · 架构 · 验收

![DSH Intelligent UI](docs/screenshots/hero.jpg) DSH Intelligent UI 是一个 **DeepSeek Harness 插件**：模型在回答时调用 `render_ui`，把行程、对比、表单、数据、清单、多步计划等内容直接渲染成对话里的卡片。界面**留在当前回合**，可以点、可以填、可以折叠，不再是“一段文字 + 一串附件链接”。 > 视觉不是官方 OpenUI 的复刻，而是工作区自己的 **纸上玻璃 / Paper Glass v1.0**：结构色跟随宿主主题，玻璃只用于控制层，渐变只用于材质与强调，数字等宽，字号和圆角不自由发挥。 --- ## 它能做什么 | | | | --- | --- | | **看得见的结构** | 表格、图表、时间线、步骤条、进度条、地图、画廊、统计卡，而不是长段落。 | | **点得动的下一步** | 按钮、快捷建议、页签、折叠面板、表单提交；没有下一步时不造假按钮。 | | **活在对话里** | `turnTail` 持久卡片：回合结束后界面仍留在对话里，不折叠进“工具过程组”。 | | **边生成边出现** | 工具三阶段 `preparing / start / result`，结构先出、数据后填。 | | **可复现** | 唯一事实源是 Session 日志里的工具参数；重放 / fork 用同一份 `ui` 重建。 | | **安全边界** | 只解析、不执行代码；白名单组件；URL 只允许 `http(s)`；不写业务数据、不调模型、不读本机文件。 | --- ## 截图
行程 / 地图 / 时间线 / 交通对比 / 可点的调整建议 方案对比 / 表格 / 状态标签 / 选择项
步骤条 / 进度 / 折叠面板 / 快捷建议 多行输入 / 单选 / 开关 / 提交回传
更多：`docs/screenshots/data.jpg`（指标与趋势图）、`docs/screenshots/gallery.jpg`（图片画廊）。 --- ## 快速开始 ### 环境 - DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** 或更高的 `0.2.x` - Node.js **20+** - pnpm（与你的 DSH profile 使用同一套） ### 安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/simmon-clap/dsh-intelligent-ui.git cd dsh-intelligent-ui # 可选：先跑一遍构建与测试 npm test # 安装到 desktop profile（不执行安装脚本） pnpm --dir ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop add --ignore-scripts "file:$PWD" ``` 如果不想直接引用工作目录： ```bash npm pack pnpm --dir ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop add --ignore-scripts "file:$PWD/dsh-intelligent-ui-0.2.0.tgz" ``` 打开 DSH 的 **插件 → 已安装插件**，找到「生成式界面」并打开开关；新开会话即可。 ### 试一句 ```text 帮我规划旧金山一日游：上午渔人码头，中午金门大桥，下午艺术宫。 ``` 模型会优先用 `render_ui` 出卡片；也可以明确说“用界面给我看 / 做成可点的卡片”。 --- ## 输出语言 模型只写**一行一条**的声明式界面源码，不写 HTML / JS / JSON / Markdown： ```text root = Stack([标题, 关键数字, 时间线, 建议]) 标题 = Heading({text: '旧金山一日游', level: 1}) 关键数字 = Row([ 景点数量, 在途时间 ]) 景点数量 = Stat({label: '主要景点', value: '3 处', hint: '都在北岸'}) 在途时间 = Stat({label: '在途', value: '约 30 分钟', hint: '打车为主'}) 时间线 = Timeline({title: '怎么走', items: [ {time: '09:00', title: '渔人码头', detail: 'Pier 39 看海狮'}, {time: '12:45', title: '金门大桥', detail: '桥面走一小段'} ]}) 建议 = Chips({title: '要不要调整？', items: [ {label: '更轻松', prompt: '把行程改轻松一点'}, {label: '换公共交通', prompt: '改成公共交通版本'} ]}) ``` - 入口必须叫 `root`；引用可以先用后写（前向引用）。 - 每次回答最多调用 **1 次** `render_ui`；默认硬约束 **200 个组件 / 32,000 字符**。 - 交互只有两类动作：`send`（把文本作为用户消息发回会话）与 `open`（新窗口打开 `http(s)`）。 --- ## 组件 当前 **24 个白名单组件**，越界会显示“未渲染：未知组件”，不会猜、不会执行。 | 组 | 组件 | | --- | --- | | 布局 | `Stack` `Row` `Card` `Divider` | | 文本 | `Heading` `Text` `Callout` `Badge` `Code` | | 数据 | `Stat` `Table` `Chart` `Timeline` `List` `Steps` `Progress` | | 媒体 | `Image` `Gallery` `Map` | | 交互 | `Tabs` `Accordion` `Form` `Buttons` `Chips` | `Chart` 支持 `bar / line / area / pie`；`Form` 支持 `text / textarea / number / date / select / radio / checkbox / switch / slider`。完整签名、参数上限和使用建议见 [`docs/COMPONENTS.md`](docs/COMPONENTS.md)。 --- ## 架构 ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Agent] -->|render_ui ui| B[Host tool] B --> C[(Session log)] B --> D[Client toolview] C --> E[turnTail persistent card] D --> F[DSL parser + whitelist] E --> F F --> G[Paper Glass renderer] G --> H[Chat] ``` - **Host 半**：注册 `render_ui` 工具与系统提示；只做解析、白名单校验、规模限制，不调模型、不写文件。 - **Client 半**：把 `tool.call.toolview` 的 `render_ui` 调用渲染成流式界面；同时通过 `conversation.chat.turnTail` 把界面留在回合尾部。 - **唯一事实源**：`ui` 源码随工具参数进入 Session 日志；插件不另存业务数据、不缓存渲染结果。 - **视觉**：所有结构色来自宿主 `--dsw-alias-*`；Paper Glass 的玻璃/渐变只由 token 派生，组件不写死颜色。 更完整的契约、slot 与可复现说明见 [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。 --- ## 验收 | 项 | 结果 | | --- | --- | | 机械门禁 | `node --test test/*.test.mjs` → **48 / 48** | | 真实对话场景 | **10 / 10 通过**（行程、对比、表单、数据、清单、多步、步骤+进度+折叠、富表单、画廊、摘要） | | 真实实例 | DSH GUI 1440，桌面端；卡片可见、可点、可提交 | | 视觉门禁 | 抽出渲染器 CSS 跑 `paper-glass/gates.mjs --strict` → **0 错误** | | 构建确定性 | 两次构建字节一致；产物 sha256 入账 | ```bash npm test # 或 node build.mjs node --test test/*.test.mjs ``` --- ## 边界 - **PC 优先**：当前验收目标是 DSH 桌面 Web GUI；手机端暂不纳入本轮。 - **不执行代码**：没有 `eval` / `new Function` / `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` / `iframe`；不加载远程脚本、样式、字体。 - **不写数据**：界面动作只有 `send` / `open`；不能直接改业务对象、不能调用其他工具、不能发网络请求（除用户点击外链）。 - **不编数**：界面里的事实必须来自工具结果或当前对话；无来源写“未知 / 待确认”。 - **不做 OpenUI 86 组件全量对齐**：视觉以 Paper Glass 为准；OpenUI 只作为组件/行为参考。 - DeepSeek Harness 仍是 developer preview；升级宿主前先跑本仓库测试与真实实例验收。 --- ## 仓库结构 ```text ├─ src/ # Host 工具、提示词、DSL 解析、渲染器、样式 ├─ client/client.js # 构建产物：单文件 Client 动态包（不要手改） ├─ test/ # 48 项 Node 测试 ├─ docs/ │ ├─ screenshots/ # README 截图 │ ├─ COMPONENTS.md │ └─ ARCHITECTURE.md ├─ build.mjs # 确定性拼接构建 ├─ cordis.patch.yml └─ package.json ``` ## 开发 ```bash node build.mjs # 重建 client/client.js node --test test/*.test.mjs # 48 项测试 ``` 提交前请确认： 1. `node build.mjs` 后 `client/client.js` 与源码同步； 2. 48 项测试全绿； 3. 新增/修改组件时同步 `src/catalog.mjs`、提示词、渲染器和测试； 4. 视觉改动按 Paper Glass v1.0 的 token / 字阶 / 玻璃 / 渐变规则走。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chatterbox（话匣子）

往系统提示里注入一段**常驻互动协议**的 DSH 插件：让「话少、爱自己扛、爱反复自查」的模型回到
**边说边做**的默认节奏。

- **边做边说**：动手前先说要做什么，做完一小段就聊两句，不把话攒到最后。
- **卡住了就开口**：需要人类的东西直接说；换目标、缩范围、弱化结论，都是他的决定，不必一个人扛。
- **把提问讲清楚**：默认在对话里问，先给背景和推荐；只有「挑一个」本身替人省力时才给选项。
- **验证有预算**：一次独立核查通常就够，把「已核对 / 待核对 / 已知风险」分开写。
- **说人话**：中文、短句、先说事实再给判断。

**默认对所有模型生效**（`modelPattern: ''` = 普适模式）；**陪伴模式默认不注入**（`skipPresets`）。

插件的语言刻意是**邀请式**的，不是纠错式：协议里不出现「失误」「悄悄」「废话」这类把人当小孩的词
（`node --test` 里有一条用例专门守这件事）。要求模型「说人话、别表演」，它自己先得是那个语气。

```
安装（本地目录）：plugin_manager action: install_bundle  target: "C:\Users\29411\dsh\插件\dsh-chatterbox"
安装（npm）：     dsh-chatterbox
安装（Release）： https://github.com/Astepluver/dsh-chatterbox/releases/latest/download/dsh-chatterbox.tgz
```

---

## 它解决什么（诊断结论，不是猜测）

「新模型话变少了、爱自己扛、爱反复自查」这三个现象，在本机逐条查过：

| 事实 | 证据 |
|---|---|
| 宿主里**没有任何**按 model id 分支的提示词、工具或 loop 逻辑 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent/lib/index.js` 的 `system-prompt/assemble` 监听器只把 `provider`/`model` 当**变量**塞进装配结果，没有 `if (model === …)` |
| 两份 shipped 预设的人设逐字相同 | `dsh-web-app/presets/{standard,ptc}.patch.yml:14` 都是 `You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.` |
| 「1017」是**界面徽章**，不是 model id | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deepseek-model-label-1017`：`lib/client.js` 只在 `provider ∈ {deepseek-account, deepseek-official} && model.id === 'deepseek-flash' && model.name === 'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash'` 时加徽章；它的 host 半边是空的 `function apply() {}`。整个 `app.asar`（1.8 亿字节）字节扫描 `flash-1017` 命中 **0** |
| 本机两条 DeepSeek 路由的 model id | 官方 `deepseek-account/deepseek-flash`（界面挂 1017 徽章的那条）与网关 `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`——**都不含 1017** |
| shipped 提示词里**没有一条**要求「工具调用之间叙述进展」 | 全仓最接近的只有 `dsh-tool-todo/lib/index.js:21` 的 `… to plan multi-step work and show progress` |

结论：没有一条现成文本把「边做边说」拉住，模型自己的默认脾气一变，行为就直接变了；
而把白名单钉在发布日期上（`1017`）必然过时。所以默认人人有份，`modelPattern` 只留作**排除**某个模型的旋钮。

另外，「反复自查」有一部分来自**用户自己的预设**而不是模型：本 profile 的「分析模式」人设
（`profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）写着「反复检验分析过程」「能对拍就必须对拍」
「报告之前回头对一遍」。本插件**不动别人的预设**，只是把「验证要有预算」放回系统提示，让两种力量互相平衡。

## 机制

```
apply(ctx, config)
  └─ ctx.effect(() => ctx.systemPrompt.section({
        name: 'plugin:chatterbox',      // 全局唯一
        order: 720,                      // dsh-methodology 700 · PTC_ONLY 800
        interpolate: false,              // 关键：见下
        text: (context) => sectionText(...)   // 每个模型步骤前重新求值
     }))
```

- **`interpolate: false` 是必需的**：`section` 默认会做 `{{变量}}` 插值，宿主在渲染期严格解析，
  未知/畸形引用**直接 throw**；那个 throw 发生在 agent-loop 的 `renderPrompt()` 里，
  插件的 try/catch 拦不到，会让**每一轮根会话**以 error 收尾（2026-10-17 实测复现）。
  关掉之后，`extra` 里写 `{{` 也只是字面量。
- 段落文本为空串时宿主直接丢掉这一段（关掉分条不会留下空壳）。
- 每次 `assemble()` 重新求值（在 `agent/pre-step`、`agent/request` 之前），按会话/preset/模型逐步生效。
- 与 `dsh-methodology` 用同一个注册点、同一种零依赖写法（裸 config，不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，
  也不导出 `Config`），order 排在其后，两者不冲突。
- **所有异常路径都兜底**：段落求值、模型读取、诊断写入都不可能影响 prompt 装配；
  求值真的失败时会在诊断文件里留一条 `kind: "error"`，而不是静默消失。

## 配置（在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的插件行里覆盖）

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；false 时不注册任何东西 |
| `order` | `720` | 段落排序值 |
| `modelPattern` | `''` | **空 = 所有模型**；填子串（如 `deepseek`）或 `/正则/` 即收窄 |
| `matchProvider` | `true` | 收窄时是否连 provider 一起匹配（`provider/model` 整体） |
| `whenModelUnknown` | `'apply'` | 收窄时拿不到模型身份的兜底 |
| `scope` | `'root'` | `root` 只给根会话；`all` 连子代理一起给 |
| `skipPresets` | `['companion']` | 这些 preset 不注入（按会话 header 的 `agentPreset` 精确匹配），比 `scope` 更强 |
| `narrate` / `askInConversation` / `questionBox` / `verificationBudget` / `plainSpeech` | `true` | 五条分条的开关 |
| `extra` | `''` | 追加到协议末尾的文本（字面量注入，不插值） |
| `reassertAfterSilentSteps` | `6` | **连续多少步没出一句文字就重申一次**（0 = 关）。长会话对抗稀释的主力 |
| `reassertOnCompaction` | `true` | 每次压缩之后重申一次 |
| `reassertEveryTurns` | `0` | 另外按轮重申：每 N 轮一次（0 = 关；默认关，上面那条更准） |
| `reminder` | 见 `cordis.patch.yml` | 重申文本（两三行，落在历史末尾） |
| `diagnostics` | `true` | 每次求值记一行 JSON |
| `diagnosticsPath` | `''` | 留空 = 插件目录下 `.state/diagnostics.jsonl`（相对路径按进程 cwd 解析） |
| `diagnosticsMaxLines` | `500` | 超过就丢掉前一半；硬上限 5000 |

模型身份按三来源取，先拿到先用：**assemble 瀑布观测到的 `provider`/`model` → `agent.options`
→ `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`**。普适模式下完全不查模型身份。

## 长会话里为什么会「变淡」，以及重申

朋友反馈「聊久了 chatterbox 就失效，模型重新变沉默」。逐条查过，结论分两半：

**一、不是提示词没送到。** 循环自己的投影函数保证「线上最新一条非空 system 消息 = 当前渲染出来的
提示词」：提示词与线上不一致时，要么原地重写 node 0，要么追加一条新的
（`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:264-282`；压缩的范围永远从 index ≥ 1 开始，`node 0` 不受遮蔽）。
唯一能挡住已注册段落的机制是 `complete: true` 段（`dsh-system-prompt` 收尾只保留那一段），
本机没有任何插件用它。而且 in-history 路由的真实故障模式是**抛错**（`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`），
不是变冷淡。⇒ 「压缩把段落吞掉了」这个解释被证伪。

**二、是模型侧遵守度在衰减。** 本机实测同一台机器上两条装了本插件的会话，助手「带文字」的比例：

```
消息区间    带文字比例
   1- 20        80%
  21- 40        50%
  41- 60        75%
  61- 80        40%
  81-100        35%
 101-120        50%
 121-140        45%
 141-160        65%
 161-180        15%   ← 长取证过程
 181-189        11%
```

关键细节：掉到 11% 的那一整段沉默发生在**同一个 user turn 里**（约 60 步）。所以修法不是
「每 N 轮再说一遍」（那一轮里一次都不会触发），而是**按「连续多少步没说话」触发**：
`reassertAfterSilentSteps`。触发时插件会把一行极短的提醒，作为 runtime-context 快照
**追加到历史末尾**——也就是离模型最近的位置。

代价：每条重申约 110 字；模型只要正常说话就不会触发。

## 怎么确认它真的生效

看诊断文件（默认 `<插件目录>/.state/diagnostics.jsonl`），每次求值一行。**本机实测**：

```json
{"time":"…","kind":"section","sessionId":"session-4aa0a2f4-…","origin":null,"model":"deepseek-flash","provider":"deepseek-account","apply":true,"reason":"no-pattern（普适模式）"}
{"time":"…","kind":"section","sessionId":"e14f9dcf-…","origin":"subagent","model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash","provider":"opencode-go","apply":false,"reason":"scope=root 且本会话是子代理"}
{"time":"…","kind":"reassert","sessionId":"session-…","count":1,"trigger":"silent:6"}
{"time":"…","kind":"prompt-missing","sessionId":"session-…","seq":699,"len":10414,"turns":4}
```

- `kind:"section"`：装配层拿到（或没拿到）文本，附理由。
- `kind:"reassert"`：重申了一次，`trigger` 是 `silent:N` / `compaction` / `turns:N`。
- `kind:"prompt-missing"`：**某个系统提示里没有本段落**。这是「模型没看到」与
  「模型看到了但不照做」唯一客观的分界——朋友那边再出现变淡时，先看有没有这一行。

更强的证据：真实会话日志里，根会话那一步的 system message 依次是
identity(0) → persona(50) → methodology(1969) → **chatterbox(3133)** → sci-viz(750)——
段落确实进了模型看到的内容，不是「注册了但没生效」。

## 已验证 / 未验证

**已验证**：`node --test` 23 例全绿（门控/语气/诊断/异常路径，含「纠错腔词表」、
「注册必须带 `interpolate:false`」两条守卫）；`node --check`；安装结果 `application: applied`
且 `Config.listConfigs` 能查到行；`apply: true`/`false` 两条分支在真实会话里各跑出过；
段落文本在真实 prompt 中的位置已核对；`npm pack --dry-run` 产物齐全；
命名声明过 `validate-names.mjs`；`query-registry.mjs` 查过中央索引（未被登记）。

**重申链路已在真机跑通（2026-10-18，0.2.0）**，四段证据闭合：

```
1) 诊断 {"kind":"loaded","reassertAfterSilentSteps":6,…}                  ← 新版被加载
2) 诊断 {"kind":"reassert","count":1,"trigger":"silent:6"}                 ← 连续 6 步没说话触发
3) 会话日志 seq=1670  user/message  source=runtime-context  894 字         ← 提醒被追加到历史末尾
4) 模型侧：那一轮运行时上下文里确实出现了「（提醒 · 互动习惯）」两行提醒      ← 送到了
```

另外用真实事件流回放新代码：748 个装配点、首次重申落在历史里那段沉默的起点。

**未验证**：让模型**更愿意说话**这件事本身。机制（段落 + 重申 + 触发）可证、「模型因此变得更好聊」
不可证。DSH 自带的市场索引校验器在 `app.asar` 内，Node 无法 import，`market/index.json`
是按校验器源码逐条实现 + 本地 `--check` 保持一致，尚未被官方校验器实跑过。

## 已知限制

- **软引导，不是硬约束**：本插件不拦任何工具调用。需要机器强制的地方（例如子代理只读）
  应该用 `ctx.tools.guard` 另写。
- 不改变 `ask_user_question` 的存在：工作区里明确要求用提问框的流程照旧可用。
- 只给根会话（`scope: 'root'`）：子代理与 Agent Teams 队友拿不到（他们对面不是人；
  队友与一次性子代理共用 `origin: 'subagent'`）。想让队友也有，把 `scope` 改成 `'all'`。
- 同一层里段落名必须唯一：把本 bundle 同时挂进 profile 和某个 preset 会**同步抛错**（不是静默覆盖）。
- **token 成本**：默认配置下段落约 1.1k 字（中文），随每次请求常驻，属于系统提示里的稳定前缀。
- 改 `scope` / 开关会让系统提示前缀变化，从而失效一次提示缓存复用。
- 诊断文件只按行数上限截断，不做轮转；每步一次读+写（实测 ~0.3 ms/次）。

## 发布与收录

本机已有一套跑通过的流程（桌面 `插件发布`，dsh-sci-viz 用过），本仓库配套一份同样的工具包：

| 步骤 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 在 GitHub 建 **Public** 仓库 `Astepluver/dsh-chatterbox`（三个勾都不勾） |
| 2 | 把「上传用」文件夹里的东西全选拖进仓库（网页上传，绕开本机 Git 凭据问题） |
| 3 | About → ⚙️ → **Topics 填这 6 个**：`dsh-plugin`、`dsh-plugins`、`dsh-plugin-desktop`、`dsh-desktop`、`dsh-plugin-market`、`deepseek-harness` |
| 4 | 发 **Release**：tag `v0.1.0`，附件名必须正好是 **`dsh-chatterbox.tgz`** |
| 5 | （可选）双击 `❹ 发布到 npm.cmd`，别人就能用一行包名安装 |

**「收录的 tag 要求」就在这里**：第三方采集程序（`插件\dsh-plugin-mesh\backend\dsh_mesh\config.py:42-49`）
只看**两条**——topic 命中白名单，或**仓库名以 `dsh-` 开头**（`build.py:295-299`）；
无 topic 且描述短于 10 字会被丢弃（`build.py:287-289`）。0 星也能收录。

另外有一套**与上面无关**的机制：DSH 的实验性「自定义插件市场」（Plugins → Discover），
它读的是用户自己加的 index URL，格式为 **format 1**，硬规则见 [`market/README.md`](market/README.md)——
其中 `category` / `labels[]` 必须在索引自己的 `metadata` 里声明过，那是另一层"tag 要求"。

## 版本

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

# dsh-web-annotate

在 DSH 侧栏里跑一个真实浏览器，指向页面元素就地写批注，汇总成结构化指令。

Point at a live element inside the DSH sidebar, drop a comment on it, and get back a structured instruction list.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.1%2B-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0284c7.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> 装不上、报错、或者行为和文档对不上，直接发邮件到 **1992335297@qq.com**，比开 Issue 更快被看到。

---

![侧栏网页批注](docs/annotate.png)

> 图为界面示意，按插件 `lib/client.js` 的工具栏、拾取高亮、元素信息与批注列表样式渲染，页面内容为假数据，不是运行截图。可用 `node scripts/make-screenshots.mjs` 重新生成（源码在 `scripts/demo/annotate.html`）。

## 它解决什么问题

改界面最累的不是改，是指路。「左边那个卡片的边距大了点」——模型得猜是哪个卡片；截一张图贴进去——又得反复圈。批注把指路变成点一下：鼠标停在哪个元素上，它的标签、尺寸、背景色、字体就摆在那儿，点一下写一句人话，最后汇总成一份带选择器的清单。

## 功能

- **真实浏览器**：宿主侧用 Playwright 起 Chromium，页面是真跑的，不是画出来的缩略图。
- **画面推流**：CDP `Page.startScreencast` 出帧，SSE 推到侧栏，页面一有变化就刷新。
- **元素拾取**：开启批注模式后，鼠标指向哪里，就高亮哪个元素并显示 `标签 / 尺寸 / 背景色 / 字体 / 字号 / 字重`。
- **就地评论**：点元素弹出输入框，回车即存；批注列表在下方可逐条删除。
- **框选区域**：按住拖动可以框一块区域批注，适合「这一整块间距不对」这类说不清是哪个元素的意见。
- **一键回填**：点 **↩** 把汇总直接写进对话输入框，不用复制粘贴。
- **快捷键**：`Ctrl+Shift+.` 切换批注模式。
- **交互转发**：退出拾取后，点击、滚轮、方向键、Enter、Tab、Esc、Backspace、PageUp/PageDown 都会转发给页面。
- **批注留得住**：按页面地址存在 `localStorage`，关掉 tab 再打开还在；删完自动清空。
- **穿透 iframe**：页面里嵌的 iframe（含跨域）也能点进去拾取，信息浮层会标出所在层级。
- **页面内输入**：工具栏 `⌨` 把一段文本（含中文）送进页面当前焦点元素，绕开键盘布局与输入法。
- **导出成文件**：`⤓` 把汇总写成 Markdown，存到 `~/.dsh/web-annotate/` 下。

## 汇总长这样

```markdown
## 网页批注

页面：http://localhost:5173/

1. `#card-a`（div，936×54）
   卡片内边距太大，收到 12px

2. `#card-b.accent`（div，936×54）
   强调色换成主题蓝
```

## 用法

1. 点右侧栏 tab 条的添加按钮，选 **网页批注**。
2. 地址栏输入 `localhost:5173`，回车。首次启动浏览器要等几秒。
3. 点工具栏的 **◱ 批注**（或按 `Ctrl+Shift+.`）进入拾取模式。指向元素看信息，点一下写评论；按住拖动可以框一块区域。
4. 点 **↩** 把汇总回填到输入框，或点 **⧉** 复制到剪贴板。

退出拾取模式后，点击和滚轮会正常传给页面，可以当普通预览用。

## 与 dsh-web-preview 的分工

| | dsh-web-preview | dsh-web-annotate |
|---|---|---|
| 渲染 | iframe 直出 | CDP 画面流 |
| 速度 | 接近原生 | 帧流，有几十毫秒延迟 |
| 能否批注 | 否（跨域拿不到 DOM） | 能 |
| 依赖 | 无 | 需要 Playwright（复用 DSH 自带的那份） |

两个插件可以同时装，各自一个 tab 类型。

## 技术实现

```
宿主 lib/index.js
  ├─ 从 DSH profile 目录解析 playwright，复用 DSH 自带的 chromium
  ├─ 每个地址一个 page 会话，CDP screencast 出帧
  ├─ SSE  GET  /api/web-annotate/frames?session=<id>
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/session      创建会话
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/input        鼠标 / 滚轮 / 键盘转发
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/pick         坐标 → 元素信息（elementFromPoint）
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/reload       重新加载
  └─ DEL  /api/web-annotate/session/<id> 关闭
```

没用 WebSocket：DSH 的 `webServer` 只暴露路由注册，不保证能拿到 http server 的 `upgrade` 事件。SSE 是普通响应，稳定可控；输入事件走 POST，量级完全够。

选择器生成走 `id` → 类名 → `nth-of-type` 的降级链，最多上溯 6 层。

## 权限与安全边界

这个插件比纯前端插件权限大，装之前请明确知道它做了什么。

- **会启动本地浏览器进程**：使用 DSH 自带的 Playwright 与 Chromium，不额外下载。
- **会访问你输入的地址**：只放行 `http` / `https`，拒绝 `file://` 与其它协议，不能读取本地文件。
- **不注入任意脚本**：页面内只执行一个固定的取元素信息函数，不执行页面返回的内容。
- **不写入文件**：批注只存在客户端内存里，复制由你自己触发。
- **会话隔离**：每个地址一个 page，关闭 tab 即销毁；无客户端连接且空闲 5 分钟后自动回收。
- `dependencies` 为空，无 `preinstall` / `install` / `postinstall` / `prepare` 生命周期脚本。

## 已知限制

- 画面是帧流，快速滚动或动画多时会有轻微延迟。
- 拾取模式会拦截点击与滚动，要操作页面（点按钮、输入）需先退出拾取。
- 键盘只转发导航键与编辑键（方向键、Enter、Tab、Esc、Backspace、PageUp/PageDown）；可打印字符走 `⌨` 面板的整段输入，逐字键入不转。
- 回填依赖 DSH 的 `conversation.input.left` 插槽存在。该插槽没挂上时自动退回复制到剪贴板。
- iframe 穿透最多 4 层；超出的部分会被当成普通 iframe 元素本身。
- 导出固定写到 `~/.dsh/web-annotate/`，不写项目目录。
- 批注存在 `localStorage`，按页面地址分键；换浏览器 profile 或清理站点数据会丢。
- 只在 Windows + DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` 桌面端验证过。

## 开发与验证

```bash
node scripts/verify.mjs   # 静态 + 路由级，17 项，不启动浏览器
node scripts/smoke.mjs    # 端到端：起站点、起 chromium、取帧、拾取、输入、刷新、关闭，8 项
```

`smoke.mjs` 会真起一个本地 HTTP 站点和 Chromium，实测输出形如：

```
PASS  创建会话并打开页面
      frame=13351 bytes, device=1000x700
PASS  SSE 收到首帧画面
      picked <div> #card-a 936x54
      bg=rgb(255, 255, 255) font=16px / system-ui
PASS  拾取元素返回标签与样式
...
结果: 8 passed, 0 failed
```

## 安装

### 一条命令

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:nubeslove/dsh-web-annotate"
```

然后在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-web-annotate"`，重启 DSH。

插件本身不含运行时依赖；Playwright 在运行时从 DSH profile 目录解析，复用 DSH 自带的 Chromium，不会额外下载浏览器。

### 本地开发

自己改代码时用 link 指向工作副本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-annotate"
```

路径含空格时手工处理：在 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-web-annotate": "link:E:/path/to/dsh-web-annotate"`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `"dsh-web-annotate"`，并在 `profiles/desktop/node_modules/` 下建指向本目录的 Junction，然后重启 DSH。

## 更新记录

- **0.3.0** — 攻克三处硬限制：拾取可递归穿透 iframe（`frame.childFrames()` 逐层进入子文档，跨域也能读，最多 4 层，浮层显示所在层级）；新增 `⌨` 页面文本输入面板，用 `keyboard.insertText` 送中文等任意字符；新增 `⤓` 导出，把汇总写成 Markdown 到 `~/.dsh/web-annotate/`。自检 19 项，冒烟 11 项。
- **0.2.0** — 批注汇总可直接回填输入框（在 `conversation.input.left` 挂桥接组件拿到 `inputActions`，桥不可用时退回复制）；新增 `Ctrl+Shift+.` 快捷键、拖动框选区域、方向键与编辑键转发、批注 `localStorage` 持久化。自检增至 17 项。
- **0.1.0** — 首个版本。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

## 反馈与联系 / Feedback & Contact

遇到 bug、安装失败、行为和文档不一致，或者想要某个功能，都可以直接发邮件。

**邮箱：1992335297@qq.com**

邮件里带上这三样，定位会快很多：

- 插件版本（`package.json` 里的 `version`）
- DSH 版本（`dsh --version`）
- 报错的完整文字或截图

也可以在 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nubeslove/dsh-web-annotate/issues) 提，但邮件更快。

plugins.description: Agent preset 检查器：看清每个 preset 的层来源、装配树、提示词与工具（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-preset-inspector

Agent preset 检查器：看清每个 preset 的层来源、装配树、提示词与工具（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

## 为什么需要它 设置页的「查看配置」只给你一份 YAML 文本：没有来源、没有包信息、没有层次。可 preset 的实际行为是**多层补丁叠出来的**——`dsh-base` 声明一行、`dsh-web-app` 改它、你的 `cordis.patch.yml` 再改一次。最后哪个值生效、这行是谁加的，全藏在多份文件里。 Preset Inspector 把同一份装配拆成三种看法： - **模型输入**：当前 preset 实际收到的系统提示词、动态上下文和工具定义； - **插件树**：每个 preset 由哪些插件行组成，每行来自哪一层； - **补丁层**：整个 profile 的 bundle / profile / home 补丁栈，以及每层执行的 insert / replace config / disable。 它只读，不改任何 preset 或配置。 ## 安装 直接装 git 源： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:omdsh-dev/dsh-preset-inspector ``` 装完重启 `dsh web`。本包依赖宿主注入官方包，**不要用本地目录 `link:` 安装**。 离线或需要固定产物时，可以用 release 里的 tarball： ```sh pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-preset-inspector-*.tgz ``` ## 用起来是什么样 在 **Settings → Agent presets** 的任意 preset 卡片上点「检查」打开面板。面板内可切换 preset，不需要另开入口。 ![Settings 入口](docs/preview/settings-entry.png) ### 模型输入 系统提示词按类型分组（身份 / 人设 / 工具引导…）。点「显示来源」可以看到每段的段名、来源和包名；不显示时页面只保留正文。 - **System Prompt**：按 `order` 排列；完整 section 规则由真实 assembly 决定。 - **动态注入**：每个 context 槽位可点击，查看 `order`、必需/可选、归属和装配说明。 - **工具定义**：模型侧真实 schema；工具名、描述、参数和提供方。搜索框可过滤。 ![动态上下文详情](docs/preview/context-detail.png) ### 插件树 / 补丁层 插件树展示每行插件、分类、包名、工具列表，以及插入/修改/禁用的层信息。补丁层展示每层实际执行的 ops；`config` patch 会标成整体替换，避免误以为是按 key 合并。 ## 能力面 | 能力 | 说明 | |---|---| | 模型输入 | 系统提示词、动态注入、工具定义；自动捕获 Agent setup 结果 | | 来源显示 | 「显示来源」按需显示段名/来源/包名和工具提供方 | | 插件树 | preset 的插件行、分类、工具、layers | | 补丁层 | bundle → profile → home 的补丁栈与 ops | | 官方设置入口 | Settings → Agent presets 卡片上的「检查」（唯一入口，不占侧栏） | | 兼容性 | 浅/深色、中/英、390px 窄屏、键盘焦点 | ## 已知限制 - **只读**；但为了拿到 Agent setup 阶段的数据，后台会自动执行一次 preset setup。它不发送模型请求；第三方插件在 setup 中可能有文件/网络等副作用。 - Agent/session 条件才注册的工具或提示词段不会出现在 mount 快照里；以实际会话为准。 - 层栈来自请求时读取的磁盘配置；CLI overlay、telemetry patch 和已热协调的内存树不在回放范围内。 - `config` patch 是整体替换，不是按 key 合并。 - 静态扫描只作为兜底，仍是启发式，复杂运行时拼接可能漏/多列。 - 同一 group 内重复 id 的行用 `#2` 区分；删除前一个同名行时序号会前移，极端情况下来源会显示为 patch。 - Settings 卡片上的「检查」是 DOM 装饰：官方 0.2.1 没有 per-card slot，官方卡片结构变化时入口会暂时消失（插件不再提供侧栏备用入口）。面板挂在 `shell.overlay`，打开事件监听和卡片装饰都由它维护。 - dry-run 在 `0.2.1-rc.1` 实测不留下新 session 文件，但依赖 factory rollback 语义；升级 dsh 后需要重新验证。 更多实现细节与验证证据见 [docs/engineering-notes.md](docs/engineering-notes.md)。 ## 插件管理 装/卸/启停用官方 CLI：`dsh plugin --profile web add|remove <包>`；已装插件在**侧边栏 Plugins 页**里查看与配置。 ## 兼容性 | dsh 版本 | 状态 | |---|---| | `0.2.1-rc.1` | ✅ 已验证（2026-10-17，隔离 DSH_HOME：tarball 安装、mount assembly、dry-run、Settings 入口、三视角、浅/深色、中/英、390px 窄屏、键盘焦点） | | `0.2.0-rc.2` | ⚠️ 未验证——段名/服务名若有差异，模型输入可能显示“运行时”而非模板 | ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files
