plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-locale-ko

**한국어** | [English](README.en.md)

**DeepSeek Harness(DSH) 비공식 한국어 언어팩** · 딥시크 하네스 한글 패치

> **Korean (한국어) UI language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/).**
> Install it from **Plugins → Add plugin** with `https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko`, then pick 한국어 in Settings → General → Language.
> Unofficial community translation; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

DeepSeek Harness의 화면(채팅, 사이드바, 설정, 플러그인, 자동화 작업, 파일 미리보기, 대화상자 등)을 한국어로 바꿔 주는 플러그인입니다.
앱 프로그램 파일은 건드리지 않고 DSH 플러그인으로만 설치되기 때문에, 플러그인 화면에서 언제든 끄거나 제거할 수 있습니다.

| 적용 전 | 적용 후 |
|---|---|
| ![적용 전: 영어 화면](docs/before-main.png) | ![적용 후: 한국어 화면](docs/after-main.png) |

<details>
<summary>스크린샷 더 보기 (설정, 플러그인 화면)</summary>

![설정 → 일반 화면](docs/settings.png)

![플러그인 화면의 한국어 언어팩 상세 정보](docs/plugins.png)

</details>

## 기준 앱

이 언어팩은 DeepSeek의 [DeepSeek Harness 공식 페이지](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)에서 배포하는 **공식 데스크톱 앱**(Download for Windows)을 기준으로 만들었습니다. 같은 페이지에서 안내하는 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`(Web UI)에서도 동작합니다.

이 프로젝트는 비공식 커뮤니티 번역이며, DeepSeek가 만들거나 보증한 것이 아닙니다.

## 지원 버전

| 앱 | 버전 |
|---|---|
| [DeepSeek Harness 공식 데스크톱 앱](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (Windows 64-bit) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` (Web UI) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |

다른 버전에서는 일부 문구가 영어로 나오거나 동작하지 않을 수 있습니다.

## 설치

Node.js나 터미널은 필요 없습니다.

1. DeepSeek Harness 왼쪽 사이드바에서 **플러그인**을 엽니다.
2. 오른쪽 위 **플러그인 추가**를 누르고, 아래 주소를 입력한 뒤 **설치**를 누릅니다.

   ```
   https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko
   ```

3. 설치가 끝나면 **지금 켜기**를 누릅니다. 다시 시작하지 않아도 바로 적용됩니다.

설정 → 일반 → 언어에서 `한국어`를 고를 수 있습니다. 운영체제 언어가 한국어이고 따로 고른 언어가 없으면 자동으로 한국어가 선택됩니다.

### 끄기 / 제거 / 업데이트

- **끄기**: 플러그인 → 설치된 플러그인 → 한국어 언어팩의 스위치를 끕니다.
- **제거**: 한국어 언어팩을 눌러 상세 화면에서 **제거**를 누릅니다.
- **업데이트**: 제거한 뒤 같은 주소로 다시 설치합니다.

설치, 끄기, 제거는 모두 DSH 앱의 **플러그인 화면**에서 처리되며, 언어팩은 **내 설정 파일**(`cordis.patch.yml`)을 직접 수정하지 않습니다.

## 구성

| 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | DSH 플러그인 선언 (번들 + 클라이언트 플러그인) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 번들을 켜면 언어팩 플러그인을 불러오는 설정 |
| `lib/client.js` | 빌드된 언어팩 본체 |
| `locale/*.json` | 플러그인 화면에 표시되는 이름과 설명 (영어·중국어·한국어) |
| `icon.svg` | 플러그인 아이콘 |
| `src/ko-dict.json` | 앱 번역 시스템에 등록된 문구의 한국어 번역 (0.2.1 기준 56개 네임스페이스, 2,566개 키) |
| `src/ko-static.json` | 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 문구의 한국어 번역. `global`(어디서나), `plugins`(플러그인 화면 안에서만) 두 묶음 |
| `src/client.template.js`, `src/build.mjs` | 위 파일들로 `lib/client.js`를 만드는 템플릿과 빌드 스크립트 |

## 번역 수정하기

`src/ko-dict.json` 또는 `src/ko-static.json`을 고친 뒤 빌드하세요.

```bash
node src/build.mjs
```

오역이나 빠진 문구는 Issue나 Pull Request로 알려 주세요.

## 동작 방식

- DSH가 제공하는 언어팩 API로 `ko` 언어(대체 언어 `en`)를 추가하고, 네임스페이스별 한국어 사전을 등록합니다. 언어 선택은 DSH가 직접 설정에 저장합니다.
- 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 일부 문구는, 화면에 표시된 텍스트가 정확히 일치할 때만 한국어로 바꿉니다. 다른 언어로 바꾸면 즉시 원래 문구로 돌아갑니다.
  - 플러그인 이름·설명은 플러그인 화면 안에서만 바꿉니다.
  - "Status", "Tools" 같은 짧은 단어는 바꾸지 않습니다. 같은 이름의 파일·폴더·세션 제목이 잘못 바뀌지 않도록 하기 위해서입니다.
  - 대화 본문(AI 답변, 사용자 메시지, 추론 내용, 코드)은 바꾸지 않습니다.

## 한계

- 앱 자체에 내장된 화면은 번역할 수 없습니다. 공식 데스크톱 앱의 창 메뉴(Application, Edit 등)가 여기에 해당합니다.
- 설정 → 기본 제공 플러그인 목록의 패키지 설명은 각 패키지의 개발자용 설명이라 공식 중국어판에서도 영어로 나오며, 이 언어팩도 번역하지 않습니다.
- 외부 플러그인과 서버에서 내려오는 일부 문구(도구 이름, 오류 원문 등)는 영어로 남을 수 있습니다.
- 앱이 업데이트되면 새 문구가 영어로 나올 수 있습니다.

## 라이선스

[MIT](LICENSE)

번역의 원문은 MIT 라이선스로 배포되는 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)(Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek)의 UI 문구입니다. 자세한 내용은 [NOTICE](NOTICE)를 보세요.

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: Guarded GitHub tools for DeepSeek Harness: 9 typed github_* tools (58 actions) where every state-changing action needs confirm:true plus a human approval seam, with a digest-verified self-update and a settings page. Zero runtime dependencies. | 面向 DSH 的 GitHub 工具：所有写动作都过审批门
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-gate

**GitHub tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) where a write cannot happen by accident.** Nine typed `github_*` tools over the GitHub CLI. Every action that changes remote state — 23 of them — needs `confirm: true` **and** passes a human approval seam. The model's flag is intent; it is not consent. ```text github_pr { action: "merge", number: 42, confirm: true } → an approval prompt naming the pull request; "no" stops it → after consent: gh pr merge 42 --repo owner/name ``` - **Argv arrays, never a shell.** `gh` is spawned with `shell: false`, so model text cannot become shell syntax — structurally, not by filtering. - **One credential chain, resolved per call.** DSH credential store → `GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` → `gh auth login` → git credential helper. Rotating a token applies to the next call. - **Configuration in the GUI.** Settings → Plugins → GitHub: paste a PAT, test it against the API, see which layer is live. The token is never displayed back. - **A branch pill** in the session header: current branch, its pull request, and a switch menu that fails closed when the caller cannot be judged. - **Digest-verified self-update.** `github_update` stages a release whose sha256 is checked against the digest GitHub publishes. Host-side tools plus one small browser half. Zero runtime dependencies. No build step. > **Requires** DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` and the > [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) (`gh`) on `PATH`. Linux, macOS, and Windows. **Topics:** `dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `dsh` · `cordis-plugin` · `github` · `gh-cli` ## Why this over another GitHub plugin Tool count is a bad proxy for usefulness — a broader surface with looser gates is easier to write and harder to trust. The trade this project makes is explicit: | | Other GitHub plugins for DSH | This one | |---|---|---| | Write safety | `confirm: true`, set by the model | `confirm: true` **+** an approval seam the model cannot set | | Raw REST | unrestricted escape hatch | path must be relative, no `..`, write methods gated at run time | | Correctness evidence | tests of its own API | 176 tests, 180 behaviour snapshots, and **84 argv shapes parsed by a real `gh`** | | Failure messages | HTTP code passed through | 401 / 403 quota / 403 SSO / 404 / 422 each name the fix | | Scope | as many tools as possible | 9 tools / 58 actions, one to a `gh` subcommand family | | Self-update | — | staged with a verified sha256, install left to the platform | If you want the largest possible tool surface with no gates, this is not the right plugin. If you want the model to be able to *look* at GitHub freely but need a person in the loop before it *changes* anything, it is. ## Table of contents - [Install](#install) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [Guidance](#guidance) - [The branch pill](#the-branch-pill) - [Settings page](#settings-page) - [What it provides](#what-it-provides) - [Updating this plugin](#updating-this-plugin) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Credential chain](#credential-chain) - [Device Flow needs your own OAuth App](#device-flow-needs-your-own-oauth-app) - [Safety model](#safety-model) - [Background jobs](#background-jobs) - [Known limitations](#known-limitations) - [Development](#development) ## Install Two ways, both through the Harness plugin manager (`plugin_manager` action `install_bundle`): 1. **From a GitHub release** — download `dsh-github-gate-.tgz` from [Releases](../../releases) and point `install_bundle` at the unpacked package directory, or at a local path holding it. 2. **From a packed tarball of your own checkout**: ```bash npm pack --pack-destination ../packages # pack OUTSIDE the source directory ``` then install `../packages/dsh-github-gate-.tgz`. **Install from a packed tarball, not from the source directory.** This is not a style preference. Installing a `link:` to a workspace directory produces a junction, and the launcher's runtime resolution does not reach bare `@deepseek-ai/*` packages through it — the plugin then fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and refuses to activate entirely. Pack the tarball **outside** the source tree: one run that packed into the source directory itself left that directory emptied once the install completed (see [docs/DESIGN.md](./docs/DESIGN.md) §5.8). The tarball is a snapshot, so editing the source requires repacking and reinstalling; a restart loads the new module generation. ### One-command download The install scripts fetch the latest release, verify its sha256 against the digest GitHub publishes, and print the install path. They deliberately do not install — that step belongs to the plugin manager, which asks for approval: ```powershell # Windows irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1273984347/dsh-github-gate/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` ```sh # Linux / macOS curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1273984347/dsh-github-gate/main/install.sh | sh ``` Then install the printed path with `plugin_manager` action `install_bundle`. ## Quick start ```text 1. Is there a credential? github_auth { action: "status" } credential source: credentials-seam | environment | gh-cli | git-credential-helper | none 2. No credential? Establish one. github_auth { action: "login" } # Device Flow, needs your own OAuth App — or paste a PAT in Settings → Plugins → GitHub — or just run `gh auth login` in a terminal; the chain picks it up 3. Something is broken? github_auth { action: "probe" } # isolates each layer, names the failed one 4. Work on a pull request. github_pr { action: "status" } # CI for the branch you are on github_pr { action: "view", number: 42 } github_pr { action: "checks", number: 42 } github_pr { action: "merge", number: 42, confirm: true } # asks a person ``` The repository is taken from the workspace's git remote when `repo` is omitted, so the common case needs no argument. ## Guidance Beyond the tools, this plugin contributes a **prompt section** and three **skills** that say what the tool schemas cannot: when to use which capability, what evidence a conclusion needs, and when to stop. The rules are deliberately few — a prompt section is paid for on every step — and each one names the tool it applies to. Three workflows load on demand: `github-pr-review`, `github-ci-triage`, `github-issue-to-pr`. ## The branch pill `client.js` is the browser half: a branch pill in the session header slot (`conversation.session.header.utilities`) showing the checked-out branch, the pull request open on it, and a menu for switching branches. It is ~26 KB and it is the only part of this bundle that renders in the browser. It reads through four loopback HTTP routes this plugin registers on the `webServer` service: | Route | Does | Without a `connection` service | |---|---|---| | `/branch`, `/branches`, `/diagnostics` | read the workspace and branch names | served, with one logged warning | | `/switch` | runs `git switch` on the working tree | **refused with 403** | A missing service is not consent: an apparatus that cannot judge a request must not treat "cannot judge" as "judged safe". The read routes fail open because refusing them would disable the pill outright in a composition that legitimately has no Connection service; `/switch` fails closed because its consequence is a change to the user's working tree. `client.js` requires no Harness Client package and uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so a chang

# dsh-ledger

用量账本（accounting only）：监听 session/event 中带 usage 的记录写 JSONL；

```bash
node --test test/ledger.test.mjs
```

plugins.description: macOS ⌃⌘F window-fullscreen shortcut for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-fullscreen-shortcut > 给 [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 桌面端补上 macOS 的窗口全屏快捷键 —— **`⌃⌘F`（Control + Command + F）**。 [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Platform: macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS-lightgrey) ![dsh: 0.2.x](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.x-6f42c1) ## 目录 - [背景](#背景) - [功能](#功能) - [环境要求](#环境要求) - [安装](#安装) - [使用](#使用) - [工作原理](#工作原理) - [文件结构](#文件结构) - [卸载](#卸载) - [从旧包名迁移](#从旧包名迁移) - [常见问题](#常见问题) - [开发](#开发) - [License](#license) ## 背景 DSH 桌面端使用自定义的 Electron 外壳，并替换掉了 Electron 默认的应用菜单。macOS 原生的「进入全屏幕 / Enter Full Screen」菜单项因此不存在，挂在它上面的系统快捷键 **`⌃⌘F`** 也随之失效；而外壳自带的快捷键目录里并没有「窗口全屏」这条命令。 结果就是：在 DSH 桌面窗口里，你没法像其他 macOS 应用那样按 `⌃⌘F` 全屏，只能点系统窗口左上角的绿色按钮。 本插件只做一件事：把这个缺失的物理按键补回来，在 DSH 桌面窗口内切换页面全屏。 ## 功能 - **`⌃⌘F` 一键切换全屏**：按一次进入全屏，再按一次退出。 - **按物理键位判断**：以 `KeyboardEvent.code === "KeyF"` 匹配，不受键盘布局（QWERTY / Dvorak / 中文输入法等）影响。 - **不打扰其他输入**：跳过长按重复（`event.repeat`）和已被页面其他控件处理（`event.defaultPrevented`）的按键。 - **同步外壳状态**：维护 `` 属性，让标题栏留白、红绿灯占位等布局样式与真实全屏状态保持一致。 - **轻量、无副作用**：纯客户端插件，无网络请求、无持久化、不访问凭据。 ## 环境要求 | 项 | 要求 | | --- | --- | | 平台 | macOS | | 宿主 | DSH **桌面端**（Electron 外壳） | | 插件 API | dsh 0.2.x（`dsh.client` 客户端插件 + bundle patch） | | 浏览器 Web 版 | 不需要本插件 —— 浏览器自带全屏，按键由浏览器自身处理 | ## 安装 > `dsh plugin add` 会修改 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`，安装后需要**重启 DSH 桌面端**才能激活客户端插件。 ### 方式一：从 GitHub 直接安装（推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kimufly/dsh-fullscreen-shortcut ``` ### 方式二：克隆后本地安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/kimufly/dsh-fullscreen-shortcut.git cd dsh-fullscreen-shortcut dsh plugin --profile desktop add . ``` `dsh plugin add` 会把包写入 profile 的 `dependencies`，并把 `dsh-fullscreen-shortcut` 追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`；重启桌面端后生效。 ### 确认安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop why dsh-fullscreen-shortcut ``` 安装成功后，DSH 桌面端「插件」列表里会出现 **窗口全屏快捷键 / Window Fullscreen Shortcut**。 ## 使用 在 DSH 桌面窗口内： | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | `⌃⌘F` | 进入全屏 / 退出全屏 | | `Esc` | 退出全屏（Fullscreen API 的默认行为） | > **提示**：本插件走的是页面级 Fullscreen API（`document.fullscreenElement`），不是 macOS 的「原生全屏空间」。窗口会占满当前屏幕，但不会创建新的桌面 Space，也不会切换系统菜单里的「退出全屏幕」状态。 ## 工作原理 1. **注册客户端模块**：`package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 声明 `platform: "web"`、`immediately: true`，并注入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules`；`cordis.patch.yml` 通过 bundle patch 把插件作为 loader 行插入。 2. **自行绑定按键**：桌面外壳只拦截已注册快捷键对应的按键（`before-input-event` 仅对已匹配的组合 `preventDefault`），DOM 的 `keydown` 路径仍然畅通。插件在 `window` 的捕获阶段监听 `keydown`，匹配 `code === "KeyF"` 且 `metaKey && ctrlKey`（同时要求没有 Alt / Shift）。 3. **调用 Fullscreen API**：命中后调用 `document.documentElement.requestFullscreen()` / `document.exitFullscreen()`。真实键盘事件自带瞬时用户激活（transient user activation），这是 `requestFullscreen()` 的硬性要求；通过 IPC 派发的模拟按键没有该激活，会被浏览器拒绝。 4. **同步外壳状态**：桌面 preload 只在窗口收到原生 `enter-full-screen` 事件时设置 ``；由页面主动发起的全屏不会触发该原生事件，布局便会继续为红绿灯预留标题栏高度。插件监听 `fullscreenchange`，自行维护该属性。 ## 文件结构 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `client.js` | 客户端插件本体：按键绑定、全屏切换、`data-fullscreen` 同步 | | `index.js` | 宿主侧空实现（行为全部在客户端） | | `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch，把插件作为 loader 行插入 | | `package.json` | 包清单，声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client` | | `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` | 插件标题与描述文案 | | `icon.svg` | 插件图标 | ## 卸载 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-fullscreen-shortcut ``` 重启 DSH 桌面端后生效。 ## 从旧包名迁移 本插件原名 `@local/window-fullscreen-shortcut`（仅以本地链接方式安装）。如果你装过旧版，请先移除再安装新包： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @local/window-fullscreen-shortcut dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kimufly/dsh-fullscreen-shortcut ``` 然后重启桌面端。 ## 常见问题 ### 按 `⌃⌘F` 没反应？ - 确认装在了 `desktop` profile：`dsh plugin --profile desktop why dsh-fullscreen-shortcut`。 - 确认已经重启过 DSH 桌面端，且焦点在 DSH 窗口内。 - 插件会跳过已被其他控件处理的按键；检查是否有其他插件或输入法占用了同一组合。 - 查看 DSH 日志里是否有 `dsh-fullscreen-shortcut:` 前缀的告警（例如 Fullscreen API 被拒绝）。 ### 全屏后标题栏还留着一条空白？ 这是 `` 未同步的典型症状。本插件已通过 `fullscreenchange` 监听处理；若仍出现，欢迎带 DSH 版本与 macOS 版本提 issue。 ### 和 macOS 绿色按钮的原生全屏是一回事吗？ 不是。本插件走 HTML Fullscreen API，原生全屏属于系统窗口管理；两者互不替代，也不会互相「接管」。 ### Windows / Linux 能用吗？ 当前只面向 macOS 的 `⌃⌘F` 习惯，未做 Windows / Linux 适配，也未在对应平台测试。 ## 开发 - 纯 JavaScript（ESM），**无构建步骤**。 - `client.js` 通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)` 注册客户端模块；逻辑包在 `ctx.effect()` 中，返回的清理函数会在插件卸载/重载时移除监听。 - 本地调试：克隆后执行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add .`，修改 `client.js` 后**重启桌面端**（已安装的客户端模块不走热更新）。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 kimufly

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在设置页按工作区分级清理会话，支持批量删除与 Agent 工具。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-cleanup-pro

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%E2%89%A50.2.1--rc.1-7da1de.svg?style=flat-square)](#兼容性)
[![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0e7490.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）补上官方缺失的**会话删除**能力：

- **设置 → 会话清理**：按工作区分级列出全部会话，搜索、多选、批量删除；
- 删除是**真删**：会话日志目录、投影缓存、工作区登记一起清掉；
- 删除后**立即推送给界面**：冷会话不用重启就从会话列表消失；
- 同时给 Agent 提供 3 个工具，对话里就能清理会话。

> 本插件是社区项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

## 安装

### 方式一：应用内插件管理器（推荐，桌面端 / Web 均可）

**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件（Add plugin）**，粘贴仓库地址：

```text
https://github.com/gcluffy/dsh-session-cleanup-pro
```

装完**重启一次 DSH**（首次安装宿主半侧需要重新加载），然后在 **设置 → 会话清理** 使用。

### 方式二：命令行（仅纯 web profile）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gcluffy/dsh-session-cleanup-pro
```

`web` 换成你实际的 profile 名。桌面端（Electron）的 profile 只允许应用自己管理，
请在应用内插件管理器里安装。

### 关于 npm 包名

npm 上已有一个同名项目 `dsh-session-delete`（其他作者维护），与本插件无关；本插件的包名是 `dsh-session-cleanup-pro`，请勿用 npm 包名安装。
本插件的 0.2.0 目前只通过 GitHub 分发；若之后以独立包名发布到 npm，这里会补充对应命令。

## 功能

### 设置页：会话清理

- 按工作区分组，可折叠；组头显示会话数与占用体积；
- 搜索会话名称 / 路径 / id；
- 单选、多选（点击整行切换，Shift 连选）、全选本组 / 全选 / 清空；
- 每行可展开详情：完整 id、目录、创建时间、累计 token、轮次；
- 删除前弹确认框，列出待删会话；运行中会话会明确提示需要重启；
- 默认开启「保护运行中的会话」，避免误删当前会话。

### 删除范围

| 目标 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 会话日志 | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<project>/<id>/session.vN.jsonl.zstd`（整个目录） |
| 投影缓存 | `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json` |
| 工作区登记 | 优先走宿主 `workspaceRegistry`（`detachSession` / `unarchiveSession` / `unpinSession`），没有该服务时退回直接改 `workspace.json` |

登记走宿主 API 时，DSH 会自己发出 `domain/changed`；删除完成后插件再让宿主广播一次
`api-session/removed`，已连接的客户端会立即把该行从会话列表移除——不需要刷新页面。

### 什么时候要重启

| 情况 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 删的是**冷会话**（不在内存里） | 登记 + 文件 + 推送都完成后，界面**即时更新**，不需要重启 |
| 删的是**运行中会话** | 行会先消失，但宿主 SessionStore 仍持有实例 → 界面提示**重启 DeepSeek Harness** 彻底释放 |

宿主是否支持即时更新，可以看 `GET /dsh-session-cleanup-pro-4c1d/health` 返回的 `features`
是否包含 `host-registry` 与 `emit-removed`。

### Agent 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `session_delete_list` | 分级列出全部工作区与会话（名称 / 大小 / 时间 / 状态） |
| `session_delete_scan` | 只报统计：总数、运行中数量、每个工作区占多大 |
| `session_delete_remove` | 批量删除；返回结果里 `needRestart` 为真时要提醒用户重启 |

### HTTP 接口（设置页使用）

```text
GET  /dsh-session-cleanup-pro-4c1d/api/tree                   → 工作区分级树
POST /dsh-session-cleanup-pro-4c1d/api/delete { ids: [...] }  → 批量删除
GET  /dsh-session-cleanup-pro-4c1d/health                     → 探活 + features
```

## 安全边界

- **只读 + 删除会话产物**：不碰 DSH 自己的代码、配置树、其他插件的数据；
- **工作区登记原子写回**：临时文件 + rename，写到一半崩溃不会留下半个 JSON；
- **并发串行化**：同时删多个会话时，登记写回排队执行，不会互相覆盖；
- **失败不静默**：哪一步失败、失败原因都会显示在设置页上；
- **默认保护运行中会话**：想删当前会话需要先关掉保护开关；
- **会删除数据**：删除不可恢复，请确认后再勾选。

## 兼容性

- 需要 **DSH ≥ 0.2.1-rc.1**（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh`）；
- 客户端半侧声明 `dsh.client.platform: "web"`；桌面客户端加载的也是同一套 web 客户端；
- 插件不写自己的状态文件，所有数据都直接来自 `$DSH_HOME`。

## 开发

```bash
node --experimental-vm-modules tools/syntax-check.mjs   # 语法检查
node --test test/                                       # 全部测试
node test/smoke.mjs                                     # 在真实数据副本上跑删除
node test/dump.mjs                                      # 打印真实扫描结果
```

`smoke.mjs` 会把真实的 `$DSH_HOME` 复制到临时目录再删，**不动真实数据**。

目录结构：

```text
dsh-session-cleanup-pro/
├── index.js              # 宿主半侧入口：HTTP 路由 + Agent 工具
├── client.js             # 浏览器半侧：设置分区「会话清理」
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle 声明
├── src/
│   ├── shared/constants.js
│   └── host/
│       ├── layout.js     # 会话在磁盘上的落点
│       ├── registry.js   # workspace.json 读写（原子替换 + 串行化）
│       ├── scanner.js    # 扫描并分级成树
│       ├── deleter.js    # 删除执行（宿主登记 API + 文件 + 推送）
│       ├── service.js    # 服务层
│       ├── api.js        # HTTP 路由
│       └── tools.js      # 3 个 Agent 工具
├── tools/                # 语法检查 / 市场索引生成
└── test/                 # 冒烟 / API / 删除 / 配置树 / 客户端翻译测试
```

## 收录与插件市场

本仓库按 [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org) 的收录要求组织：

- 公开仓库 + 根目录 `package.json`（包名、版本、`engines`）；
- 导出的插件入口符合 DSH 规范（`apply(ctx)`）；
- README 含可复制的安装命令；
- MIT 许可证。

GitHub 仓库需要添加 topic **`dsh-plugin`**，站点才会自动发现与收录；提交入口：
<https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/submit>。

> 注意：想出现在 DSH 应用内的「插件中心」，还需要把 0.2.x 发布到 npm；
> 只发 GitHub 时仍会被站点收录，安装方式为 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:gcluffy/dsh-session-cleanup-pro`。

## English

A DSH plugin that adds real session deletion: a **Settings → Session cleanup** section listing
sessions grouped by workspace with search, multi-select and batch delete, plus three agent tools
(`session_delete_list`, `session_delete_scan`, `session_delete_remove`). Deletion removes the
session log directory, its projection cache and the workspace record (through the host registry),
then broadcasts `api-session/removed` so the UI updates without a restart. Running sessions still
need a DSH restart before the host releases them.

Install with the in-app plugin manager (paste `https://github.com/gcluffy/dsh-session-cleanup-pro`) or:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gcluffy/dsh-session-cleanup-pro
```

Requires DSH ≥ 0.2.1-rc.1. MIT licensed. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Markdown 转义吃掉路径分隔符时，取文件前把分隔符还原；不管哪个模型、哪个会话写的路径，本地图片都能显示。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-path-repair — 图片路径修复

本地图片（聊天里的 Markdown 图片、会话文档预览）在取文件前，把被 Markdown 转义吃掉的分隔符还原回去。**不靠提示词，不挑模型，不挑会话**。

## 问题

本地图片走 `/api/file?path=…`，path 是 Markdown 解析器给出的目标。在链接目标里，反斜杠后跟 ASCII 标点会被当作 CommonMark 转义：

```
写出来的：  ![x](C:\work\_out\shot.png)
解析得到：  C:\work_out\shot.png        ← \_ 的 \ 被吃掉
请求结果：  404 → 「图片无法预览 · alt」
```

这个还原在**解析器里**发生，早于客户端任何路径钩子（`pathImages` / `fileImages`），所以页面侧插件拿不到原始路径；而「让模型改成正斜杠」只对新生成的文字有效，别的智能体、历史消息都不管用。

## 做法

包住 `/api/file` 的处理函数：

1. 原样交给原处理器；不是 404 就直接返回，正常路径零影响。
2. 是 404 时，按「Markdown 转义只会发生在 ASCII 标点前」生成候选路径（把 `\` 插回标点前，1~3 处组合，最小改动优先）。
3. 每个候选都用 **HEAD 走原处理器**探测，也就是说仍然由组合出来的文件系统提供方（含沙箱策略）决定能不能读。
4. 只有**恰好一个**候选存在时才用它重新取文件；两个都像，就保持原来的 404，不猜。
5. 预算：单次最多 160 次探测、400ms。

## 边界

- 只在**已经失败**的请求上工作；目录依旧拒绝，不存在的文件依旧 404。
- 依赖 Connection 服务里的 `fetchRoutes` 表与 `registerFetchRoute`；上游如果改名，本插件会静默失效（不影响任何请求），不会把路径改成错的。
- 卸载时还原：路由的包装标记与 `registerFetchRoute` 都会被恢复。

## 测试

```bash
node test/repair.test.mjs
```

用真实文件系统 + 一个与官方行为一致的假处理器，覆盖：正常路径、被吃掉分隔符的路径、HEAD、两个候选的歧义、无可修复、指向目录。

plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - plugins.description: Model-selectable subagents with per-task reasoning effort for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.x. Maintained continuation of CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Subagent Model Router

**Give every delegated task the right model and reasoning effort—automatically.**

> [!NOTE]
> This is the maintained continuation of [CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router](https://github.com/CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router), including [poka-IT's DSH 0.1.7/0.2.0 port](https://github.com/CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router/pull/3). It targets DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x and adds per-task reasoning effort. Full history and credit are preserved.

Stop using one model for every kind of work. Configure your preferred fast, affordable, specialized, and high-reasoning models once; the router gives your agent the aliases, tags, and guidance it needs to intelligently select the best route for each delegated task.

That means faster routine work, stronger results on difficult problems, better control over cost, and less model micromanagement. Subagents can run in parallel, their results are reliably joined before the parent responds, and the model chosen for each task stays visible throughout the UI.

## Why use it?

- **Better results where they matter** — reserve your strongest models for architecture, security, deep reasoning, or critical review.
- **Lower cost and latency** — send routine searches, edits, and focused implementation work to faster or more economical routes.
- **Automatic, task-aware routing** — friendly aliases, capability tags, and plain-language usage guidance help the orchestrator choose intelligently.
- **Per-task reasoning effort** — the orchestrator can run the same route at `low` for mechanical work or `xhigh` for a stubborn bug, with an optional default per alias.
- **Confident parallel delegation** — launch multiple specialists in the background and reliably collect every result before synthesis.
- **Clear model visibility** — see which model actually handled a task in subagent headers and in the optional Better Sidebar **Sub-agents** tab.
- **Easy setup** — configure your model team from the Web UI, through a guided skill, or directly in a Cordis patch.

> [!TIP]
> Already using [Better Sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)? The router adds an optional **Sub-agents** tab through Better Sidebar's public `registerTab` API.

## See it in action

### Follow every specialist from Better Sidebar

![Better Sidebar Tasks view showing delegated subagents and their selected model chips](docs/screenshots/better-sidebar-task-model-chips.png)

*See parallel delegated work, current status, and the selected model together in the task tree you already use.*

### Build your ideal model team

![Subagent Model Router settings for aliases, providers, tags, token limits, and routing guidance](docs/screenshots/subagent-model-router-settings.png)

*Define friendly routes and tell the orchestrator when each model shines—from quick, budget-friendly tasks to your most demanding work.*

## What it adds

- `subagent_model`: a delegation tool whose `model` argument is restricted to user-configured aliases, with an optional `reasoning_effort`.
- `wait-for-subagents`: a join tool that waits for this agent's outstanding continuable background children, including standard and model-routed delegations, and returns their terminal results.
- Per-model tags and routing descriptions embedded in the tool schema and system prompt.
- `model_subagent_catalog`: a read-only view of models advertised by registered LLM providers.
- `configure_subagent_models`: a model-facing tool that reads or replaces only this plugin entry's configuration, without filesystem access.
- `model-subagent-setup`: a guided skill for selecting routes, generating routing guidance, obtaining confirmation, and saving through the constrained configuration tool.
- **Settings → Subagent Models**: a Web settings page for manually adding, editing, and removing routes.
- A hot-reloaded plugin configuration: the `config:` of the `- id: dsh-subagent-model-router` Loader entry in a Cordis patch.
- Foreground execution and durable continuable background subagents.
- Configurable stale-subagent filtering for listing tools, defaulting to 20 parent/user message turns without contact.
- An active-model chip in an opened subagent header.
- An optional Better Sidebar **Sub-agents** tab, with active-model chips on its rows, registered through the public sidebar service (when installed).

With an empty `models` list, the catalog, configuration, and wait tools remain available alongside the settings page and setup skill, but `subagent_model` is not registered. This provides a bootstrap state for initial setup.

## Orchestrator behavior

When model-selectable delegation is available, the system prompt tells the orchestrator not to duplicate work it delegated. After issuing all intended background delegations, it must call `wait-for-subagents` before synthesizing the child results or giving a final answer. While a same-session completion goal is active, the orchestrator must not merely report that another model is handling the task and end its turn with background subagents still outstanding: ending the turn triggers immediate goal continuation and can race child tracking. Waiting joins the outstanding work so the orchestrator can synthesize the results and continue or complete the goal. The wait tool joins every continuable background child started by that parent through `subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `subagent_model`, or `auto_agent_run`; it remains useful when no model routes are configured. It reserves standard, forked, and project-specialist delegation calls before they can publish a child, and after plugin reload it discovers direct continuable children when their durable descriptors confirm their mode and the live Agent is either running or interrupted with parked input (reported separately as paused). It preserves every terminal content block and drops retained records when the parent is disposed, while foreground one-shot runs and job-backed non-continuable delegations remain outside this join because their owning tool already returns or collects the result.

Direct human steering must not leave the parent blocked in an old join. When a committed `agent/inbox/spliced` event inserts a `source.kind: user` message at `next-step` for that parent, an active wait returns `{ kind: "interrupted", pending: [...] }` without cancelling or consuming any child. Each pending entry carries the exact child and run identity when available. The DSH agent loop does not automatically schedule a second tool call after the parent answers. Instead, the plugin's system prompt, tool description, and interruption result explicitly require the parent to answer the steering message first and then call `wait-for-subagents` again before final synthesis. That second call resumes the retained records and returns their eventual terminal output; queued `next-turn` input, model-authored context, cancellations, and events for other sessions do not trigger this outcome. A simultaneous child completion remains retained for the resumed wait.

The continuation manager's durable settlement notice triggers immediate reconciliation when a terminal lifecycle event was missed. Recovery requires matching post-boundary evidence in both the retained child epoch log and the parent notice, so an absent registry entry or an idle/resumable child is never treated as success by itself. For an ordinary tracked start, the record remains bound to the exact child and run identity. After plugin reload, a genuinely running child can instead be discovered without a published run id; its exact retained Agent object plus child and parent log boundaries identify that observed activation safely. A ten-second watchdog provides the same reconciliation as a fallback if the live notice event was also missed. Cancellation still rejects the active tool call without consuming records, and parent disposal still releases tracked children and active waits. If another plugin already owns or scope-shadows the `wait-for-subagents` name, this plugin leaves it untouched and suppresses its wait-specific guidance and tracking for the affected agents.

plugins.description: Voice copilot for DeepSeek Harness: names and attaches the push-to-talk session, adds composer microphones, and runs a real-time spoken conversation loop with Silero VAD, speculative transcription, streaming TTS and speaker verification.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-voz-copilot

Voice copilot for DeepSeek Harness. It gives the push-to-talk session a **name**
and a **place in the sidebar**, adds **dictation microphones to the composer**,
and can run a **real-time spoken conversation**: the microphone stays open, a
Silero VAD decides when you speak, transcription starts while you are still
silent, and the answer is spoken back sentence by sentence while the model is
still writing.

The plugin is the glue between the harness and a speech stack running on
localhost. It does **not** ship a speech-to-text engine or a text-to-speech
voice; those are external services (see [Requirements](#requirements)).

## Install

```sh
npm install -g pnpm
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-plugin-voz-copilot --allow-build=onnxruntime-node
```

`--allow-build=onnxruntime-node` é obrigatório no pnpm 10+: sem ele o pnpm bloqueia o download do binário do ONNX Runtime e a instalação falha. O pacote em si não tem passo de build.
# restart the harness (stop `dsh web` and start it again)
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` installs it **and**
adds its line to the profile bundle list. The bundle layer is read at boot, so a
restart is what activates it.

If `dsh` is installed globally, use `dsh` instead of `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`.

### Remove

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-voz-copilot
# restart the harness
```

Removing the package removes its bundle line. Conversations already named keep
their title in the session log; nothing is deleted.

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the same range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` (the harness manages profile plugins with it).
- **DeepSeek Harness** with the `web` profile for the interface. The `title`
  mode is used by the `acp` profile.
- **Speech-to-text**: an HTTP endpoint compatible with whisper.cpp's
  `whisper-server`, at `whisperUrl` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8178`):
  `POST /inference?response_format=json` with the audio in the multipart field
  `file`, answering `{"text": "..."}`. The server must decode WebM/Opus (an
  ffmpeg-enabled build), WAV and MP3. This plugin does not install it.
- **Optional fast engine**: `whisperFastUrl` (for example `http://127.0.0.1:8179`)
  for short conversation segments. When it is not set, the main endpoint is used.
- **Optional text-to-speech**: the `edge-tts` CLI, or a warm HTTP server. See
  [Configuration](#configuration). Without `tts`, the real-time conversation
  button stays disabled with the reason in its tooltip; dictation still works.
- **Optional speaker verification**: Python 3 with `sherpa-onnx` and `numpy`
  (`requirements.txt`). The ERes2Net model (38 MB, Apache-2.0) and the Silero
  VAD model (2.3 MB, MIT) are bundled. The speech detector uses
  `onnxruntime-node`, installed by npm.

## Use

The plugin is additive: it does not replace any harness control.

- **Push-to-talk session.** With a companion push-to-talk bridge that binds the
  Copilot key (F23 in the reference setup) and opens the session with
  `[conversa_copilot]` as the first line of the turn, this plugin pins the
  session title to `conversa_copilot` and attaches the session to the configured
  workspace, so it appears in the sidebar instead of staying invisible. The
  bridge and the key binding are not part of this package.
- **Header microphone.** Binds the conversation that is open in the GUI as the
  target of the voice. Lit means this is the voice conversation; a second click
  unbinds it. Binding writes the session id to `statePath` (the same file the
  bridge reads) and attaches the session to the workspace.
- **Sidebar footer.** Shows which conversation is receiving the voice without
  opening it.
- **Composer microphones.** Two buttons next to Send:
  - the **plain microphone** records and leaves the transcription in the draft,
    so you can edit before sending;
  - the **microphone with an arrow** records and sends the turn directly.

  Click the same button again to stop. While recording, the button becomes a red
  stop square; `Esc` or the cancel control in the floating pill aborts. The
  transcription is appended after whatever was already in the draft, never
  replacing it. An empty transcription is an error, never an empty turn.
- **Real-time conversation.** The third button opens the spoken loop on the open
  conversation: speak normally, the answer is spoken while it is written, and
  speaking over it interrupts (barge-in). The panel has pause, stop-response and
  close controls; `Esc` closes it and always releases the microphone.
- **Only your voice.** After enrolling your voice in the conversation panel,
  speaker embeddings decide whether a segment belongs to you. Audio from other
  voices is ignored before transcription. The check is fail-open: no enrollment,
  no local server, or too-short audio lets the speech through.

## How it works

Two halves, one package:

| Half | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| host | `index.js` | `title` mode pins the session title; `attach` mode links and attaches the session, and serves `/voz-copilot/api/*` |
| page | `client.js` | header button, sidebar indicator, composer microphones, recording pill and the conversation panel |
| host | `vad.js` | Silero VAD on 16 kHz PCM: speech probability with LSTM state between calls |
| host | `speaker.js` + `speaker-servidor.py` | speaker embeddings, voice profile and the cosine decision |
| host | `fala.js` | deterministic text cleanup (markdown, code, links, emoji) and sentence splitting |
| host | `tts.js` | text to MP3 through `edge-tts` or the warm server |
| host | `falar.js` | waits for the turn to finish and reads its text |

The browser never talks to the speech servers directly: the host process owns
the loopback route and enforces a local-request boundary (loopback `Host`,
same-origin `Origin`, POST for state changes, 256 KB for JSON and 16 MB for
audio). Audio and transcripts stay on localhost unless you point a configured
service at a remote address.

## Configuration

The defaults come from the package bundle patch and boot on any machine. To use
your own workspace and voice, edit the profile patch
(`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`). A patch under the same `id` replaces
the whole config of the line, so restate every key you want to keep.

```yaml
- id: voz-copilot
  config:
    mode: 'attach'
    workspace: '/path/to/your/workspace'
    title: 'conversa_copilot'
    statePath: '~/.dsh/voz-copilot.json'
    pollMs: 3000
    whisperUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:8178'
    whisperFastUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:8179'
    voz:
      persona: 'Answer in short, plain sentences that sound natural when spoken aloud.'
      maxChars: 220
    tts:
      bin: 'edge-tts'
      voice: 'en-US-AriaNeural'
      rate: '+0%'
      volume: '+0%'
      lexicon: '/path/to/tts_lexicon.py'
      python: 'python3'
      servidorQuente: 'http://127.0.0.1:8180'
      servidorQuenteScript: '/path/to/tts-servidor.py'
      servidorQuentePython: 'python3'
    orador:
      limiar: 0.5
      perfilPath: '~/.dsh/voz-perfil.json'
```

`~` is expanded in `workspace`, `statePath` and the other paths below.

| Key | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `attach` (bundle line); code default is `title` | `attach` for the `web` profile; `title` for the `acp` profile |
| `workspace` | `.` (the process working directory) | workspace that owns the voice session; set it to your workspace path |
| `title` | `conversa_copilot` | title pinned on the push-to-talk session |
| `marker` | none, required in `title` mode | first-line marker the bridge sends, e.g. `[conversa_copilot]` |
| `statePath` | `~/.dsh/voz-copilot.json` | durable link between the bridge and the session id |
| `pollMs` | `3000` | how often `attach` mode checks the link |
| `whisperUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:8178` | whisper-server used by dictation and by the slow path |
| `whisperFastUrl` | same as `whisperUrl` | faster whisper-server for conversation segments |
| `voz.persona` | a short spoken-answer instruction | prefix prepended to each spoken turn |
|

# dsh-ui-background

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-ui-background.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ui-background)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-ui-background.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A522.19-339933)](https://nodejs.org)

给 **DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端**加一层本地背景（图片 / 视频）+ 全界面毛玻璃。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

> 装完**必须重启一次 Host**（DSH 的模块解析表在启动时构建）。
> 状态：`0.8.2`，在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 上开发与验证。RC 阶段内部契约会变，升级 DSH 后请重新验收。

## 它是什么（以及为什么不卡）

毛玻璃**不靠扫描 DOM**，而是改官方主题令牌：

```js
ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-ui-background', {
  '--dsw-alias-bg-base':         { light: 'rgba(255,255,255,.62)', dark: '…' },
  '--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill': { light: '…', dark: '…' },
  // 另外 3 个抬升面 / 弹层令牌
})
```

DSH 的 `body`、主框架、侧栏本来就用这些令牌画背景，所以：

- 零 DOM 扫描、零 `MutationObserver`、零逐面板 `backdrop-filter`
- 关掉 = 撤销令牌层，界面**立刻回到出厂样式**，无残留
- 背景层是**一个** `position:fixed; z-index:-1` 的图层（图片走纯 CSS，视频走一个 `<video>`）

## 功能

- 背景来源：上传文件 / 本机路径（只读，不复制不移动）
- 视频背景：`mp4` / `webm` 循环播放，切到后台自动暂停
- 构图：`铺满(cover)` / `完整(contain)`、缩放 50–300%、水平/垂直位置，**预览里可直接拖动**
- 壁纸引擎：自动扫 Steam 工坊 `431960`，**只列出可直接播放的**（视频/图片）
- 最近使用：最多 12 条，带缩略图与**构图参数**，一键切回，可单条删除
- 上传文件可单个删除；删到正在用的那张会自动关掉背景
- 全部本地：不联网、不收集数据

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

**装完必须重启一次 Host**（DSH 的模块解析表在启动时构建，新装的包当次不可导入）。

重启后：设置 → **背景与玻璃**。

## 适合什么场景

- 用本地图片或视频当背景，界面跟着半透明
- 换图之后不用重新调构图：每条历史记录里都存着缩放与位置

做不到的：Wallpaper Engine 的 Scene 渲染。`scene.pkg` 需要它自己的引擎，本插件只读图片和视频文件。
## 已知限制

| 限制 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| Scene 壁纸不能当背景 | `scene.pkg` 是 Wallpaper Engine 私有格式，需要它的引擎渲染；包里没有现成图片 |
| 别拿 WE 预览图凑数 | 实测预览图只有 **144–254 px**，铺满 1920 宽会糊 7–13 倍 |
| 想要 WE 画面 → 截图 | 开着 WE，`Win+Shift+S` 截屏后点「粘贴截图」（1920×1080，清晰） |
| `mkv` / `mov` 可能不播 | Edge 不支持这些容器，用 `mp4` / `webm` |
| 半透明会影响所有用基础背景令牌的地方 | 代码块顶栏、图片占位、弹层遮罩都会跟着透明，这是同一套令牌的代价 |

## 安全

- Host 端只读**你在设置里显式填写的**那一个本机文件，以及 Steam 工坊目录里的 `project.json` / 媒体 / 预览图
- HTTP 路由仅回环；写操作拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`
- 上传目录内的文件名已净化，不接受路径穿越
- 状态存在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-ui-background/`（`state.json` + `backgrounds/`），卸载插件**不会**自动删除，请自行清理

## 开发

```bash
node selftest.mjs   # 用假 Cordis 上下文挂载 host 半身，直接打自己的 HTTP 处理器
```

`lib` 端只依赖 `node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:os`，没有 npm 运行时依赖。

## License

MIT
