> **本仓库不是原创作品。** 它是桌宠 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)（作者 **PC2005-cloud**，MIT）的**二次创作**，只做一件事：让上游桌宠在 **DeepSeek Harness 官方桌面端（Electron 版）** 装上、能启用、可管理。桌宠本体、动画素材、全部玩法与文档都来自上游，版权归原作者。 --- ## 📌 非原创声明 | 内容 | 归属 | | --- | --- | | 桌宠本体、106 段动画与素材、提示词、玩法（待机 / 漫游 / 拖拽抛掷 / 余额 / 碎碎念 / 对话 / 工作状态 / 系统通知 / pet pack） | 上游 **[PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)**（MIT） | | 官方桌面端适配层（`adapter/`）、组合包声明、上游产物同步与校验、安装 / 兼容 / 排障文档、测试 | 本仓库（基于上游的二次创作） | `vendor/` 内是上游 npm 发布版 `dsh-pet@0.3.7` 的已构建产物，`dsh-pet/assets/` 内是上游的动画与素材——本仓库没有、也不试图拥有上游的任何内容。按上游「二创约定」：任何介绍、展示、分发本仓库的地方，请保留上游作者地址 。 ## 🚀 安装（官方桌面端） 1. 桌面应用 → **插件管理 → 添加插件**； 2. 填本仓库地址： ```text https://github.com/zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop ``` （等价 pnpm spec：`github:zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop`） 3. 启用 `dsh-pet` 组合包，**重开桌面应用**。 默认只显示**一只**：窗口外那只透明置顶小窗（`display: desktop`）。想改成应用内 / 两只 / 不显示，见 [DESKTOP.md §12](DESKTOP.md) 或设置页「桌宠配置」。 ## ✅ 验证 桌宠加载后，DSH 自己的 Web 服务上会多一个只读接口： ```text GET http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-pet-desktop/health ``` 返回 `status: active`、`host.kind: desktop`、`upstream.applied: true` 即适配层与上游都已就绪（字段含义见 [DESKTOP.md §3](DESKTOP.md)）。 ## 📦 仓库结构 ```text adapter/ 适配层：宿主识别、运行时诊断、健康检查、失败降级 cordis.patch.yml 组合包声明（桌面端插件管理据此把它当插件） vendor/dsh-pet-0.3.7/ 上游已构建产物（免构建，SHA-256 逐文件校验） dsh-pet/assets/ 运行时素材（webm / 字体 / 表情包 / 默认配置） animations/webm/ 本仓库额外收录的动作素材（文件名即动作名） tests/ 清单、适配层纯逻辑、启动冒烟 DESKTOP.md 为什么需要、兼容矩阵、排障、版本记录 scripts/sync-vendor.mjs 上游产物同步与可审计补丁 ``` **不在本仓库**（都在上游）：`src/` 源码、素材生成链（提示词 + Python 脚本）、HTTP API 文档、生态清单、玩法与配置手册。 ## 🎞 额外动作 除了上游自带的 106 段动画，本仓库额外收录的动作放在 [`animations/webm/`](animations/README.md)——目录约定与上游一致（`webm/` 子目录 + **文件名即动作名**，VP9-alpha、640×360）： | 文件 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | [`animations/webm/非洲之心.webm`](animations/webm/非洲之心.webm) | 开保险箱、捧起钻石的 10 秒动作（用户自制，已去水印/去音频/抠成透明） | 装法、配置写法与转换参数见 [animations/README.md](animations/README.md)。 ## 🔗 功能、玩法、二次创作 → 去上游 - 功能与配置、动画与 pet pack、HTTP API、问题反馈： - 本仓库改了什么、兼容性与排障：[DESKTOP.md](DESKTOP.md) ## 许可 - 代码：MIT（上游版权归 **PC2005-cloud**；本仓库的适配改动同样以 MIT 提供） - 素材（动画 / 提示词 / 源视频）：允许开源使用，**禁止商用** - 二次创作：请保留上游作者地址 ## 版本 当前 `0.3.7-desktop.5`（基于上游 `dsh-pet@0.3.7`）。变更见 [DESKTOP.md §11](DESKTOP.md)。

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. plugins.description: Offline/online import-export and migration for DeepSeek Harness: profiles, plugins, skills, hooks, boards
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-portable

**Offline and online export/import for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): pack a whole working DSH home into one `.dshpkg` file and restore it on another machine — no network, no `pnpm install`, no manual path fixing.**

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) · [PUBLISHING](PUBLISHING.md) · [HANDOFF](HANDOFF.md)

---

## Why

Moving a DSH setup between machines is painful for three reasons:

1. A working profile is not one file. It is `profiles/<name>/` plus plugins **with their `node_modules`**, skills, hooks, task boards, storages, `AGENTS.md`, installed runtimes, and session logs.
2. Plugins are installed by pnpm from the network. An air-gapped machine, a locked-down corporate laptop, or a machine behind a dead proxy simply cannot run `dsh plugin add`.
3. Configuration files embed absolute paths (`C:\\Users\\me\\.dsh`, `/home/me/.dsh`) and the profile name, so copying the directory tree produces a DSH that boots with broken plugin paths.

dsh-portable solves all three: it packages a whitelist of roots into a single self-describing archive, refuses to walk outside that whitelist, and on import rewrites the six configuration files that actually contain machine-local paths.

## What goes into a package

| Root | Path | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| profile | `profiles/<name>` (config **and** plugin `node_modules`) | always |
| skills | `skills` | always |
| skills-disabled | `skills-disabled` | always |
| hooks | `hooks` | always |
| storages | `storages` | always |
| task boards | task-board / todo-board storage | always |
| browser host | dsh-builtin-browser-host | always |
| agent instructions | `AGENTS.md` | always |
| sessions | session logs | opt-in (`includeSessions`) |
| runtimes | downloaded runtimes | opt-in (`includeRuntimes`) |
| credentials | `.credentials.yaml` | **opt-in, off by default** |
| source maps | `*.map` inside the package | on (`includeSourceMaps`) |
| backups | `*.bak-*` next to config files | off (`includeBackups`) |

Anything not listed is never collected — there is no recursive "copy the whole home directory" step anywhere in the code.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-portable
```

The plugin has to be registered in the profile's own `package.json` — under `dependencies` **and** `dsh.profile.bundles`. Copying the package directory into `profiles/<profile>/node_modules` by hand looks like it works, until that profile runs `npm install` again: npm treats an undeclared package as extraneous and deletes it, and from then on the panel still renders its cards while every request answers `404`. `dsh plugin add` (or `npm install dsh-portable` inside the profile) writes both halves.

Then open **DSH settings → Portable Migration** (便携迁移). The panel is registered at `settings.section` with order 70, and is bilingual (zh/en) automatically.

Nothing is written to the DSH home until you press a button.

## Using the panel

Six cards:

1. **Export** — pick which optional roots to include, name the file, press Export. Packing runs in a worker thread; the progress bar streams entry counts, and a 20 MB package over ~14 000 entries takes about 3 seconds.
2. **Packages** — every `.dshpkg` under `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-portable/exports`, with size, entry count, manifest summary, and buttons: Import / Share / Delete (delete asks for confirmation).
3. **Upload** — drag or pick a `.dshpkg` and it is streamed to disk (`.part` then rename), so a 2 GB package never sits in memory.
4. **Import** — choose merge or replace, press *Preview* first (zero writes), then *Import* (explicit confirmation). The result lists applied items, rewritten files, backup location and warnings.
5. **LAN share** — publish a package as a one-shot download link (`http://<lan-ip>:<port>/d/<token>`). Defaults: **1 download, 60 minutes**, Range/HEAD supported, 410 on expiry or exhaustion. No relay, no cloud, no account.
6. **Backups** — the automatic pre-install backups (`<DSH_HOME>/portable-backups/<stamp>`), newest 5 kept.

## HTTP API

Base: `/dsh-portable/api`. All responses are JSON except the download route and the uploaded-file streaming route. Authentication reuses the host's `connection.requestRejection` fence (cookie + trusted origin), and falls back to a loopback-only check when that service is absent.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/status` | host info, package counts, active job, share server state |
| GET | `/profiles` | profiles present in this DSH home |
| GET | `/jobs` | recent jobs (export / preview / import) |
| GET | `/jobs/detail?id=` | one job with live progress |
| POST | `/jobs/cancel` | cancel a running job |
| POST | `/export` | start an export |
| GET | `/artifacts` | packages available for import |
| GET | `/artifacts/meta?id=` | manifest of one package |
| POST | `/artifacts/delete` | delete a package (confirmed in the UI) |
| PUT | `/upload/<name>` | stream an uploaded package to disk |
| POST | `/import/preview` | two-phase install, phase 1 (zero writes) |
| POST | `/import` | two-phase install, phase 2 (`confirm:true` required) |
| GET | `/backups` | automatic pre-install backups |
| POST | `/share` | mint a one-shot LAN download link |
| GET | `/share` | list live links |
| POST | `/share/remove` | revoke a link |

**Everywhere a package is named, the API takes an `artifactId` such as `exports:machine-20261018.dshpkg`, never a filesystem path.** `/`, `\\`, `..` and control characters are rejected, so neither the model nor a web page can use this plugin to read or write an arbitrary file.

## Model tools

Registered on the host tools service (silently skipped if the service is absent):

| Tool | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `portable_export` | package the current profile; returns id, size, entry count, per-root breakdown |
| `portable_inspect` | read a package manifest without importing |
| `portable_import` | **without `confirm:true` it is a dry run**; with it, performs the two-phase install |
| `portable_share` | mint a one-shot LAN link (1 download, 60 min) |

## CLI bootstrap (target machine without DSH)

```bash
# Windows
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 preview .\machine.dshpkg
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 install .\machine.dshpkg --yes

# macOS / Linux
sh bootstrap/install.sh preview ./machine.dshpkg
sh bootstrap/install.sh install ./machine.dshpkg --yes
```

Flags: `--home <dir>` (default `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`), `--profile <name>`, `--mode merge|replace`, `--keep <n>`, `--yes`. Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failure, `2` usage error. Without `--yes` on a non-TTY it refuses to write.

## Package format

`.dshpkg` is a gzipped tar. The manifest is the **first** entry:

```text
.dsh-portable/manifest.json
profiles/desktop/...
skills/...
hooks/hooks.json
...
```

```json
{
  "format": "dsh-portable/1",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-18T02:11:03.000Z",
  "tool": { "name": "dsh-portable", "version": "0.1.0" },
  "source": {
    "hostname": "WORKSTATION",
    "platform": "win32",
    "arch": "x64",
    "node": "v22.23.2",
    "dshHome": "C:\\Users\\me\\.dsh",
    "profile": "desktop"
  },
  "options": { "includeNodeModules": true, "includeSessions": false },
  "stats": { "entries": 13774, "files": 13482, "dirs": 292, "links": 0, "bytes": 20664511 },
  "roots": [{ "id": "skillsDisabled", "logical": "skills-disabled", "files": 13193, "bytes": 44615569 }]
}
```

Because it is a plain tar, `tar -xzf machine.dshpkg` works anywhere — you can inspect a package on a machine that has never heard of DSH. Long paths use PAX extended headers; the reader understands them incrementally, including PAX bodies that straddle chunk boundaries.

## Import pipeline

```text
preview:  read manifest ──► per-top counts + existsOnTarget ──► report (zero writes)
install:  extract to <home>/portable-staging/<stamp>
          ──► rename profile dir if the target profile name differs
          ──► rewrite local paths in the 6 config files
          ──► back up those 6 files to <home>/portable-backups/<stamp>
          ──► apply each top-level item (merge: add/overwrite; replace: move aside first)
          ──►

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that checks whether a voice note's transcript matches its audio (EmbeddingGemma cosine in a shared 768-d space) and searches the audio by meaning.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-escutar

A voice note has two records: the audio and the transcript. When the transcript
is wrong (wrong language, noise, text from another note), the mistake enters the
conversation silently. This plugin measures how far the transcript is from the
audio in the shared 768-dimensional space of EmbeddingGemma, and lets you search
the audio by meaning even when the transcript cannot be trusted.

It never transcribes again, never deletes and never rewrites a transcript: it
reads, measures and warns. Audio never leaves your machine.

## Install

Works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Open a terminal (PowerShell is fine on
Windows) and run:

```sh
# 1. pnpm — the harness manages profile plugins with it
npm install -g pnpm

# 2. add the plugin to your `web` profile
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-escutar

# 3. restart the harness: the bundle layer is read at boot
#    stop `dsh web` (Ctrl+C) and start it again
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-escutar`.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` also appends the
plugin row to the profile bundle list. That row is the only activation, and it
is applied at every boot. Nothing else to configure to install.

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command above (it resolves the repository again), then restart
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-escutar   # then restart
```

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the same range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` — the harness uses it to manage profile plugins.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself.
- **EmbeddingGemma CLI** reachable as an executable. The plugin calls
  `parecido <audio> <text> --simetrico` and
  `buscar <query> --indice <collection> --n <n>`. Point it with the
  `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN` environment variable or the `gemma` config key. If the
  binary is missing, the first measurement answers with an error naming that
  variable; the rest of the harness is unaffected.
- **A voice corpus**: one audio file and one transcript per note, sharing the
  id (`001.ogg` + `001.md`), either side by side or split into `audio/` and
  `texto/`.

The plugin itself has no native dependencies and no build step: plain ESM using
only Node built-ins.

## Usage

| Who | How | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| the agent | `conferir_transcricao` tool | check one note (`id`) or search the audio by meaning (`consulta`) |
| you | `/escutar` command | recent notes with a suspicious transcript |
| the agent | `agent/pre-step` hook | a short warning at the end of the conversation when a recent note is suspicious; nothing is appended when there is no suspicion, so it costs zero tokens |

```text
conferir_transcricao { "id": "001" }                               # is this note trustworthy?
conferir_transcricao { "consulta": "what did I say about backup" } # search the audio
/escutar                                                           # recent suspicious notes
```

### Verdicts

The verdict is the cosine between the audio vector and the transcript vector:

| Verdict | When |
|---|---|
| `suspeita` | cosine < **0.78** − 0.03 |
| `incerta` | inside the 0.03 band around the threshold |
| `confiavel` | cosine > 0.78 + 0.03 |
| `sem-medida` | no number (CLI failure, corrupt cache) |

A note on the edge of the threshold is reported as `incerta` on purpose: it is
neither an alarm nor a pass.

## Configuration

Every key falls back to a default, so a wrong config never breaks the plugin.
Override the row by `id` in your profile patch
(`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`; on Windows,
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`). A patch **replaces the
whole config of the row**, so restate every key you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: escutar
  config:
    corpus: '/path/to/voice-corpus'
    cache: '/path/to/discordancia.json'
    gemma: '/path/to/embeddinggemma'
    limiar: 0.78
    banda: 0.03
    maxAvisos: 2
    colecaoAudio: 'escutar-audio-gemma-v1'
    tempoLimiteMs: 120000
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `workspace` | package directory | base for the `corpus` and `cache` defaults |
| `corpus` | `<workspace>/corpus` | folder with the audio/transcript pairs |
| `cache` | `<workspace>/estado/discordancia.json` | cache read by `/escutar` and the hook |
| `gemma` | `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN`, then `~/.local/bin/embeddinggemma` (`embeddinggemma.exe` on Windows) | EmbeddingGemma CLI |
| `limiar` | `0.78` | cosine below which the transcript is suspicious |
| `banda` | `0.03` | uncertainty margin around the threshold |
| `maxAvisos` | `2` | maximum lines the hook appends; `0` disables it |
| `colecaoAudio` | `escutar-audio-gemma-v1` | index name used by `consulta` |
| `tempoLimiteMs` | `120000` | timeout for one CLI call |

The `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN` variable is used when `gemma` is not set in the
config. The package carries no machine-specific path.

### Index and cache

The plugin reads two artifacts; it does not build them:

1. **Audio index** (`colecaoAudio`, default `escutar-audio-gemma-v1`) — needed
   only by `conferir_transcricao` with `consulta`. Build it with the
   EmbeddingGemma CLI:

   ```sh
   embeddinggemma indexar /path/to/corpus/audio \
     --nome escutar-audio-gemma-v1 --ext ogg,opus,mp3,wav,m4a
   ```

   The audio encoder reads roughly the first 30 seconds of each file. If you
   need long notes sliced into windows, slice them before indexing.

2. **Discordance cache** (`cache`) — needed by `/escutar` and the hook. It is a
   JSON file written by your indexing pipeline:

   ```json
   {
     "gerado_em": "2026-10-13T12:00:00+00:00",
     "notas": [
       {
         "id": "001",
         "cosseno": 0.84,
         "transcricao": "first 200 characters of the transcript",
         "mtime": "2026-10-13T11:59:00+00:00",
         "mtime_texto": "2026-10-13T11:59:00+00:00",
         "janelas": [0.84],
         "segundos": 12
       }
     ]
   }
   ```

   `mtime` and `mtime_texto` are the modification times of the audio and the
   transcript when the cosine was measured. The tool checks them on every read:
   a cache without them, or older than the files on disk, is not served as
   current — the note is measured again on the spot. The hook only warns about
   notes whose `mtime` is within the last 48 hours.

Without an index or a cache, `conferir_transcricao` with `id` still works: it
measures the pair live (about 11 s to load the model, plus a few seconds per
note). `/escutar` and the hook stay quiet and say what is missing.

## Verification

After the restart, dump the profile config and look for the row:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

```text
# == dsh-escutar
- id: escutar
  name: dsh-escutar
```

Then ask the agent to call `conferir_transcricao` with `{"id": "001"}` (or run
`/escutar` when the cache exists). A live measurement returns the cosine, the
verdict and the transcript read from the cache.

From a source checkout, run the test suite:

```sh
npm test
```

The suite covers the verdict band, the CLI output parser, the cache freshness
guards, the command, the hook and the missing-binary error. It uses shell stubs,
so it runs on Linux and macOS; installing the plugin does not depend on it.

## Limits

- **The audio encoder reads about 30 seconds.** A long note is judged by a
  window, not by the whole recording.
- **A plausible but wrong transcript can pass.** Swapping one word for another
  word on the same subject may not move the cosine below the threshold. The
  signal catches gross errors: wrong language, noise, text from another note.
- **It does not judge the content.** It only says whether the audio and the text
  talk about the same thing in the same semantic space.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: In-place selection translation for DeepSeek Harness — right-click selected text to replace it with Chinese, right-click again to restore the original. 右键划词翻译，再次右键还原。
plugins.readme_text:
# 划词翻译 · DSH Selection Translator

在 **DeepSeek Harness Web UI** 里选中文字后右键，菜单中除了「复制」还会多出「翻译成中文」。点击后，选中的英文会在原位置直接被中文替换；再次右键被翻译的文字，菜单变为「取消翻译」，点击即可还原原文。

![plugin icon](icon.svg)

## 功能

- 选中文字右键 → **复制 / 翻译成中文**
- 翻译结果**就地覆盖**选区，不弹窗、不新增消息
- 被翻译的片段带点状下划线，再次右键 → **取消翻译** 还原原文
- 中英混合选区会整体翻译成中文
- 菜单文案固定为中文（不跟随界面语言）

## 安装

发布到 npm 后，在 Harness 的插件管理器中安装：

```
dsh-selection-translator
```

本地开发时，克隆仓库后在插件管理器中从本地目录安装，或把该目录加为 profile 的依赖。

安装后会同时挂载 Harness 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator`，用于提供匿名翻译服务，无需账号或 API Key。

## 使用

1. 在对话、工具输出或任意可选中的文本上拖选内容。
2. 在选区上点右键，选择「翻译成中文」。
3. 中文就地覆盖原文。
4. 对中文片段再次右键，选择「取消翻译」恢复原文。

## 隐私

选中的文本会离开本机，发往 Harness 的匿名翻译提供方（当前为 Microsoft Bing 的 Edge 翻译端点）。本插件自身不保存原文或译文，也不会随翻译请求发送会话 ID；翻译由 Harness 的 `translator` 服务完成，结果不落盘。

如果文本涉及敏感信息，请不要使用翻译功能。

## 已知限制

- 按段落/文本节点分别翻译，长文本会自动分段，翻译过程中菜单里显示进度条；极短片段（尤其是被行内代码切开的两段）译文可能不如整段通顺。
- 完整选中的段落会保留段落、标题、列表和行内代码/代码块；加粗、链接等不承载代码语义的内联样式会被拍平。
- 消息被 React 重新渲染（例如流式输出或切换会话）时，翻译片段可能丢失，原文会重新出现；重新翻译即可。
- 插件会插入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator` 行；如果其他 bundle 也挂载了 translator，可能产生服务冲突。
- 百度翻译的公开接口需要 appid 和签名，本插件没有使用百度。

## 工作原理

- `client.js`：在 `shell.overlay` 槽位注册浮动菜单。Electron 桌面端的「复制」菜单由主进程生成，仅靠 DOM 的 `preventDefault()` 无法压制，因此右键按下时先保存选区再清空选区，让原生菜单没有可显示条目。
  - 完整选中的段落整段翻译，行内代码/代码块用占位符保留并原样放回；不完整的段落按文本节点逐段替换，保留原有 DOM 结构。
  - 长文本按 8 个片段一批发送，菜单里显示进度条；关闭菜单会取消进行中的翻译。
- `index.js`：Host 半注册同源路由 `POST /api/dsh/selection-translator`，调用 Harness 的 `translator` 服务把文本翻译成中文；超过 3500 字符的片段会自动切块翻译后拼接。
- `cordis.patch.yml`：同时挂载 translator 服务和本插件。

## 开发与发布

见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)；上架 DSH 插件市场见 [MARKET.md](MARKET.md)。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) client plugin: live account balance plus the current DeepSeek billing window (peak / off-peak) in the sidebar footer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-chip

**Two rows in the DSH sidebar footer:** your live account balance, and the current DeepSeek billing window (peak / off-peak) with the clock time that window ends.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [Agent install guide](AGENT-INSTALL.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

```
┌─ sidebar footer ─────────────────┐
│  Balance                  ¥12.34 │  ← balance row
│  Off-peak          ends 09:00    │  ← billing-window row
│  🟣 account                      │  ← built-in account entry
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```

The balance row sits directly above the avatar / account row, the billing row right under it. Both register in the `sidebar.footer.action` list slot, so nothing in the built-in UI is replaced or wrapped.

> Why not inside the avatar row: that row is `settings.trigger`, a `single` slot already owned by `dsh-client-ui-settings-general`. `sidebar.footer.action` is the nearest free list slot in the same bottom-left block.

## What it shows

| | |
|---|---|
| **Balance** | Live wallet total from the same `account` Remote that Settings → Account uses. Bonus wallets are appended as `+¥0.50`; amounts truncate to cents with thousands separators; sub-cent amounts show `<¥0.01`. A failed read keeps the last number instead of blanking the row. |
| **Billing window** | `Peak` (amber) or `Off-peak` (green), plus when it ends — `12:00`, `tomorrow 09:00`, `Mon 09:00`, `Mar 3 09:00`. |
| **Hover** | Three short lines: state + countdown, the reason (peak windows / weekend / statutory holiday), then the pricing note and what a click does. |
| **Click** | Balance row opens your usage page (URL comes from the account state stream). Billing row opens the official pricing page. |
| **Collapsed sidebar** | Balance shows only the amount; billing shows only `Peak` / `Idle`. |

Every state renders something visible — loading `…`, signed out, no wallet, read failure — so "the plugin did not load" and "the plugin loaded but has no data" never look the same.

## Billing windows

The billing row mirrors DeepSeek's published rule, **in Beijing time (UTC+8)**:

- **Peak:** Monday–Friday, 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, **excluding Chinese statutory holidays**.
- **Off-peak:** everything else — 12:00–14:00, after 18:00, weekends, and holidays all day.
- Off-peak pricing is half of peak.

Sources: [Model & Pricing (EN)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) · [模型 & 价格 (中文)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) · 2026 holiday dates from [国务院办公厅关于 2026 年部分节假日安排的通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7047091.htm) (国办发明电〔2025〕7号). Pricing and windows can change — the official page is authoritative.

The judgement is pure local arithmetic (`Date.now()` plus the rule above), computed entirely in Beijing wall-clock time, so the result does **not** depend on the machine's time zone. On a machine outside UTC+8, the row prefixes `Beijing ` and the hover adds the local equivalent.

The statutory holiday table is compiled in (`lib/client.js`, `HOLIDAY_TABLE`) and currently covers 2026. Weekends moved to working days still count as weekends, so no separate adjustment table is needed. For a year the table does not cover yet, the plugin falls back to weekday-only rules and says so in the hover.

## Install

Requirements: DSH 0.2.x, and Python 3 for the installer. Node.js is optional — only the offline tests need it.

### Let an agent do it

Hand the repository, or the release zip, to your assistant and point it at [`AGENT-INSTALL.md`](AGENT-INSTALL.md). That guide covers environment checks, offline verification, installation, activation, reporting back, troubleshooting, rollback, and a no-Python manual path.

### By hand

```bash
python3 install.py          # macOS / Linux
python install.py           # Windows
```

The installer scans `$DSH_HOME/profiles/*` (default `~/.dsh/profiles`), copies four files into `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-balance-chip/`, and appends one `insert` entry to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It does not touch the profile's `package.json` or `dsh.profile.bundles`, uses no network, and is idempotent.

Useful flags:

```bash
python3 install.py --list           # show detected profiles, change nothing
python3 install.py --profile web    # install into one profile (repeatable)
python3 install.py --uninstall      # remove the entry, keep the package
python3 install.py --purge          # also delete the package directory
```

Then let it take effect: press `Ctrl+R` / `Cmd+R` in the window first; if that is not enough, fully quit and reopen DSH (macOS `⌘Q` — closing the window does not quit the process).

From a release zip: unzip `dsh-balance-chip-<version>.zip`, then run the same command inside it.

## Configuration

Every field of an entry's `config` is optional; an invalid value falls back to the default instead of hiding the row.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: balance-chip
      name: "dsh-balance-chip"
      config:
        windows: ["09:00-12:00", "14:00-18:00"]   # Beijing time; [[540,720],[840,1080]] also accepted
        weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]                 # days treated as working days (0 = Sunday)
        holidays: ["2027-01-01", "2027-02-06"]    # extra dates, union with the built-in table
        ignoreHolidays: false                     # true = ignore holidays entirely
        zoneOffsetMinutes: 480                    # time zone the rule is defined in
        pricingUrl: "https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing"
```

## How it works

- **Two client rows, one host stub.** `lib/client.js` is the browser half: it renders both rows, reads the balance over the existing `account` Remote (`getBalance` for the value, `watch` for sign-in state and the usage URL) and computes the billing window locally. `lib/index.js` is the host half — it exists because the loader also imports every package on the host side, and it carries only a load probe.
- **One slot, ordered by `order`.** Balance `order: 10`, billing `order: 20`, both in `sidebar.footer.action` (`kind: list`, `scope: root`).
- **Pure function, thin component.** `periodAt` / `describeChip` are side-effect-free and exported as `exports.period`; the component only prints their output. The loader reads `apply` / `inject` and ignores the extra export.
- **No network, no credentials, no host code.** The only outbound action is `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")` on click. The only host-side write is a `/tmp` load probe wrapped in `try/catch`.
- **Theme tokens only.** Colours come from `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so light and dark themes both work.

## Compatibility

Developed against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `4.0.4` — the versions that ship with the desktop build it was tested on. The package declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer dependency, so DSH's compatibility gate does not block it; what it needs at runtime is the `sidebar.footer.action` slot and the `slots` / `locale` / `remote.account` services.

## Development

```bash
node test-client.cjs .                       # balance row, fake Remote, no browser
node test-peak.cjs .                         # schedule, strings, tooltip layout
TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati node test-peak.cjs .   # same conclusions in another zone
```

Both suites are offline: a minimal React-hooks runtime, a fake `ctx`, and a fake `account` Remote. `test-peak.cjs` covers window boundaries, overnight and weekend spans, every 2026 holiday block, config fallbacks and tooltip line lengths, and prints a `SCHEDULE-FINGERPRINT` line that must be identical across time zones.

## Version history

| Version | Date | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1.1.1 | 2026-10-15 | Hover tooltips split into short lines; `aria-label` now a separate single line |
| 1.1.0 | 2026-10-14 | Added the billing-window row (peak / off-peak, end time, holiday table, config) |
| 1.0.0 | 2026-10-14 | Balance row only |

## Credits

Built by **Ivan Chen** and **[HugePaint](https://github.com/HugePaint)**.

Not affiliated with DeepSeek. The windows and prices it displays are DeepSeek's; the plugin only reproduces the published rule locally.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Ivan Chen, HugePaint

plugins.description: DSH 交接鏈面板：把互相交接的對話聚成一條鏈（卡片／編號／面板／HUD／門檻提醒／自動交接）
plugins.readme_text:
# session-chains — 交接鏈面板 for DSH

把「互相交接的對話」自動聚成一條**鏈**：左側欄一張卡片列出每條鏈、每場對話編號，
點一下切過去；快到上下文上限時提醒你交接，設定打開的話連「開新對話＋貼提示詞＋切過去」都自己做完。

> 這是 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/) 的外掛（host 端 `index.mjs` ＋ 瀏覽器端 `client.js`），
> 以 `file://` 掛進 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`，不改內建側邊欄、不動 profile。

---

## 為什麼要做

拆對話是省 token 最有效的手段（同一條工作線實測可省約 71%），但代價是側邊欄散成一堆看不出關係的對話框。
而「哪幾場是同一條線」其實**已經寫在日誌裡** —— 只差沒有人把它讀出來：

- 接手的那一場，交接提示詞是使用者貼進去的**第一句話**；
- 交出的那一場，同一份文字是**助理產出的**。

兩側都落在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<工作區>/<session>/session.v*.jsonl.zstd`。
所以只要提示詞裡有一行 `鏈=<代號>`，兩邊就都認得出來，面板自動分組 —— 不必手動歸類。

## 長什麼樣

| 位置 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| 左側欄卡片 | 每條鏈一列，展開是各場對話（`001`、`002`…），右側三顆：收合／暫停／開面板 |
| 面板（浮層） | 全部鏈、搜尋、拖拉／多選歸鏈、四鍵排序（名稱／建立／場次數／最後活動） |
| 置頂／封存（2026-10-19） | 面板每列的 📌 把鏈釘在卡片最上面（不受排序影響）；🗄 封存＝從卡片收起，面板的「封存庫 N」才看得到、也才還原得回去 |
| 輸入框上方 HUD | `本場 320k/210` ＝ 這一場的上下文／請求數，達門檻才變色 |
| ⚙ 設定 | 字級、四組顏色、卡片圖示、HUD 五段開關、**交接門檻**、自動交接 |

> **置頂與封存存在哪**：跟改名同一份 `aliases.json`（`pinned`／`archived` 兩個清單），不是瀏覽器 localStorage，
> 所以換瀏覽器、重開 DSH 都還在；改名之後置頂也跟著走（讀寫時都會過對照表）。
> 封存**不動任何 session 日誌**，只是不在卡片顯示。封存的鏈若又交接出新場次，**留在封存庫**（不會自己跳回卡片）。

## 安裝

需要 DSH（桌面版或 web 版都可以）。兩種裝法，選一種：

**A. 從插件市場／`dsh plugin add`（repo 根目錄就是套件根）**

```bash
# 發佈到 npm 之後：
dsh plugin --profile web add session-chains
# 或直接從 GitHub：
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HildebrandYu/dsh-session-chains
```

**B. 直接掛本機資料夾（開發用，改檔即重載）**

```bash
git clone <this-repo> dsh-session-chains
cd dsh-session-chains

node scripts/install.mjs            # dry-run：只寫 .preview/，讓你先看補丁長什麼樣
node scripts/install.mjs --apply    # 真的掛上（會先備份 $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml）
node scripts/install.mjs --remove --apply   # 整包移除
```

掛好後**重新整理 GUI 一次**就會出現卡片。移除時它會把自己那兩段（插件列＋HMR 監看）一起清掉。

> **套件結構**：`package.json` 在 repo 根（市集與 `dsh plugin add` 只讀這個），裡面宣告
> `dsh.bundle.patch = ./cordis.patch.yml`（沒有這個就無法安裝，只宣告 `dsh.client` 不算）
> 與 `dsh.client.platform = web`；程式本體在 `plugin/`，`exports` 指過去。
> 本機用 file:// 直掛時，載入器會從 `plugin/index.mjs` 往上找到根目錄的 `package.json`。

> `install.mjs` 會寫兩段：`session-chains`（插件本體）與 `session-chains-hmr`（把 `plugin/` 加進 HMR 的監看根目錄，
> 沒有這段改 `index.mjs` 不會生效）。兩段都用哨兵包住，可重複執行。

## 使用

1. **平常**：照常工作。交接過的對話會自己出現在同一條鏈裡。
2. **要交接時**：面板上按「生成交接詞」→ AI 寫交接單與提示詞 → 按「開新對話」自動開＋貼＋送出＋切換。
3. **到門檻**：畫面會跳提醒（warn 可延後 30 分鐘、hard 只能延後 5 分鐘）。
   打開 ⚙ 的「到達門檻自動交接」，hard 會在這一輪結束後**自己**做完上面第 2 步。

## 門檻（預設值與怎麼選）

| 訊號 | 提醒（warn） | 強制（hard） |
|---|---|---|
| 請求數 | ≥ 200 | ≥ 320 |
| 上下文 tokens | ≥ 320k | ≥ 480k |
| 佔模型視窗比例 | ≥ 50% | ≥ 65% |

- **warn 是提示**（只顯示，不動作）；**hard 才是緊急煞車**（設了自動交接才會出手）。
- 預設值是回放 42 場真實對話訂出來的：舊的 80／120、160k／240k 會在 25/42 場觸發
  （觸發時中位還剩 103 步＝一定半路被切）；現在只在 6/42 場觸發，都是 300 步以上或 470k 以上的長場。
- 比例那一列是給**換模型**用的：1M 視窗下幾乎不會先觸發，換成 200k 視窗的模型時它會自動先擋。
- 全部可在 ⚙ 改，或直接改 localStorage 的 `dsh.session-chains.settings`。

## 運作原理（三個判定）

| 訊號 | 規則 | 例子 |
|---|---|---|
| 接手 1 | 第一句話有明確標記 | `鏈=my-project` |
| 接手 2 | 舊式提示詞 | `接續 my-project：讀 …` |
| 接手 3 | 第一句話裡的專案路徑 | `30-CodingSkills/my-project` |
| 交出 | **助理訊息裡「整行就是標記」** | 產出的提示詞那一行 |
| — | 都沒有 → 未標記 | 一般對話 |

「交出」那一條刻意嚴格（行首就是標記）：實測一場正在討論本功能的對話，助理推理裡
`鏈=…` 這種字串出現 23 次（全在行內），寬鬆比對會把一般對話誤認成鏈的起點。

## 測試

```bash
node --test scripts/          # 單元測試（純函式：鏈判定、編號、改名、建議歸鏈）
node scripts/smoke.mjs        # 端到端：在沙箱裡跑 client bundle，檢查面板／卡片／交接流程
node scripts/verify.mjs       # 靜態：manifest、bundle 形式、補丁現況
DSH_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:51714 node scripts/probe.mjs   # 實機：宿主是否已把 bundle 組進 boot graph
```

`scripts/smoke.mjs` 不需要真的 DSH：它自己造假的宿主 API（sessions、workspace、fetch、localStorage），
所以 CI 也能跑。

## 已知限制

- **只支援 DSH**：它讀的是 DSH 自己的 session 日誌格式（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），換宿主就得改 `chains.mjs`。
- **紅點還沒有資料來源**：宿主目前沒有「這一場失敗了」的狀態可讀，所以失敗圓點先留空。
- **手動「交接→新對話」在沒有交接詞時會顯示兩步錯誤**（設計如此：先按「生成交接詞」）。
- 鏈的判定靠提示詞裡的標記；沒用過交接指令的舊對話會落在「未標記」，可在面板上逐一歸鏈。

## 授權

MIT，見 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: DSH Desktop 右上角电源菜单：关闭 / 重启整个应用。Windows only, MIT.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-power-menu 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加一个右上角电源按钮：点开只有 **关闭DSH** 和 **重启DSH** 两项，省得每次改完插件/配置还要去系统托盘里翻「退出」。 > Windows 专用 · 只支持 DSH Desktop · 纯本地 · 无外部依赖 · MIT > > ⭐ 如果这个小工具帮你省了点时间，欢迎点个 **Star** 支持一下，感谢～ ![dsh-power-menu 菜单截图](docs/screenshot.png) ## 为什么做这个 DSH Desktop 关窗口只是收进托盘，真正退出或重启要走托盘菜单；而改插件、改配置之后又经常需要重启一次。这个插件把这两步搬到会话标题栏右上角：一个电源键，两项操作，点完就走。 ## 功能 - **右上角电源按钮**：位于会话标题栏图标行最右侧，顺序为「布局 / 侧栏 / 电源」。 - **空会话也显示**：欢迎页和对话内使用同一个挂载位置，透明无底色，不会破坏主题，也不会出现两个按钮。 - **Windows 电源菜单风格**：白色圆角卡片、悬浮阴影、左侧线性图标 + 右侧文本，只有两项，不塞多余入口。 - **关闭DSH**：结束整个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用（Electron 主进程 + Host），不重新启动。 - **重启DSH**：结束整个应用，等旧端口释放后用原可执行文件重新拉起，窗口自动回来。 - **键盘可用**：`↑` / `↓` / `Home` / `End` 在两项间移动，`Enter` / 空格执行，`Esc` 关闭，点菜单外部也能关。 - **执行反馈**：点击后整页盖一层半透明遮罩，显示「正在关闭DSH…」/「正在重启DSH…」。 - **纯本地**：没有外部依赖、没有遥测；接口只监听本机回环地址，并做同源校验。 ## 安装 ### 方式 A：通过 DSH 插件管理器（推荐） 1. 打开 DSH Desktop 的 **插件 / 插件市场**。 2. 选择 **添加插件**，输入： ```text github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` 3. 安装完成后重启一次 DSH。 4. 在 **插件市场 → 已安装** 里确认 `dsh-power-menu` 处于「启用中」。 > 如果装完点按钮报 `HTTP 404`，说明插件只进了 `dependencies`、没进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，宿主半没加载。运行仓库里的 `enable.ps1`（右键使用 PowerShell 运行），它会先备份 profile，再把 `dsh-power-menu` 补进 `dsh.profile.bundles`；然后重启 DSH。 ### 方式 B：命令行安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` > `dsh` 是 DSH 自带的 CLI；如果 PATH 里没有，请用 DSH 安装目录里的 `dsh` / `dsh.cmd`。 ### 方式 C：本地开发安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/xichen-62/dsh-power-menu.git ``` 把插件链接进 desktop profile： ```powershell # Windows PowerShell $profileDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop" New-Item -ItemType Junction ` -Path "$profileDir\node_modules\dsh-power-menu" ` -Target "<你 clone 下来的目录>" ``` 然后在 `$profileDir\package.json` 里： - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-power-menu": "link:<你 clone 下来的目录>"` - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-power-menu"` 重启 DSH 生效。这个插件没有构建步骤，改完 `lib/` 里的文件重启即可。 ## 使用 1. 在会话标题栏右上角点电源图标。 2. 选择 **关闭DSH** 或 **重启DSH**。 3. 等待遮罩出现：关闭会退出应用；重启会在几秒后把窗口拉回来。 | 动作 | 结果 | 需要手动重开？ | | --- | --- | --- | | 关闭DSH | 结束整个桌面应用，不重新启动 | 是 | | 重启DSH | 结束应用 → 等端口释放 → 重新拉起 | 否，窗口自动回来 | > **注意**：点击即执行，没有二次确认。两个动作都会中断正在生成的回答、运行中的工具和后台任务。请在点之前保存手头的事情。 ## 工作原理 桌面版的进程树大致是： ```text Electron 主进程 └── Host 子进程（dsh-desktop-host，ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1） └── 本插件 ``` 插件跑在 Host 里，不能直接调用 Electron 的 `app.quit()` / `app.relaunch()`。所以 Host 只负责“交接”，真正的进程切换交给一个分离的 helper： ```mermaid flowchart LR UI[电源菜单] -->|POST| Host[Host 插件] Host -->|写 handoff + spawn| Helper[detached helper] Helper -->|taskkill /PID main /F
不带 /T| Main[Electron 主进程] Main -.->|IPC 断开| Host Host -->|application.shutdown| Disk[(会话日志落盘)] Helper -->|等端口释放 + 重新拉起| NewMain[新的 Electron 主进程] ``` 具体步骤： 1. Host 把交接信息写到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\`，用 `process.execPath` + `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 启动 `lib/helper.cjs`。 2. helper 等 1.2 秒，让 HTTP 应答先到浏览器。 3. helper 执行 `taskkill /PID <主进程> /F`，**刻意不带 `/T`**：只结束 Electron 主进程，让 Host 子进程有机会收到 IPC 断开。 4. Host 检测到断开后走自己的 `application.shutdown`，尽量把会话日志正常落盘。 5. 重启模式下，helper 等旧监听端口释放，清掉 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` / `DSH_DESKTOP_NODE_EXECUTABLE`，用原可执行文件重新拉起，并确认新进程存活；失败会重试，仍失败就弹窗提示手动打开。 6. 关闭模式下不拉起，等 Host 自己退出。 ### 接口 Host 半注册三个仅限本机回环的接口： ```text POST /api/dsh-power-menu/shutdown POST /api/dsh-power-menu/restart GET /api/dsh-power-menu/health ``` ## 安全 - 三个接口只接受回环地址（`127.0.0.1` / `::1`），校验 `Host` 必须是本机，拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`，带 `Origin` 时必须与本机同源。 - 没有鉴权令牌的第三方网页无法跨站触发关机/重启。 - 只支持桌面版；`dsh web` 下接口返回 409，不会去杀别的进程。 - 不收集任何数据，不联网，不写注册表；日志只写在本地 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\`。 ## 兼容性 - **系统**：Windows 10 / 11。插件依赖 `taskkill` 和 Electron 桌面进程树，其他系统未实现。 - **DSH**：在 **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2** 上实测通过（2026-10-18）。其他 0.2.x 版本可能可用，但未逐一验证。 - **Node**：跟随 DSH 自带的 Node（22+），无需单独安装。 ## 开发 ```text dsh-power-menu/ ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js Host 半：三个回环接口 + 交接调度 │ ├── client.js 浏览器半：window.__ModuleLoader__ bundle │ └── helper.cjs 分离的交接 helper ├── cordis.patch.yml bundle 插入层 ├── package.json ├── docs/screenshot.png └── README.md ``` - 客户端 bundle 不是普通 ESM，必须用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 格式；`dsh.client.inject` 声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`。 - 没有构建步骤，也没有运行时 npm 依赖。 - 提交前跑一次静态检查： ```bash npm run check ``` - 本地调试日志：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\power-menu.log` 和 `helper-*.log`。 ## 常见问题 **按钮没出现？** 确认插件处于「启用中」，并重启过一次 DSH；按钮只出现在有会话标题栏的页面。 **插件卡片上没显示介绍？** 本地开发（link 安装）的插件，卡片不读 `package.json` 的 `description`，需要在卡片上点「添加备注」自己填。这是 DSH 插件管理器的行为，不是插件的问题。 **重启后端口变了？** 正常。DSH Desktop 每次启动用随机端口（`--port 0`），插件只负责拉起新实例，不假设端口不变。 **点了没反应？** 看 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\` 下的日志；`dsh web` 环境会返回 409（仅支持桌面版）。 **装完点按钮报 `HTTP 404`？** 说明宿主半没加载：插件只在 `dependencies` 里，不在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里。运行仓库里的 `enable.ps1`，或手动把 `dsh-power-menu` 加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，再重启 DSH。0.1.9 起不再依赖 `postinstall`——pnpm 11 默认会拦截依赖的生命周期脚本，装不上钩子。 ## 卸载 - 插件管理器里移除 `dsh-power-menu`，或者从 profile 的 `dependencies` / `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉，再删掉 `node_modules` 里的链接。 - 可选：删除 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\` 下的日志与交接文件。 - 重启 DSH 生效。 ## 更新日志 见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 xichen-62 ## 致谢 - 分离 helper 做进程交接、只结束主进程让 Host 优雅退出的思路，参考了 [dsh-desktop-restart](https://github.com/luoshuizhiwei/dsh-desktop-restart)（MIT）。本项目的实现是独立编写的。 - 菜单样式参考 Windows 电源菜单；图标为内联 SVG，无第三方图标库。 --- ## English A small DSH Desktop plugin that adds a power button to the top-right of the session header. It opens a Windows-style menu with exactly two actions: - **关闭DSH** — quit the whole desktop app (no relaunch). - **重启DSH** — quit and relaunch the app, so the window comes back automatically. Windows only, DSH Desktop only. No telemetry, no external dependencies; the three HTTP routes are loopback-only and same-origin fenced. Install from GitHub: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` or add `github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu` in the DSH plugin manager, then restart DSH. If this saves you some time, a ⭐ **star** is much appreciated. Thanks! MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Force the model's internal reasoning to Simplified Chinese for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-thinking-zh

让 DeepSeek Harness 里模型的**内部思考（reasoning / thinking）使用简体中文**的提示词汉化包。

> 非官方插件，与 DeepSeek 无关。英文说明见 [README.en.md](README.en.md)。

## 它做什么

- 向 DSH 的系统提示词注册一个固定段落（`dsh-thinking-zh:reasoning-language`），要求模型：
  - 所有内部思考与推理一律使用简体中文；
  - 代码、命令、路径、API 名、错误原文、专有名词保持原样；
  - 中文推理不得省略步骤、降低严谨度；
  - 只约束内部思考，最终回复仍按用户语言；
  - 用户在当前对话中明确要求换语言时，以用户要求为准。
- 只改提示词，不改 DSH 程序文件、不改 UI、不发网络请求。

## 为什么这样兼容后续版本

- 只用 DSH 公开的 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` API，不 import 任何 DSH 内部模块；
- 声明 `inject = ['systemPrompt']`：未来版本若没有该服务，插件静默不激活，不会让宿主启动失败；
- 段落 `order` 用固定数字 `6000`，不依赖未来版本可能改动的顺序表；
- 注册过程全部包在 try/catch 中，失败只写一条警告；
- 插件被禁用/卸载时通过 `ctx.effect` 移除段落（老版本没有该 API 时只是不清理）；
- 纯 ESM、零运行时依赖、无客户端（client）部分，不与 UI 版本耦合。

提示词是逐次请求重新组装的；本插件注册的是**常量文本**，不会改变其余提示词，也不会在两次请求之间抖动。

## 安装

从 npm：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-thinking-zh
```

从本地 tarball：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:/path/to/dsh-thinking-zh-0.1.0.tgz"
```

然后确认 profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `"dsh-thinking-zh"`，**完全退出并重开 DSH**。

## 配置（可关闭）

默认开启。不想用时不必卸载，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行即可关闭：

```yaml
- id: dsh-thinking-zh
  name: dsh-thinking-zh
  config:
    enabled: false
```

## 卸载

从 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 与 `dependencies` 中删掉 `dsh-thinking-zh`，
再执行 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH 即可。它不写入任何用户数据。

## 目录

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主插件：注册系统提示词段落 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：把自己插入 profile 的组合 |
| `package.json` | 包声明，`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向上面的 patch |
| `README.en.md` | 英文说明 |
| `LICENSE` | MIT 许可证 |

## 安全说明

- 无网络、无文件读写、无子进程、无凭据访问；
- 只新增一段提示词，不覆盖、不删除任何已有段落；
- 段落名带命名空间前缀，避免与其他插件冲突。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness provider for a copilot-api gateway
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-copilot-api

[Chinese](README.zh-CN.md)

DeepSeek Harness provider for a copilot-api gateway. Tested with Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-copilot-api
```

Restart Harness after the first install. The package inserts entry `copilot-api-provider`. No profile configuration is required.

Defaults:

- `baseURL`: `http://localhost:4141` (with or without `/v1`)
- `protocol`: `openai-responses`
- credential reference: `GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY`

Save the key in the Models card with **Save API key**, in Harness credentials, or in the launch environment of that name. Configuration stores the reference name, not the key.

Use `anthropic-messages` as `protocol` for Messages.

## Change the connection

Override the inserted entry only when a default is wrong. Keep the id `copilot-api-provider`, and restate every connection field you still need:

```yaml
- id: copilot-api-provider
  config:
    baseURL: http://localhost:4141
    apiKey: GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY
    protocol: openai-responses
    modelRefreshInterval: 120000
```

`apiKey` is a credential reference. `apiKeyEnv` is the same kind of name; when both are set, they must match. `headers` can be set to custom request headers. `modelRefreshInterval` is in milliseconds and defaults to `120000` (automatic refresh every 2 minutes); set it to `0` to disable periodic refresh.

## From a checkout

```sh
cd /absolute/path/dsh-copilot-api
bun install
bun run build
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-copilot-api
```

Model mapping and overrides: [docs/models.md](docs/models.md). Headers and sessions: [docs/headers.md](docs/headers.md). Development: [docs/development.md](docs/development.md).

plugins.description: Session-scoped context window selector for the DeepSeek Harness model picker
plugins.readme_text:
# 上下文窗口选择器 · dsh-context-window-picker

在 DSH 的**模型选择弹窗**里，为**当前会话**临时切换上下文窗口大小（`contextWindow`），
和「模型」「推理等级」并列成独立一行；新建会话自动恢复 Profile 默认值。

对标 WorkBuddy：模型详情面板中「思考强度」+「上下文窗口」两个配置项并列，会话级临时生效。

![模型弹窗中的上下文窗口行](screenshots/model-popup.png)

![展开后的档位列表](screenshots/picker-open.png)

## 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/luyiheng1111/dsh-context-window-picker.git
```

然后在 DSH 的 Plugins 页面里用本地目录安装（Install from path / 本地 bundle）指向刚 clone 的目录，
或在终端：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-context-window-picker
```

安装后重启 DSH 即可。插件没有构建步骤、没有运行时依赖（React 由宿主提供），
默认走 bundle patch 里的 `presets`/`completionRatio` 等默认值，无需任何配置。

## 交互

1. 打开输入框右侧的模型选择弹窗（或 `/model`）。
2. 弹窗面板里「模型」「推理等级」下方多出独立的一行 —— **上下文窗口  256K  ›**，
   右侧显示的是**当前生效**窗口；被本会话覆盖时该数字变为品牌色高亮。
3. 点这一行展开档位列表，选一个即可即时生效：
   - 默认（跟随模型）
   - 128K / 256K / 512K 等（只列出不超过当前模型默认窗口的档位；
     选中与默认相同的档位等同于回到「默认」）
4. 选择后立即写入当前会话，再发一条消息，`request/context` 事件里的上下文窗口即为新值。
5. 新建会话不携带该选择，自动回到适配器目录里的默认窗口。

因为这一行是渲染在弹窗面板**内部**的，点击它和它的档位列表都不会把弹窗关掉，
可以像原生配置项一样反复切换。

## 为什么不是「改 Profile 配置」

`defaultContextWindow` 是适配器目录（`llm-pi-ai.providers.*.models[].contextWindow` / `llm-deepseek`）
的全局值，改它会影响所有会话。本插件只在宿主内存里按 **sessionId** 记录覆盖值，
不写任何配置文件，也不写会话日志（不污染 session log）。

## 实现要点

- **宿主半** 在 `llm` 服务的原型上包装两个公开方法（插件卸载时精确还原）：
  - `llm.prepareCall(config, signal, configure)`：通过官方 `configure` 回调收紧 `maxTokens`，
    并在返回的冻结调用对象上把 `context.contextWindow` 换成会话覆盖值。
    这一步保证 `request/context` 事件、token 计量、压缩阈值看到的是同一个窗口。
  - `llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model)`：`compaction-basic` 通过它取窗口，
    所以压缩压力判断同样使用会话覆盖值。
- `Session#requestHeader` 在覆盖生效期间夹紧 `config.maxTokens`，
  避免压缩策略拿旧的 256K 完成预留去比新的小窗口而直接抛错。
- **客户端半** 不替换原生模型选择组件，而是通过 `conversation.input.model.label` 槽位
  在弹窗里追加一行：用一个隐藏锚点向上找到持有 `role="menuitem"` 单元格的面板容器，
  再用 `ReactDOM.createPortal` 把这一行插到最后一个单元格之后。
  这样这一行天然属于弹窗内部，原来的「点击外部即关闭」判定不会在点击中途把弹窗卸掉。
  该槽位同时负责输入框上的模型名，所以其余放置处（`trigger` / `option`）仍原样渲染模型名。
- 客户端与宿主之间走本机回环 JSON 接口：
  `GET /dsh-context-window-picker/api/{state,health}`、`POST /dsh-context-window-picker/api/set`，
  请求校验 Host 为回环地址、拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 与非同源 `Origin`。

## 配置（bundle patch 里可改）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `presets` | `[131072, 262144, 524288, 1048576]` | 候选窗口（只显示不超过模型默认值的） |
| `completionRatio` | `0.25` | 单次输出上限 ≤ 窗口 × 该比例 |
| `headroomTokens` | `65536` | 与压缩策略的 headroom 对齐，保证压缩不会因预留不足报错 |
| `minimumWindow` | `131072` | 最小可选窗口；低于它的模型只显示「默认」 |

## 文件

- `index.js` — 宿主插件（llm 拦截、按会话覆盖、回环 API）
- `client.js` — 客户端 UI（模型弹窗内的上下文窗口行与档位面板）
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch，插入宿主插件行
- `locale/{zh,en}.json` — 插件管理器 / 市场展示元数据
- `icon.svg` — 插件图标

## 已验证

- 宿主：`GET /dsh-context-window-picker/api/health` 返回 patch 计数；把某会话设为 262144 后，
  下一个请求的 `request/context` 事件记录 `contextWindow: 262144`，`request/header.maxTokens`
  从 256000 收紧到 65536（压缩压力判断不再抛 `leaving no message budget`）。
- 客户端：刷新页面后，模型弹窗内「推理等级」下方出现独立的「上下文窗口」行，
  模型名显示正常；点开可切换档位，切换后该行数字即时更新。

> 修改 `index.js` 需要重启 DSH 才会重新加载宿主半边；只改 `client.js` 刷新页面即可。

## 安全说明

宿主半边通过包装 `llm` 服务原型的方法（`prepareCall` / `resolveModelInfo`）和
`Session#requestHeader` 来施加覆盖——DSH 目前没有官方的「按会话改上下文窗口」接口。
这些包装在插件卸载时精确还原。所有对客户端暴露的接口都是本机回环 JSON：

| 路径 | 方法 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/dsh-context-window-picker/api/state` | GET | 读取当前会话的基准窗口 / 覆盖值 / 候选档位 |
| `/dsh-context-window-picker/api/set` | POST | 设置或（传 `null`）清除本会话覆盖 |
| `/dsh-context-window-picker/api/health` | GET | patch 计数与当前配置（诊断用） |

请求会被校验：Host 必须是回环地址或 `webRuntime.trustedHosts` 中的授权域，
拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`，且 `Origin` 必须缺失、为 `dsh-app://app` 或与 Host 同源。

## 已知限制

- 候选档位只显示**不超过**模型基准窗口的值（放大窗口属于模型/Profile 层面的能力）。
- 覆盖只影响之后发出的请求；正在执行的 step 保持它启动时的窗口。
- 客户端半边影子注册了已发布的 `conversation.input.model.label` 槽位
  （`replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui`），若官方以后改动模型弹窗的面板结构，
  插件需要相应调整行容器的定位方式。
- 输入框上的模型按钮不再追加窗口后缀；窗口只在弹窗内展示。

## 许可

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 -
